## `prepared-all-and-aggregate-need-their-receiver`

`all` and `aggregate` on a collection's `prepared` object now declare the object they are called on. This applies to every collection, not only one filtered with `whereUnique`. A call without that receiver no longer compiles:

```ts
const { all, aggregate } = db.orm.Post.prepared;
all(); // error: The 'this' context of type 'void' is not assignable to method's 'this'
aggregate((a) => ({ posts: a.count() })); // the same error
```

Call the method on the `prepared` object instead:

```ts
const prepared = db.orm.Post.prepared;
prepared.all();
prepared.aggregate((a) => ({ posts: a.count() }));
```

These still compile and need no change: a destructured `first` or `firstOrThrow`, as in `const { first, firstOrThrow } = db.orm.Post.prepared; first(); firstOrThrow()`, and `prepared.all` passed as a callback without being called. What the methods do at run time is unchanged.

## `build-native-enums-takes-the-domain`

Pass the contract's domain beside its storage:

```ts
// before
buildNamespacedNativeEnums(contract.storage);
// after
buildNamespacedNativeEnums(contract.storage, contract.domain);
```

The result no longer has an accessor for a domain enum (an `enum` block or `enumType()`), only for native enum types. The type `NamespacedNativeEnums<Contract>` leaves out the same names. Code that read a domain enum from the result reads it from the accessor `db.enums` uses instead.

## Middleware hooks are activity hooks

The runtime now runs every statement and every transaction as an **activity**. A middleware observes an activity through three lifecycle events, `activityStarted`, `activityEnded` and `activityFinalized`, and changes or stops a statement through interceptors: `beforeEncode`, `intercept.onQuery`, `intercept.onExecute` and `onRow`. The per-statement hooks are gone.

### Rename the hooks

| Before | After |
|---|---|
| `beforeQuery`, `beforeExecute` | `beforeEncode` |
| `interceptQuery`, `interceptExecute` | `intercept.onQuery`, `intercept.onExecute` |
| `onRow` | `onRow` |
| `afterQuery`, `afterExecute` | `activityEnded` on a statement |
| `afterTransaction` | `activityFinalized` on a statement |
| `beforeCompile` | `beforeCompile` |

`beforeEncode` keeps the arguments of `beforeQuery` and `beforeExecute`: the lowered plan, the context and the parameter mutator. It runs for both `query()` and `execute()`. A middleware that defined both `beforeQuery` and `beforeExecute` with the same body defines `beforeEncode` once. A middleware that must tell them apart reads `activity.returns` (`'rows'` or `'stats'`) in `activityStarted` and keeps it in `ctx.state`.

The interceptors move under one `intercept` object:

```diff
- async interceptQuery(plan, ctx) {
-   return { rows: cached };
- },
+ intercept: {
+   async onQuery(plan, ctx) {
+     return { rows: cached };
+   },
+ },
```

### Read the result from `activityEnded`

`afterQuery(plan, result, ctx)` and `afterExecute(plan, result, ctx)` become one hook, `activityEnded(activity, result, ctx)`. It fires for transactions too, so check the kind first. `result.completed` is replaced by `result.outcome`, which is `'succeeded'`, `'failed'` or `'stopped'` (the caller stopped reading the rows). `latencyMs` and `source` are unchanged; `rowCount` or `stats` is there according to `result.returns`. The plan the caller sent is `activity.plan`; the lowered SQL is not on the activity, so a middleware that logs it keeps it from `beforeEncode` in `ctx.state`:

```diff
- async afterQuery(plan, result, ctx) {
-   if (result.latencyMs > 250) ctx.log.warn({ sql: plan.sql, rowCount: result.rowCount });
- },
+ async beforeEncode(plan, ctx) {
+   ctx.state(statementSql)['sql'] = plan.sql;
+ },
+ async activityEnded(activity, result, ctx) {
+   if (result.kind !== 'statement' || result.latencyMs <= 250) return;
+   ctx.log.warn({
+     sql: ctx.state(statementSql)['sql'],
+     ...(result.returns === 'rows' ? { rowCount: result.rowCount } : {}),
+   });
+ },
```

`statementSql` is a module-level `Symbol('…')`, for example `const statementSql = Symbol('slow-query-warning.sql')`. An error thrown from `activityEnded` after a successful statement still fails it and reaches the caller, as an error from `afterQuery` did; every other middleware still receives `activityEnded`, and the caller receives the first error. A transaction also ends: `succeeded` when its `commit()` or `rollback()` resolved, `failed` when it rejected. So a rolled-back transaction ends `succeeded` and is finalized `rolled-back`. `activityEnded` also fires where `afterQuery` and `afterExecute` did not: for a statement the caller stopped reading, with `result.outcome` `'stopped'`, and for a statement that failed before it ran, in `beforeCompile`, `beforeEncode` or parameter encoding, with `result.outcome` `'failed'`, `latencyMs: 0` and `source: 'driver'`. A middleware that counts statements or latencies checks `result.outcome` if it should skip them.

### Replace `afterTransaction` with `activityFinalized`

`afterTransaction(plan, result, ctx)` becomes `activityFinalized(activity, result, ctx)`. A statement still running when its transaction ends is finalized when it ends, after its `activityEnded`, where `afterTransaction` fired at the transaction's end, before the statement's after-hook. `result.outcome` keeps its three values, `'committed'`, `'rolled-back'` and `'unknown'`, and the same rules decide it. An error thrown from it is still logged and swallowed. It also fires for transactions, after their statements, so a middleware that acts on statements checks `activity.kind === 'statement'`. A statement that fails before it runs, in `beforeCompile`, `beforeEncode` or parameter encoding, is now finalized too: `unknown` outside a transaction, and with the transaction's outcome inside one.

### Rename the context type and the execution id

`RuntimeMiddlewareContext` is now `ActivityContext`, and `SqlMiddlewareContext` and `MongoMiddlewareContext` extend it. A SQL middleware imports `SqlMiddleware` and `SqlMiddlewareContext` from `@prisma/orm-postgres/family-runtime` (or `@prisma/orm-sqlite/family-runtime`), a Mongo middleware imports `MongoMiddleware` and `MongoMiddlewareContext` from `@prisma/orm-mongo/family-runtime`, and a cross-family middleware imports `CrossFamilyMiddleware` and `ActivityContext` from `@prisma/orm-framework/components/runtime`. `ctx.planExecutionId` is removed; use `activity.id`, a fresh id for each activity that every hook of the activity sees. A log detail or field that carried `planExecutionId: ctx.planExecutionId` becomes `activityId: activity.id`. Keep per-statement state in `ctx.state(key)` instead of a `WeakMap` keyed by the plan: each activity has its own state, and middleware that use the same key share the object. `AfterQueryResult`, `AfterExecuteResult` and `AfterTransactionResult` are removed; use `ActivityEndedResult` and `ActivityFinalizedResult`.

### Abort phases and already-aborted calls

A `RUNTIME.ABORTED` error raised during the middleware stage before encoding has `details.phase` `'beforeEncode'`. Code that matches `'beforeQuery'` or `'beforeExecute'` matches `'beforeEncode'` instead. The same holds for the Mongo error `RUNTIME.CONTENT_HASH_REQUIRES_RESOLVED_COMMAND`, raised when a Mongo `beforeEncode` hook calls `ctx.contentHash`: its `details.phase` is `'beforeEncode'`. A call whose signal was aborted before it was made now fires `activityStarted`, then ends `failed`, before it rejects with `RUNTIME.ABORTED`.

### The observed-row budget now runs

`budgets()` now counts the rows each query returns. Before, this check never ran, so a query that returned more than `maxRows` rows succeeded. Now, with the default row severity `'error'` or in `strict` mode, such a query fails with `BUDGET.ROWS_EXCEEDED` once the count passes `maxRows`; with `severities: { rowCount: 'warn' }` in `permissive` mode it logs one warning for the statement and keeps streaming. The `postgres()` client runs its runtime in `strict` mode, where every `budgets()` violation throws whatever its severity, so the warn path does not apply there until the client exposes `mode`. Raise `maxRows` for reads that are expected to return more rows. `tableRows` and `defaultTableRows` only change the estimate checked before a read runs; they do not change the limit on rows a read actually returns.

### Move per-statement state from a `WeakMap` to `ctx.state`

A middleware that kept per-statement state in a `WeakMap` keyed by the plan keeps it in `ctx.state` instead. The state object's values are `unknown`, so read them back through a type guard, and delete the entry in `activityEnded` once it is used:

```diff
- const pending = new WeakMap<object, PendingMiss>();
+ const pendingMiss = Symbol('cache.pendingMiss');
+
+ function pendingOf(ctx: ActivityContext): PendingMiss | undefined {
+   const miss = ctx.state(pendingMiss)['miss'];
+   return isPendingMiss(miss) ? miss : undefined;
+ }

  // in intercept.onQuery, on a miss
- pending.set(exec, { entry, buffer: [] });
+ ctx.state(pendingMiss)['miss'] = { entry, buffer: [] };

  // in onRow
- pending.get(exec)?.buffer.push(row);
+ pendingOf(ctx)?.buffer.push(row);

  // in activityEnded, which replaces afterQuery
- const miss = pending.get(exec);
- if (miss === undefined) return;
- pending.delete(exec);
- if (!result.completed || result.source !== 'driver') return;
+ const miss = pendingOf(ctx);
+ if (miss === undefined) return;
+ delete ctx.state(pendingMiss)['miss'];
+ if (result.kind !== 'statement' || result.outcome !== 'succeeded' || result.source !== 'driver') return;
```

`pendingMiss` and `pendingOf` are module-level; `isPendingMiss` is a type guard for the state's shape. The middleware object then lists `intercept: { onQuery }`, `onRow` and `activityEnded` in place of `interceptQuery`, `onRow` and `afterQuery`.

### Run statements through the statement runners

A family runtime no longer composes the middleware runners itself. It runs each statement through one call that starts the activity, runs a body, and ends and finalizes the activity:

```diff
- await runBeforeQueryChain(exec, this.middleware, ctx, mutator);
- yield* reportQueryEnding(onQueryEnd, () =>
-   runQueryWithMiddleware(exec, this.middleware, ctx, () => this.runDriver(exec)),
- );
+ yield* streamStatement(
+   { middleware: this.middleware, plan, context: contextFields, parent: undefined },
+   async function* (run) {
+     const exec = await prepare(run); // calls run.beforeEncode(draft, mutator) before encoding
+     yield* run.runQuery(exec, () => self.runDriver(exec));
+   },
+ );
```

`executeStatement` is the same for `execute()`, with `run.runExecute(exec, runDriver)`. `context` is an `ActivityContextFields`: the runtime-wide fields (`contract`, `mode`, `now`, `log`, `contentHash`, `scope`, and `signal` when the caller passed one); the runner adds `parent`, `state` and `inTransaction`. `parent` is the open transaction a statement was sent on, or `undefined`. `RuntimeCoreOptions.ctx` takes the same fields, so remove `planExecutionId` from it.

A runtime that opens transactions calls `startTransactionActivity({ middleware, context, holdFinishedChildren })` before `BEGIN`, where `holdFinishedChildren` is decided once, when the runtime is created: `true` only when some middleware implements `activityFinalized`. It passes the result as the `parent` of every statement sent on the transaction or its connection while it is open, and calls `end({ by: 'commit' | 'rollback', outcome, ... })` when `commit()` or `rollback()` settles. A SQL runtime subclass that wrapped a driver transaction with `wrapTransaction(driverTx, connection)` calls `beginTransactionOn(connection, owner)` instead, which does all of this.

### Renamed log events

A test or log filter that matches the runtime's debug event `middleware.interceptQuery` or `middleware.interceptExecute` matches `middleware.intercept.onQuery` or `middleware.intercept.onExecute`. The error event `middleware.afterTransaction.error` is now `middleware.activityFinalized.error`.

## MongoDB carries out `--rename` and `--delete`

### `rename-statements-capability-removed`

Delete `renameStatements` from a target's `migrations` capability, and any `keepDataByHand` function it pointed at. A test double of the capability that set it drops the member. A data-loss question now offers `rename` for a model or field the destination no longer has on every target; write a planner that carries out the resolved statements it is given, or refuses each with a `statementRefused` conflict that carries it in `refusedStatement`.

### `mongo-ddl-rename-collection`

The DDL command alphabet gains a collection rename:

```ts
import { RenameCollectionCommand } from '@prisma/orm-family-mongo/query-ast/control';

new RenameCollectionCommand('profiles', 'users');
```

A `MongoDdlCommandVisitor<R>` implementation adds `renameCollection(command)`. A Mongo driver's `run(wireCommand)` handles `kind: 'renameCollection'`, as the shipped driver does with `db.renameCollection(collection, to)`, without `dropTarget`. An adapter's DDL lowering maps the command to `new RenameCollectionWireCommand(command.collection, command.to)`.

### `mongo-dml-operations`

Rename the types where code names them:

```diff
- import type { MongoDataTransformCheck, MongoDataTransformOperation } from '@prisma/orm-family-mongo/query-ast/control';
+ import type { MongoDmlCheck, MongoDmlOperation } from '@prisma/orm-family-mongo/query-ast/control';
```

Where code narrows `AnyMongoMigrationOperation` by `operation.operationClass === 'data'`, use the guard instead:

```diff
- if (operation.operationClass === 'data') {
+ if (isMongoDmlOperation(operation)) {
```

`isMongoDmlOperation` comes from `@prisma/orm-family-mongo/query-ast/control`. An operation without `run` is a DDL operation. The `dataTransform` factory keeps its name: it builds a DML operation with class `data`. A hand-written `dataTransform` still has class `data`, so a policy that leaves out `data` (as `db update`'s does) still refuses it, and runs `renameField` and `unsetField`.

### `mongo-update-many-bypass-validation`

A hand-built lowered draft of kind `rawUpdateMany` adds `bypassDocumentValidation: false`. A driver's `updateMany` passes `bypassDocumentValidation: true` to MongoDB when the wire command carries it.

### `mongo-op-factory-call-to-op`

Code typed against the result of `toOp()` or `renderOps(...)` as `MongoMigrationPlanOperation` widens it to `AnyMongoMigrationOperation`, and narrows with `isMongoDmlOperation` where it needs `execute` or `run`.
````

## File: backend/.agents/skills/prisma-8/upgrading/extension/upgrades/8.0.0-rc.18-to-8.0.0-rc.19/scripts/client-takes-contract-value/contract-from-json.ts
````typescript
// Moves every Prisma 8 client call that passes `contractJson` to a contract value:
//   postgres<Contract>({ contractJson, url })
// becomes
//   export const contract = contractFromJson<Contract>(contractJson);
//   postgres({ contract, url })
//
// Usage: node contract-from-json.ts [project-root] [--typescript <path to the typescript package>]
//
// The script reads source files with the TypeScript compiler, which it loads from the project.
// It rewrites each source file it can move, and prints it. In a module with a default export, such
// as a Worker entry, it declares `contract` without `export` and says so. It prints to stderr, with the reason,
// each file that passes `contractJson` to a client but that it did not move: a test file, a file
// that already has another binding named `contract`, a file whose clients use different contracts,
// a file whose `contractJson` value is not readable at the top of the file, or a call it cannot
// read. A `contract` destructured from the moved call is dropped from the destructuring. It exits 1 when it printed such a file, and changes nothing and exits 1
// when TypeScript is not installed or an argument is wrong. It skips node_modules, dist, build and every directory whose
// name starts with a dot, such as .git, .agents or .claude, and links that lead nowhere.

import { readdirSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, statSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { join, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
import type * as TS from 'typescript';

const SOURCE_FILE = /\.(?:ts|tsx|mts|cts)$/;
const TEST_FILE = /\.(?:test|spec)(?:-d)?\.[cm]?tsx?$/;
const TEST_DIRECTORIES = new Set(['test', 'tests', '__tests__']);
const SKIPPED_DIRECTORIES = new Set(['node_modules', 'dist', 'build']);
const FACADE_ENTRY =
  /^@prisma\/orm-(postgres|sqlite|mongo)\/(?:runtime|serverless|static|query-builder)$/;
const SUPABASE_ENTRY = '@prisma/orm-extension-supabase/runtime';
const FACTORY_EXPORTS = new Set(['default', 'supabase', 'mongoQuery']);
const DETECTION =
  /(?<![\w$.])(?:postgres|postgresServerless|sqlite|supabase|mongo|postgresStatic|sqliteStatic|mongoStatic|mongoQuery)(?:<[^<>()]*(?:<[^<>()]*>[^<>()]*)*>)?\(\s*\{(?:(?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*?,)?\s*contractJson\s*[,}:]/;

interface Edit {
  readonly start: number;
  readonly end: number;
  readonly text: string;
}

interface MovedCall {
  readonly node: TS.CallExpression;
  readonly edits: readonly Edit[];
  readonly typeArguments: string;
  readonly json: string;
  readonly jsonNames: readonly string[];
  readonly staticEntry: string;
}

type Outcome =
  | { readonly kind: 'unchanged' }
  | { readonly kind: 'rewritten'; readonly source: string; readonly exported: boolean }
  | { readonly kind: 'refused'; readonly reason: string };

function staticEntryOf(specifier: string): string | undefined {
  const facade = FACADE_ENTRY.exec(specifier);
  if (facade !== null) return `@prisma/orm-${facade[1]}/static`;
  return specifier === SUPABASE_ENTRY ? '@prisma/orm-postgres/static' : undefined;
}

function specifierOf(ts: typeof TS, statement: TS.ImportDeclaration): string {
  return ts.isStringLiteral(statement.moduleSpecifier) ? statement.moduleSpecifier.text : '';
}

function compareSpecifiers(left: string, right: string): number {
  const rank = (specifier: string) =>
    specifier.startsWith('node:') ? 0 : specifier.startsWith('.') ? 2 : 1;
  return rank(left) - rank(right) || (left < right ? -1 : left > right ? 1 : 0);
}

function factoriesOf(ts: typeof TS, imports: readonly TS.ImportDeclaration[]) {
  const factories = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const statement of imports) {
    const clause = statement.importClause;
    const staticEntry = staticEntryOf(specifierOf(ts, statement));
    if (clause === undefined || clause.isTypeOnly || staticEntry === undefined) continue;
    if (clause.name !== undefined) factories.set(clause.name.text, staticEntry);
    const bindings = clause.namedBindings;
    if (bindings === undefined || !ts.isNamedImports(bindings)) continue;
    for (const element of bindings.elements) {
      const imported = (element.propertyName ?? element.name).text;
      if (!element.isTypeOnly && FACTORY_EXPORTS.has(imported)) {
        factories.set(element.name.text, staticEntry);
      }
    }
  }
  return factories;
}

function topLevelNames(ts: typeof TS, sourceFile: TS.SourceFile) {
  const imported = new Set<string>();
  const declared = new Set<string>();
  for (const statement of sourceFile.statements) {
    if (ts.isImportDeclaration(statement)) {
      const clause = statement.importClause;
      if (clause?.name !== undefined) imported.add(clause.name.text);
      const bindings = clause?.namedBindings;
      if (bindings !== undefined && ts.isNamespaceImport(bindings))
        imported.add(bindings.name.text);
      else for (const element of bindings?.elements ?? []) imported.add(element.name.text);
    } else if (ts.isVariableStatement(statement)) {
      for (const declaration of statement.declarationList.declarations) {
        for (const name of bindingNames(ts, declaration.name)) declared.add(name);
      }
    } else if (
      (ts.isFunctionDeclaration(statement) || ts.isClassDeclaration(statement)) &&
      statement.name !== undefined
    ) {
      declared.add(statement.name.text);
    }
  }
  return { imported, declared };
}

function bindingIdentifiers(ts: typeof TS, name: TS.BindingName): TS.Identifier[] {
  if (ts.isIdentifier(name)) return [name];
  return name.elements.flatMap((element) =>
    ts.isOmittedExpression(element) ? [] : bindingIdentifiers(ts, element.name),
  );
}

function bindingNames(ts: typeof TS, name: TS.BindingName): string[] {
  return bindingIdentifiers(ts, name).map((identifier) => identifier.text);
}

function bindingsOf(ts: typeof TS, root: TS.Node, wanted: string): TS.Node[] {
  const found: TS.Node[] = [];
  const visit = (node: TS.Node): void => {
    const binding = ownBindingOf(ts, node, wanted);
    if (binding !== undefined) found.push(binding);
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(root);
  return found;
}

function ownBindingOf(ts: typeof TS, node: TS.Node, wanted: string): TS.Node | undefined {
  if (ts.isVariableDeclaration(node) || ts.isParameter(node)) {
    return bindingIdentifiers(ts, node.name).find((name) => name.text === wanted);
  }
  if (
    (ts.isFunctionDeclaration(node) ||
      ts.isFunctionExpression(node) ||
      ts.isClassDeclaration(node) ||
      ts.isClassExpression(node) ||
      ts.isEnumDeclaration(node) ||
      ts.isModuleDeclaration(node) ||
      ts.isImportEqualsDeclaration(node) ||
      ts.isExportSpecifier(node) ||
      ts.isNamespaceExport(node) ||
      ts.isImportSpecifier(node) ||
      ts.isNamespaceImport(node) ||
      ts.isImportClause(node)) &&
    node.name !== undefined &&
    ts.isIdentifier(node.name) &&
    node.name.text === wanted
  ) {
    return node.name;
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** Whether `identifier` names a variable the file declares at its top level. */
function isTopLevelVariable(ts: typeof TS, identifier: TS.Node): boolean {
  let node = identifier.parent;
  while (
    ts.isBindingElement(node) ||
    ts.isObjectBindingPattern(node) ||
    ts.isArrayBindingPattern(node)
  )
    node = node.parent;
  return (
    ts.isVariableDeclaration(node) &&
    ts.isVariableDeclarationList(node.parent) &&
    ts.isVariableStatement(node.parent.parent) &&
    ts.isSourceFile(node.parent.parent.parent)
  );
}

function topLevelStatementOf(ts: typeof TS, node: TS.Node): TS.Node | undefined {
  let current = node;
  while (current.parent !== undefined && !ts.isSourceFile(current.parent)) current = current.parent;
  return current.parent === undefined ? undefined : current;
}

/** The edit that drops `contract` from `const { ..., contract } = client(...)`, whose value the moved declaration now holds. */
function destructuredContractEdit(
  ts: typeof TS,
  sourceFile: TS.SourceFile,
  call: TS.CallExpression,
  exported: boolean,
): { readonly binding: TS.Node; readonly edit: Edit } | undefined {
  const declaration = call.parent;
  if (!ts.isVariableDeclaration(declaration) || declaration.initializer !== call) return undefined;
  const pattern = declaration.name;
  if (!ts.isObjectBindingPattern(pattern)) return undefined;
  if (pattern.elements.some((element) => element.dotDotDotToken !== undefined)) return undefined;
  const index = pattern.elements.findIndex(
    (element) =>
      element.propertyName === undefined &&
      element.initializer === undefined &&
      ts.isIdentifier(element.name) &&
      element.name.text === 'contract',
  );
  const element = pattern.elements[index];
  if (element === undefined) return undefined;
  const statement = declaration.parent.parent;
  const isExported =
    ts.isVariableStatement(statement) &&
    (ts.getModifiers(statement)?.some((m) => m.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.ExportKeyword) ?? false);
  if (isExported && !exported) return undefined;
  if (pattern.elements.length === 1) {
    if (
      !ts.isVariableStatement(statement) ||
      isExported ||
      statement.declarationList.declarations.length !== 1
    )
      return undefined;
    return {
      binding: element.name,
      edit: { start: statement.getStart(sourceFile), end: call.getStart(sourceFile), text: '' },
    };
  }
  const next = pattern.elements[index + 1];
  const previous = pattern.elements[index - 1];
  const edit =
    next !== undefined
      ? { start: element.getStart(sourceFile), end: next.getStart(sourceFile), text: '' }
      : { start: previous?.end ?? element.getStart(sourceFile), end: element.end, text: '' };
  return { binding: element.name, edit };
}

function isReference(ts: typeof TS, identifier: TS.Identifier): boolean {
  const parent = identifier.parent;
  return !(
    (ts.isPropertyAccessExpression(parent) && parent.name === identifier) ||
    (ts.isQualifiedName(parent) && parent.right === identifier) ||
    ((ts.isPropertyAssignment(parent) ||
      ts.isMethodDeclaration(parent) ||
      ts.isGetAccessorDeclaration(parent) ||
      ts.isSetAccessorDeclaration(parent)) &&
      parent.name === identifier)
  );
}

function identifiersIn(ts: typeof TS, node: TS.Node): string[] {
  const names: string[] = [];
  const visit = (child: TS.Node): void => {
    if (ts.isIdentifier(child) && isReference(ts, child)) names.push(child.text);
    ts.forEachChild(child, visit);
  };
  visit(node);
  return names;
}

function contractJsonProperty(ts: typeof TS, object: TS.ObjectLiteralExpression) {
  return object.properties.find(
    (property): property is TS.ShorthandPropertyAssignment | TS.PropertyAssignment =>
      (ts.isShorthandPropertyAssignment(property) || ts.isPropertyAssignment(property)) &&
      (ts.isIdentifier(property.name) || ts.isStringLiteral(property.name)) &&
      property.name.text === 'contractJson',
  );
}

function movedCalls(
  ts: typeof TS,
  sourceFile: TS.SourceFile,
  factories: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
): MovedCall[] {
  const source = sourceFile.text;
  const calls: MovedCall[] = [];
  const visit = (node: TS.Node): void => {
    if (ts.isCallExpression(node) && ts.isIdentifier(node.expression)) {
      const staticEntry = factories.get(node.expression.text);
      const [options] = node.arguments;
      const property =
        options !== undefined && ts.isObjectLiteralExpression(options)
          ? contractJsonProperty(ts, options)
          : undefined;
      if (staticEntry !== undefined && property !== undefined) {
        const edits: Edit[] = [
          { start: property.getStart(sourceFile), end: property.end, text: 'contract' },
        ];
        const typeArguments = node.typeArguments;
        if (typeArguments !== undefined) {
          edits.push({
            start: node.expression.end,
            end: source.indexOf('>', typeArguments.end) + 1,
            text: '',
          });
        }
        calls.push({
          node,
          edits,
          typeArguments:
            typeArguments === undefined
              ? ''
              : `<${typeArguments.map((type) => type.getText(sourceFile)).join(', ')}>`,
          json: ts.isPropertyAssignment(property)
            ? property.initializer.getText(sourceFile)
            : 'contractJson',
          jsonNames: ts.isPropertyAssignment(property)
            ? identifiersIn(ts, property.initializer)
            : ['contractJson'],
          staticEntry,
        });
      }
    }
    ts.forEachChild(node, visit);
  };
  visit(sourceFile);
  return calls;
}

function importEdit(
  ts: typeof TS,
  sourceFile: TS.SourceFile,
  imports: readonly TS.ImportDeclaration[],
  staticEntry: string,
  style: { readonly quote: string; readonly semicolon: string; readonly eol: string },
): Edit | { readonly after: string } {
  const existing = imports.find(
    (statement) =>
      specifierOf(ts, statement) === staticEntry &&
      statement.importClause !== undefined &&
      !statement.importClause.isTypeOnly,
  );
  const clause = existing?.importClause;
  const bindings = clause?.namedBindings;
  if (bindings !== undefined && ts.isNamedImports(bindings)) {
    const first = bindings.elements[0];
    return first === undefined
      ? { start: bindings.getStart(sourceFile), end: bindings.end, text: '{ contractFromJson }' }
      : {
          start: first.getStart(sourceFile),
          end: first.getStart(sourceFile),
          text: 'contractFromJson, ',
        };
  }
  if (clause?.name !== undefined && bindings === undefined) {
    return { start: clause.name.end, end: clause.name.end, text: ', { contractFromJson }' };
  }
  const line = `import { contractFromJson } from ${style.quote}${staticEntry}${style.quote}${style.semicolon}`;
  const before = imports.find(
    (statement) =>
      statement.importClause !== undefined &&
      compareSpecifiers(specifierOf(ts, statement), staticEntry) > 0,
  );
  if (before === undefined) return { after: `${style.eol}${line}` };
  const at = before.getStart(sourceFile);
  return { start: at, end: at, text: `${line}${style.eol}` };
}

export function moveFile(ts: typeof TS, fileName: string, source: string): Outcome {
  const sourceFile = ts.createSourceFile(
    fileName,
    source,
    ts.ScriptTarget.Latest,
    true,
    fileName.endsWith('.tsx') ? ts.ScriptKind.TSX : ts.ScriptKind.TS,
  );
  const imports = sourceFile.statements.filter(ts.isImportDeclaration);
  const calls = movedCalls(ts, sourceFile, factoriesOf(ts, imports));
  const first = calls[0];
  if (first === undefined) {
    return DETECTION.test(source)
      ? {
          kind: 'refused',
          reason: 'it passes contractJson to a client in a form the script cannot read',
        }
      : { kind: 'unchanged' };
  }
  if (
    calls.some(
      (call) =>
        call.json !== first.json ||
        call.typeArguments !== first.typeArguments ||
        call.staticEntry !== first.staticEntry,
    )
  ) {
    return {
      kind: 'refused',
      reason: 'its clients use different contracts; give each its own contractFromJson value',
    };
  }
  const names = topLevelNames(ts, sourceFile);
  const topLevelStatement = topLevelStatementOf(ts, first.node);
  const inner = first.jsonNames.find(
    (name) =>
      topLevelStatement !== undefined &&
      bindingsOf(ts, topLevelStatement, name).some((found) => !isTopLevelVariable(ts, found)),
  );
  if (inner !== undefined) {
    return {
      kind: 'refused',
      reason: `its contractJson value uses ${inner}, which is a parameter or local binding where the client is created, not a value the top of the file can read; pass contract: contractFromJson${first.typeArguments}(${first.json}) to the call instead of contractJson, and import contractFromJson from ${first.staticEntry}`,
    };
  }
  const exported = !hasDefaultExport(ts, sourceFile);
  const destructured = calls
    .map((call) => destructuredContractEdit(ts, sourceFile, call.node, exported))
    .filter((found) => found !== undefined);
  const binding = bindingsOf(ts, sourceFile, 'contract').find(
    (found) => !destructured.some((entry) => entry.binding === found),
  );
  if (binding !== undefined) {
    const line = sourceFile.getLineAndCharacterOfPosition(binding.getStart(sourceFile)).line + 1;
    return {
      kind: 'refused',
      reason: ts.isExportSpecifier(binding.parent)
        ? `it exports contract in an export statement (line ${line}); remove contract from that statement and run the script again`
        : `it already has a binding named contract (line ${line}); rename that binding and run the script again`,
    };
  }
  const local = first.jsonNames.find((name) => names.declared.has(name));
  if (local !== undefined) {
    return {
      kind: 'refused',
      reason: `its contractJson value uses ${local}, which the file declares after its imports; declare the contract value after ${local} by hand`,
    };
  }

  const lastImport = imports.at(-1);
  if (lastImport === undefined) {
    return { kind: 'refused', reason: 'it imports no client' };
  }
  const firstImport = imports[0];
  const firstImportText = firstImport?.getText(sourceFile) ?? '';
  const style = {
    quote: firstImport?.moduleSpecifier.getText(sourceFile).startsWith('"') ? '"' : "'",
    semicolon: firstImportText.endsWith(';') ? ';' : '',
    eol: source.includes('\r\n') ? '\r\n' : '\n',
  };
  const edits: Edit[] = [
    ...calls.flatMap((call) => call.edits),
    ...destructured.map((entry) => entry.edit),
  ];
  const staticImport = importEdit(ts, sourceFile, imports, first.staticEntry, style);
  const importedAfter = 'after' in staticImport ? staticImport.after : '';
  if ('start' in staticImport) edits.push(staticImport);

  let afterImports = lastImport.end;
  while (source[afterImports] === '\r' || source[afterImports] === '\n') afterImports++;
  const declaration = `${exported ? 'export ' : ''}const contract = contractFromJson${first.typeArguments}(${first.json})${style.semicolon}`;
  edits.push({
    start: lastImport.end,
    end: afterImports,
    text: `${importedAfter}${style.eol}${style.eol}${declaration}${style.eol}${afterImports < source.length ? style.eol : ''}`,
  });

  let moved = source;
  for (const edit of [...edits].sort((left, right) => right.start - left.start)) {
    moved = moved.slice(0, edit.start) + edit.text + moved.slice(edit.end);
  }
  return { kind: 'rewritten', source: moved, exported };
}

function hasDefaultExport(ts: typeof TS, sourceFile: TS.SourceFile): boolean {
  return sourceFile.statements.some(
    (statement) =>
      (ts.isExportAssignment(statement) && !statement.isExportEquals) ||
      (ts.isExportDeclaration(statement) &&
        statement.exportClause !== undefined &&
        ts.isNamedExports(statement.exportClause) &&
        statement.exportClause.elements.some((element) => element.name.text === 'default')) ||
      (ts.canHaveModifiers(statement) &&
        (ts.getModifiers(statement)?.some((m) => m.kind === ts.SyntaxKind.DefaultKeyword) ??
          false)),
  );
}

function isTestPath(path: string): boolean {
  return TEST_FILE.test(path) || path.split(/[\\/]/).some((part) => TEST_DIRECTORIES.has(part));
}

function isDirectory(path: string): boolean {
  try {
    return statSync(path).isDirectory();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isFile(path: string): boolean {
  try {
    return statSync(path).isFile();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** Each source file under `root`, once, by the first path that reaches it; a link to a directory already visited is not followed again. */
function sourceFiles(root: string): string[] {
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const found = new Map<string, string>();
  const visit = (directory: string): void => {
    const realDirectory = realpathSync(directory);
    if (visited.has(realDirectory)) return;
    visited.add(realDirectory);
    for (const entry of readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true })) {
      const path = join(directory, entry.name);
      if (entry.isDirectory() || (entry.isSymbolicLink() && isDirectory(path))) {
        if (!SKIPPED_DIRECTORIES.has(entry.name) && !entry.name.startsWith('.')) visit(path);
      } else if (
        (entry.isFile() || (entry.isSymbolicLink() && isFile(path))) &&
        SOURCE_FILE.test(entry.name) &&
        !entry.name.endsWith('.d.ts')
      ) {
        const realFile = realpathSync(path);
        if (!found.has(realFile)) found.set(realFile, path);
      }
    }
  };
  visit(root);
  return [...found.values()];
}

function loadTypeScript(root: string, explicit: string | undefined): typeof TS | undefined {
  const require = createRequire(join(root, 'package.json'));
  try {
    return require(explicit ?? 'typescript');
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

const USAGE =
  'Usage: node contract-from-json.ts [project-root] [--typescript <path to the typescript package>]';

function parseArgs(args: readonly string[]): {
  readonly root: string;
  readonly typescript: string | undefined;
  readonly errors: string[];
} {
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const positional: string[] = [];
  let typescript: string | undefined;
  for (let index = 0; index < args.length; index++) {
    const arg = args[index] ?? '';
    if (arg === '--typescript') {
      const path = args[++index];
      if (path === undefined || path.startsWith('-'))
        errors.push('--typescript: needs the path to the typescript package');
      else typescript = resolve(path);
    } else if (arg.startsWith('-')) errors.push(`${arg}: unknown option`);
    else positional.push(arg);
  }
  if (positional.length > 1) errors.push(`expected one project root, got ${positional.length}`);
  const root = resolve(positional[0] ?? process.cwd());
  if (errors.length === 0 && !isDirectory(root)) errors.push(`${root}: not a directory`);
  if (errors.length > 0) errors.push(USAGE);
  return { root, typescript, errors };
}

function main(): number {
  const { root, typescript, errors } = parseArgs(process.argv.slice(2));
  if (errors.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`${errors.join('\n')}\n`);
    return 1;
  }
  const ts = loadTypeScript(root, typescript);
  if (ts === undefined) {
    process.stderr.write(
      `TypeScript is not installed in ${root}. Install it (for example pnpm add -D typescript) and run the script again, or move each client by hand as the guide describes. No file was changed.\n`,
    );
    return 1;
  }

  let refused = 0;
  for (const path of sourceFiles(root).sort()) {
    const name = relative(root, path).split('\\').join('/');
    const source = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    const outcome: Outcome = isTestPath(name)
      ? DETECTION.test(source)
        ? {
            kind: 'refused',
            reason:
              'it is a test file; import the contract value from the module that creates the client',
          }
        : { kind: 'unchanged' }
      : moveFile(ts, path, source);
    if (outcome.kind === 'rewritten') {
      writeFileSync(path, outcome.source);
      process.stdout.write(
        outcome.exported
          ? `${name}: moved to contractFromJson\n`
          : `${name}: moved to contractFromJson; contract is not exported, because the module has a default export (a Worker treats every named export of its entry module as an entrypoint); a module that needs the value gets it from a separate module\n`,
      );
    } else if (outcome.kind === 'refused') {
      refused++;
      process.stderr.write(`${name}: not moved, because ${outcome.reason}\n`);
    }
  }
  return refused === 0 ? 0 : 1;
}

process.exitCode = main();
````

````typescript
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Rewrites every stored SQLite contract in a project to this release's form: a column or named type
 * of `sqlite/datetime@1` or `sqlite/json@1` names its own data type (`sqlite/datetime`,
 * `sqlite/json`) instead of `sqlite/text`, and a datetime default or enum value is written with
 * exactly three fraction digits (`2024-01-01T00:00:00.000Z`). It then renames the snapshot
 * directories and rewrites every migration, ref, `migration.ts` and `contract.d.ts` that names an
 * old storage hash.
 *
 * Usage: node data-type-values.ts [project-root]
 *
 * The project root defaults to the working directory. The script reads and writes files only. It
 * needs no database, network or configured stack, and a project already in the new form is left
 * unchanged. When it stops (a file that must be JSON is not, or a snapshot directory that already
 * exists with different content) it changes no file, prints one line per case and exits 1. When it
 * finishes it prints how many files and snapshot directories it changed and each storage hash it
 * replaced.
 *
 * The storage hash and migration hash rules are copied from `@internal/contract` and
 * `@internal/migration-tools` because a project's strict `node_modules` does not expose them.
 */
import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import {
  chmodSync,
  type Dirent,
  existsSync,
  mkdirSync,
  readdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  realpathSync,
  renameSync,
  rmSync,
  statSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { basename, dirname, join, relative, resolve, sep } from 'node:path';

type Json = null | boolean | number | string | Json[] | JsonRecord;
interface JsonRecord {
  [key: string]: Json;
}

const DATA_TYPES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  'sqlite/datetime@1': 'sqlite/datetime',
  'sqlite/json@1': 'sqlite/json',
};
const DATETIME_CODEC = 'sqlite/datetime@1';
const PREVIOUS_DATA_TYPE = 'sqlite/text';
const UTC_INSTANT = /^(.*:\d{2})(?:\.(\d{1,3}))?Z$/;
const SKIPPED_DIRECTORIES = new Set(['node_modules', 'dist', 'build']);
const HASH = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/;
const TEMPORARY_SUFFIX = '.data-type-values-tmp';

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is JsonRecord {
  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
  const prototype: unknown = Object.getPrototypeOf(value);
  return prototype === Object.prototype || prototype === null;
}

function parseJson(text: string): Json | undefined {
  try {
    const value: Json = JSON.parse(text);
    return value;
  } catch {
    return undefined;
  }
}

function sha256(text: string): string {
  return createHash('sha256').update(text).digest('hex');
}

function compareCodeUnits(a: string, b: string): number {
  return a < b ? -1 : a > b ? 1 : 0;
}

function sortKeys(value: Json): Json {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map(sortKeys);
  if (!isRecord(value)) return value;
  const sorted: JsonRecord = {};
  for (const key of Object.keys(value).sort(compareCodeUnits)) {
    const child = value[key];
    if (child !== undefined) sorted[key] = sortKeys(child);
  }
  return sorted;
}

function canonicalizeJson(value: Json): string {
  return JSON.stringify(sortKeys(value));
}

type PathSegment = string | readonly string[];

function matchesPath(path: readonly string[], pattern: readonly PathSegment[]): boolean {
  if (path.length !== pattern.length) return false;
  return pattern.every((segment, index) => {
    const value = path[index];
    if (value === undefined) return false;
    if (segment === '*') return true;
    return typeof segment === 'string' ? value === segment : segment.includes(value);
  });
}

const SQL_PRESERVED_EMPTY: readonly (readonly PathSegment[])[] = [
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries', 'table'],
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries', 'table', '*'],
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries', 'table', '*', ['uniques', 'indexes', 'foreignKeys']],
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries', 'table', '*', 'indexes', 'unique'],
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries', 'table', '*', 'columns', '*', 'default', 'value'],
];
const COLUMN_DEFAULT_VALUE: readonly PathSegment[] = [
  'storage',
  'namespaces',
  '*',
  'entries',
  'table',
  '*',
  'columns',
  '*',
  'default',
  'value',
];
const COLUMN_PATHS: readonly (readonly PathSegment[])[] = [
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries', 'table', '*', 'columns', '*'],
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'tables', '*', 'columns', '*'],
];
const DATA_TYPE_PATHS: readonly (readonly PathSegment[])[] = [
  ...COLUMN_PATHS,
  ['storage', 'types', '*'],
];
const FRAMEWORK_PRESERVED_EMPTY: readonly (readonly PathSegment[])[] = [
  ['domain', 'namespaces'],
  ['domain', 'namespaces', '*'],
  ['domain', 'namespaces', '*', 'models'],
  ['domain', 'namespaces', '*', 'models', '*', 'relations'],
  ['domain', 'namespaces', '*', 'models', '*', 'storage'],
  ['storage', 'namespaces'],
  ['storage', 'namespaces', '*', 'entries'],
  ['roots'],
  ['extensions'],
  ['extensions', '*'],
  ['capabilities'],
  ['meta'],
  ['execution', 'mutations', 'defaults'],
];
const TOP_LEVEL_ORDER = [
  'schemaVersion',
  'canonicalVersion',
  'targetFamily',
  'target',
  'profileHash',
  'roots',
  'domain',
  'storage',
  'execution',
  'capabilities',
  'extensions',
  'defaultControlPolicy',
  'meta',
];

function isDefaultValue(value: Json): boolean {
  if (value === false) return true;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.length === 0;
  return isRecord(value) && Object.keys(value).length === 0;
}

function isPreservedEmpty(path: readonly string[], key: string): boolean {
  if (key === 'nullable') return true;
  if (key === 'elementNullable' && path.at(-2) === 'many') return true;
  if (FRAMEWORK_PRESERVED_EMPTY.some((pattern) => matchesPath(path, pattern))) return true;
  if (
    path.length >= COLUMN_DEFAULT_VALUE.length &&
    matchesPath(path.slice(0, COLUMN_DEFAULT_VALUE.length), COLUMN_DEFAULT_VALUE)
  )
    return true;
  return SQL_PRESERVED_EMPTY.some((pattern) => matchesPath(path, pattern));
}

function omitDefaults(value: Json, path: readonly string[]): Json {
  if (Array.isArray(value)) return value.map((item) => omitDefaults(item, path));
  if (!isRecord(value)) return value;
  const result: JsonRecord = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) {
    const childPath = [...path, key];
    if (key === '_generated') continue;
    if (key === 'generated' && child === false) continue;
    if ((key === 'onDelete' || key === 'onUpdate') && child === 'noAction') continue;
    if (isDefaultValue(child) && !isPreservedEmpty(childPath, key)) continue;
    result[key] = omitDefaults(child, childPath);
  }
  return result;
}

function compareByName(a: Json, b: Json): number {
  const nameA = isRecord(a) && typeof a['name'] === 'string' ? a['name'] : '';
  const nameB = isRecord(b) && typeof b['name'] === 'string' ? b['name'] : '';
  return compareCodeUnits(nameA, nameB);
}

function sortTableArrays(storage: Json): Json {
  if (!isRecord(storage)) return storage;
  const namespaces = storage['namespaces'];
  if (!isRecord(namespaces)) return storage;
  const sortedNamespaces: JsonRecord = {};
  for (const [namespaceId, namespace] of Object.entries(namespaces)) {
    const entries = isRecord(namespace) ? namespace['entries'] : undefined;
    const tables = isRecord(entries) ? entries['table'] : undefined;
    if (!isRecord(namespace) || !isRecord(entries) || !isRecord(tables)) {
      sortedNamespaces[namespaceId] = namespace;
      continue;
    }
    const sortedTables: JsonRecord = {};
    for (const [tableName, table] of Object.entries(tables)) {
      if (!isRecord(table)) {
        sortedTables[tableName] = table;
        continue;
      }
      const sortedTable: JsonRecord = { ...table };
      for (const key of ['checks', 'indexes', 'uniques']) {
        const list = table[key];
        if (Array.isArray(list)) sortedTable[key] = [...list].sort(compareByName);
      }
      sortedTables[tableName] = sortedTable;
    }
    sortedNamespaces[namespaceId] = { ...namespace, entries: { ...entries, table: sortedTables } };
  }
  return { ...storage, namespaces: sortedNamespaces };
}

function orderTopLevel(value: JsonRecord): JsonRecord {
  const ordered: JsonRecord = {};
  const remaining = new Set(Object.keys(value));
  for (const key of TOP_LEVEL_ORDER) {
    const child = value[key];
    if (child !== undefined) {
      ordered[key] = child;
      remaining.delete(key);
    }
  }
  for (const key of [...remaining].sort(compareCodeUnits)) {
    const child = value[key];
    if (child !== undefined) ordered[key] = child;
  }
  return ordered;
}

function omitNamespaceKinds(storage: JsonRecord): JsonRecord {
  const namespaces = storage['namespaces'];
  if (!isRecord(namespaces)) return storage;
  const stripped: JsonRecord = {};
  for (const [namespaceId, namespace] of Object.entries(namespaces)) {
    if (isRecord(namespace)) {
      const { kind: _kind, ...rest } = namespace;
      stripped[namespaceId] = rest;
    } else {
      stripped[namespaceId] = namespace;
    }
  }
  return { ...storage, namespaces: stripped };
}

function computeStorageHash(contract: JsonRecord): string {
  const storage = isRecord(contract['storage']) ? contract['storage'] : {};
  const { storageHash: _published, ...withoutHash } = storage;
  const hashed: JsonRecord = {
    schemaVersion: '1',
    targetFamily: typeof contract['targetFamily'] === 'string' ? contract['targetFamily'] : '',
    target: typeof contract['target'] === 'string' ? contract['target'] : '',
    profileHash: '',
    roots: {},
    domain: { namespaces: {} },
    storage: omitNamespaceKinds(withoutHash),
    extensions: {},
    capabilities: {},
    meta: {},
  };
  const withoutDefaults = omitDefaults(hashed, []);
  if (!isRecord(withoutDefaults)) return '';
  const withSortedStorage = {
    ...withoutDefaults,
    storage: sortTableArrays(withoutDefaults['storage'] ?? {}),
  };
  const sorted = sortKeys(withSortedStorage);
  return isRecord(sorted) ? sha256(JSON.stringify(orderTopLevel(sorted), null, 2)) : '';
}

function computeMigrationHash(metadata: JsonRecord, ops: Json): string {
  const { migrationHash: _migrationHash, ...withoutHash } = metadata;
  const parts = [canonicalizeJson(withoutHash), canonicalizeJson(ops)].map(sha256);
  return sha256(canonicalizeJson(parts));
}

interface ProjectFiles {
  readonly json: readonly string[];
  readonly migrationJson: readonly string[];
  readonly refs: readonly string[];
  readonly migrationTs: readonly string[];
  readonly leftovers: readonly string[];
}

function isDirectory(path: string): boolean {
  try {
    return statSync(path).isDirectory();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

function isFile(path: string): boolean {
  try {
    return statSync(path).isFile();
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

/** A file, or a link to one: the script reads and writes through links to files. */
function isFileEntry(dir: string, entry: Dirent): boolean {
  return entry.isFile() || (entry.isSymbolicLink() && isFile(join(dir, entry.name)));
}

/** A file the script reads, by the path it was reached through: its own path rather than a link's. */
interface FoundFile {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly linked: boolean;
  readonly inMigrationPackage: boolean;
}

function listFiles(root: string): ProjectFiles {
  const leftovers: string[] = [];
  const visited = new Set<string>();
  const found = new Map<string, FoundFile>();
  const visit = (dir: string): void => {
    const realDir = realpathSync(dir);
    if (visited.has(realDir)) return;
    visited.add(realDir);
    const entries = readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).sort((a, b) =>
      compareCodeUnits(a.name, b.name),
    );
    const inMigrationPackage = entries.some(
      (entry) => entry.name === 'migration.json' && isFileEntry(dir, entry),
    );
    for (const entry of entries) {
      const path = join(dir, entry.name);
      if (entry.name.endsWith(TEMPORARY_SUFFIX)) {
        leftovers.push(path);
        continue;
      }
      if (entry.isDirectory() || (entry.isSymbolicLink() && isDirectory(path))) {
        if (!SKIPPED_DIRECTORIES.has(entry.name) && !entry.name.startsWith('.')) visit(path);
        continue;
      }
      if (!isFileEntry(dir, entry)) continue;
      const realFile = realpathSync(path);
      const linked = entry.isSymbolicLink();
      const known = found.get(realFile);
      if (known === undefined || (known.linked && !linked))
        found.set(realFile, { path, linked, inMigrationPackage });
    }
  };
  visit(root);
  const files = [...found.values()];
  const named = (test: (file: FoundFile, name: string) => boolean): string[] =>
    files.filter((file) => test(file, basename(file.path))).map((file) => file.path);
  return {
    json: named((_file, name) => name.endsWith('.json')),
    migrationJson: named((_file, name) => name === 'migration.json'),
    refs: named((file, name) => name.endsWith('.json') && basename(dirname(file.path)) === 'refs'),
    migrationTs: named((file, name) => name === 'migration.ts' && file.inMigrationPackage),
    leftovers,
  };
}

function isSnapshotContract(path: string): boolean {
  const snapshotDir = dirname(path);
  return (
    basename(path) === 'contract.json' &&
    HASH.test(basename(snapshotDir)) &&
    basename(dirname(snapshotDir)) === 'snapshots'
  );
}

function mapRecord(value: Json, map: (key: string, child: Json) => Json): Json {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return value;
  const result: JsonRecord = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(value)) result[key] = map(key, child);
  return result;
}

function mapEntries(
  value: Json,
  path: readonly string[],
  patterns: readonly (readonly PathSegment[])[],
  rewrite: (entry: JsonRecord, path: readonly string[]) => JsonRecord,
): Json {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return value;
  if (patterns.some((pattern) => matchesPath(path, pattern))) return rewrite(value, path);
  const leadsToEntry = patterns.some(
    (pattern) => path.length < pattern.length && matchesPath(path, pattern.slice(0, path.length)),
  );
  return leadsToEntry
    ? mapRecord(value, (key, child) => mapEntries(child, [...path, key], patterns, rewrite))
    : value;
}

function mapContractEntries(
  contract: JsonRecord,
  patterns: readonly (readonly PathSegment[])[],
  rewrite: (entry: JsonRecord, path: readonly string[]) => JsonRecord,
): JsonRecord {
  const result: JsonRecord = {};
  for (const [key, child] of Object.entries(contract))
    result[key] = mapEntries(child, [key], patterns, rewrite);
  return result;
}

function enumKey(namespaceId: string, name: string): string {
  return `${namespaceId}\u0000${name}`;
}

function withStorageHash(contract: JsonRecord, hash: string): JsonRecord {
  const storage = isRecord(contract['storage']) ? contract['storage'] : {};
  return { ...contract, storage: { ...storage, storageHash: hash } };
}

function emittedForm(contract: JsonRecord, original: string): string {
  const { _generated: generated, ...rest } = contract;
  const sorted = sortKeys(rest);
  const ordered = isRecord(sorted) ? orderTopLevel(sorted) : {};
  if (generated !== undefined) ordered['_generated'] = generated;
  return `${JSON.stringify(ordered, null, 2)}${original.endsWith('\n') ? '\n' : ''}`;
}

function snapshotForm(contract: JsonRecord): string {
  return `${canonicalizeJson(contract)}\n`;
}

interface Block {
  readonly start: number;
  end: number;
  readonly label: string;
  readonly parent: Block | undefined;
}

function scanBlocks(text: string): Block[] {
  const blocks: Block[] = [];
  const open: Block[] = [];
  let quote: string | undefined;
  for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index++) {
    const char = text[index];
    if (quote !== undefined) {
      if (char === '\\') index++;
      else if (char === quote) quote = undefined;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === "'" || char === '"' || char === '`') {
      quote = char;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === '{') {
      const key =
        /(?:readonly\s+)?([\p{ID_Start}_$][\p{ID_Continue}$]*|'[^']*'|"[^"]*")\s*\??\s*:\s*$/u.exec(
          text.slice(Math.max(0, index - 200), index),
        );
      const block: Block = {
        start: index,
        end: text.length,
        label: key?.[1]?.replace(/^['"]|['"]$/g, '') ?? '',
        parent: open.at(-1),
      };
      open.push(block);
      blocks.push(block);
    } else if (char === '}') {
      const block = open.pop();
      if (block !== undefined) block.end = index;
    }
  }
  return blocks;
}

function innermostBlock(blocks: readonly Block[], position: number): Block | undefined {
  let found: Block | undefined;
  for (const block of blocks) {
    if (
      block.start < position &&
      position < block.end &&
      (found === undefined || block.start > found.start)
    )
      found = block;
  }
  return found;
}

function isColumnBlock(block: Block): boolean {
  return block.parent?.label === 'columns';
}

function isStorageTypeBlock(blocks: readonly Block[], block: Block): boolean {
  const types = block.parent;
  return (
    types?.label === 'types' &&
    blocks.some((other) => other.parent === types.parent && other.label === 'namespaces')
  );
}

function isInColumnDefault(block: Block): boolean {
  for (let ancestor = block.parent; ancestor !== undefined; ancestor = ancestor.parent)
    if (
      ancestor.label === 'default' &&
      ancestor.parent !== undefined &&
      isColumnBlock(ancestor.parent)
    )
      return true;
  return false;
}

function holdsDataType(blocks: readonly Block[], block: Block): boolean {
  return (isColumnBlock(block) || isStorageTypeBlock(blocks, block)) && !isInColumnDefault(block);
}

function genericArgumentEnd(text: string, start: number): number {
  let depth = 0;
  let quote: string | undefined;
  for (let index = start; index < text.length; index++) {
    const char = text[index];
    if (quote !== undefined) {
      if (char === '\\') index++;
      else if (char === quote) quote = undefined;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === "'" || char === '"' || char === '`') quote = char;
    else if (char === '{' || char === '[' || char === '(' || char === '<') depth++;
    else if (char === '}' || char === ']' || char === ')') depth--;
    else if (char === '>') {
      if (depth === 0) return index;
      depth--;
    }
  }
  return text.length;
}

function memberOf(
  text: string,
  blocks: readonly Block[],
  block: Block,
  name: string,
): string | undefined {
  const pattern = new RegExp(`readonly ${name}: (['"])((?:\\\\.|(?!\\1).)*)\\1`, 'g');
  for (const member of text.slice(block.start, block.end).matchAll(pattern)) {
    if (innermostBlock(blocks, block.start + member.index) === block) return member[2];
  }
  return undefined;
}

/** The end of the type literal that starts at `start`: the first `;`, `,` or closing bracket outside it. */
function literalEnd(text: string, start: number): number {
  let depth = 0;
  let quote: string | undefined;
  for (let index = start; index < text.length; index++) {
    const char = text[index];
    if (quote !== undefined) {
      if (char === '\\') index++;
      else if (char === quote) quote = undefined;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === "'" || char === '"' || char === '`') quote = char;
    else if (char === '{' || char === '[' || char === '(' || char === '<') depth++;
    else if (char === '}' || char === ']' || char === ')' || char === '>') {
      if (depth === 0) return index;
      depth--;
    } else if ((char === ';' || char === ',') && depth === 0) return index;
  }
  return text.length;
}

function bracketEnd(text: string, open: number): number {
  let depth = 0;
  let quote: string | undefined;
  for (let index = open; index < text.length; index++) {
    const char = text[index];
    if (quote !== undefined) {
      if (char === '\\') index++;
      else if (char === quote) quote = undefined;
      continue;
    }
    if (char === "'" || char === '"' || char === '`') quote = char;
    else if (char === '[' || char === '{' || char === '(') depth++;
    else if (char === ']' || char === '}' || char === ')') {
      depth--;
      if (depth === 0) return index + 1;
    }
  }
  return text.length;
}

function replaceQuotedHashes(text: string, hashes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): string {
  return text.replace(/"([0-9a-f]{64})"/g, (match: string, hash: string) => {
    const next = hashes.get(hash);
    return next === undefined ? match : `"${next}"`;
  });
}

function readDirectory(dir: string): Map<string, string> {
  const files = new Map<string, string>();
  if (!existsSync(dir)) return files;
  for (const entry of readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }))
    if (isFileEntry(dir, entry) && !entry.name.endsWith(TEMPORARY_SUFFIX))
      files.set(entry.name, readFileSync(join(dir, entry.name), 'utf8'));
  return files;
}

function sameFiles(a: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, b: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): boolean {
  return a.size === b.size && [...a].every(([name, content]) => b.get(name) === content);
}

function temporaryPath(path: string): string {
  return join(dirname(path), `.${basename(path)}${TEMPORARY_SUFFIX}`);
}

function writeWithModeOf(path: string, text: string, modeSource: string): void {
  writeFileSync(path, text);
  if (existsSync(modeSource)) chmodSync(path, statSync(modeSource).mode & 0o7777);
}

function writeFile(path: string, text: string): void {
  const target = realpathSync(path);
  const temporary = temporaryPath(target);
  writeWithModeOf(temporary, text, target);
  renameSync(temporary, target);
}

function writeDirectory(dir: string, files: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, sourceDir: string): void {
  const temporary = temporaryPath(dir);
  mkdirSync(temporary);
  for (const [name, text] of files)
    writeWithModeOf(join(temporary, name), text, join(sourceDir, name));
  renameSync(temporary, dir);
}

function removeDirectory(dir: string): void {
  const temporary = temporaryPath(dir);
  renameSync(dir, temporary);
  rmSync(temporary, { recursive: true, force: true });
}

function count(amount: number, singular: string, plural: string): string {
  return `${amount} ${amount === 1 ? singular : plural}`;
}

function summary(
  root: string,
  contractsFound: number,
  files: number,
  directories: number,
  hashes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
): readonly string[] {
  if (contractsFound === 0) return [`No SQLite contract was found under ${root}; nothing changed.`];
  if (files === 0 && directories === 0)
    return ['The project is already in the new form; nothing changed.'];
  const renamed = count(directories, 'snapshot directory', 'snapshot directories');
  const changes = `Rewrote ${count(files, 'file', 'files')} and renamed ${renamed}.`;
  if (hashes.size === 0) return [changes];
  return [
    `${changes} Storage hashes changed (old -> new):`,
    ...[...hashes]
      .sort(([a], [b]) => compareCodeUnits(a, b))
      .map(([oldHash, newHash]) => `  ${oldHash} -> ${newHash}`),
  ];
}

/** The text `sqlite/datetime` stores for an instant the previous release stored: three fraction digits, always. */
function storedDatetime(value: Json): Json {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return value;
  const match = UTC_INSTANT.exec(value);
  return match === null ? value : `${match[1]}.${(match[2] ?? '').padEnd(3, '0')}Z`;
}

function storedDatetimes(value: Json): Json {
  return Array.isArray(value) ? value.map(storedDatetime) : storedDatetime(value);
}

interface Rewrite {
  readonly contract: JsonRecord;
  readonly changed: boolean;
  readonly datetimeEnums: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

/**
 * A `sqlite/datetime@1` enum's members in the domain, and the storage value set its columns name,
 * hold instants, so they are written as `sqlite/datetime` stores them too.
 */
function rewriteDatetimeEnums(contract: JsonRecord): Rewrite {
  const datetimeEnums = new Set<string>();
  let changed = false;
  const rewritten = (values: readonly Json[]): Json[] => {
    const next = values.map(storedDatetime);
    if (canonicalizeJson(next) !== canonicalizeJson([...values])) changed = true;
    return next;
  };

  const domain = mapRecord(contract['domain'] ?? null, (key, namespaces) =>
    key !== 'namespaces'
      ? namespaces
      : mapRecord(namespaces, (namespaceId, namespace) =>
          mapRecord(namespace, (kind, enums) =>
            kind !== 'enum'
              ? enums
              : mapRecord(enums, (name, enumType) => {
                  const members = isRecord(enumType) ? enumType['members'] : undefined;
                  if (
                    !isRecord(enumType) ||
                    enumType['codecId'] !== DATETIME_CODEC ||
                    !Array.isArray(members)
                  )
                    return enumType;
                  datetimeEnums.add(enumKey(namespaceId, name));
                  const values = rewritten(
                    members.map((member) => (isRecord(member) ? (member['value'] ?? null) : null)),
                  );
                  return {
                    ...enumType,
                    members: members.map((member, index) =>
                      isRecord(member) && member['value'] !== undefined
                        ? { ...member, value: values[index] ?? null }
                        : member,
                    ),
                  };
                }),
          ),
        ),
  );

  const storage = contract['storage'];
  const namespaces = isRecord(storage) ? storage['namespaces'] : undefined;
  for (const namespace of isRecord(namespaces) ? Object.values(namespaces) : []) {
    const entries = isRecord(namespace) ? namespace['entries'] : undefined;
    const tables = isRecord(entries) ? entries['table'] : undefined;
    for (const table of isRecord(tables) ? Object.values(tables) : []) {
      const columns = isRecord(table) ? table['columns'] : undefined;
      for (const column of isRecord(columns) ? Object.values(columns) : []) {
        const valueSet = isRecord(column) ? column['valueSet'] : undefined;
        if (
          isRecord(column) &&
          column['codecId'] === DATETIME_CODEC &&
          isRecord(valueSet) &&
          typeof valueSet['namespaceId'] === 'string' &&
          typeof valueSet['entityName'] === 'string'
        )
          datetimeEnums.add(enumKey(valueSet['namespaceId'], valueSet['entityName']));
      }
    }
  }

  const nextStorage = mapRecord(storage ?? null, (key, storageNamespaces) =>
    key !== 'namespaces'
      ? storageNamespaces
      : mapRecord(storageNamespaces, (namespaceId, namespace) =>
          mapRecord(namespace, (namespaceKey, entries) =>
            namespaceKey !== 'entries'
              ? entries
              : mapRecord(entries, (entryKind, valueSets) =>
                  entryKind !== 'valueSet'
                    ? valueSets
                    : mapRecord(valueSets, (name, valueSet) => {
                        const values = isRecord(valueSet) ? valueSet['values'] : undefined;
                        if (
                          !datetimeEnums.has(enumKey(namespaceId, name)) ||
                          !isRecord(valueSet) ||
                          !Array.isArray(values)
                        )
                          return valueSet;
                        return { ...valueSet, values: rewritten(values) };
                      }),
                ),
          ),
        ),
  );

  return {
    contract: {
      ...contract,
      ...(contract['domain'] === undefined ? {} : { domain }),
      ...(storage === undefined ? {} : { storage: nextStorage }),
    },
    changed,
    datetimeEnums,
  };
}

function rewriteContract(contract: JsonRecord): Rewrite {
  if (contract['target'] !== 'sqlite')
    return { contract, changed: false, datetimeEnums: new Set() };
  let changed = false;
  const rewriteEntry = (entry: JsonRecord): JsonRecord => {
    const codecId = entry['codecId'];
    const dataType = typeof codecId === 'string' ? DATA_TYPES[codecId] : undefined;
    if (dataType === undefined) return entry;
    let next = entry;
    if (entry['dataType'] === PREVIOUS_DATA_TYPE) {
      next = { ...next, dataType };
      changed = true;
    }
    const columnDefault = next['default'];
    if (
      codecId === DATETIME_CODEC &&
      isRecord(columnDefault) &&
      columnDefault['kind'] === 'literal' &&
      columnDefault['value'] !== undefined
    ) {
      const value = storedDatetimes(columnDefault['value']);
      if (canonicalizeJson(value) !== canonicalizeJson(columnDefault['value'])) {
        next = { ...next, default: { ...columnDefault, value } };
        changed = true;
      }
    }
    return next;
  };
  const enums = rewriteDatetimeEnums(mapContractEntries(contract, DATA_TYPE_PATHS, rewriteEntry));
  return {
    contract: enums.contract,
    changed: changed || enums.changed,
    datetimeEnums: enums.datetimeEnums,
  };
}

interface Edit {
  readonly start: number;
  readonly end: number;
  readonly text: string;
}

/** The quoted instants between `start` and `end`, each written as `sqlite/datetime` stores it. */
function datetimeEdits(text: string, start: number, end: number): Edit[] {
  const edits: Edit[] = [];
  for (const match of text.slice(start, end).matchAll(/(['"])((?:\\.|(?!\1).)*)\1/g)) {
    const value = match[2] ?? '';
    const stored = storedDatetime(value);
    if (stored === value) continue;
    const at = start + match.index + 1;
    edits.push({ start: at, end: at + value.length, text: String(stored) });
  }
  return edits;
}

function rewriteDts(
  text: string,
  datetimeEnums: ReadonlySet<string>,
  hashes: ReadonlyMap<string, string>,
): string {
  const blocks = scanBlocks(text);
  const edits: Edit[] = [];

  for (const match of text.matchAll(/readonly dataType: (['"])sqlite\/text\1/g)) {
    const block = innermostBlock(blocks, match.index);
    if (block === undefined || !holdsDataType(blocks, block)) continue;
    const codecId = memberOf(text, blocks, block, 'codecId');
    const dataType = codecId === undefined ? undefined : DATA_TYPES[codecId];
    if (dataType === undefined) continue;
    const quote = match[1] ?? "'";
    edits.push({
      start: match.index,
      end: match.index + match[0].length,
      text: `readonly dataType: ${quote}${dataType}${quote}`,
    });
  }

  for (const match of text.matchAll(/DefaultLiteralValue<\s*(['"])sqlite\/datetime@1\1\s*,\s*/g)) {
    const start = match.index + match[0].length;
    edits.push(...datetimeEdits(text, start, genericArgumentEnd(text, start)));
  }

  for (const match of text.matchAll(/readonly values: readonly \[/g)) {
    const valueSet = innermostBlock(blocks, match.index);
    const kind = valueSet?.parent;
    const namespace = kind?.parent?.parent;
    if (
      valueSet === undefined ||
      kind?.label !== 'valueSet' ||
      kind.parent?.label !== 'entries' ||
      namespace === undefined ||
      !datetimeEnums.has(enumKey(namespace.label, valueSet.label))
    )
      continue;
    const open = match.index + match[0].length - 1;
    edits.push(...datetimeEdits(text, open, bracketEnd(text, open)));
  }

  for (const match of text.matchAll(/readonly value: /g)) {
    const member = innermostBlock(blocks, match.index);
    const enumType = member?.parent;
    const namespace = enumType?.parent?.parent;
    if (
      member === undefined ||
      member.label !== '' ||
      enumType?.parent?.label !== 'enum' ||
      namespace === undefined ||
      !datetimeEnums.has(enumKey(namespace.label, enumType.label))
    )
      continue;
    const start = match.index + match[0].length;
    edits.push(...datetimeEdits(text, start, literalEnd(text, start)));
  }

  for (const match of text.matchAll(/(['"])([0-9a-f]{64})\1/g)) {
    const hash = match[2];
    const next = hash === undefined ? undefined : hashes.get(hash);
    if (next === undefined) continue;
    edits.push({
      start: match.index,
      end: match.index + match[0].length,
      text: `${match[1]}${next}${match[1]}`,
    });
  }

  let result = text;
  for (const edit of edits.sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start))
    result = `${result.slice(0, edit.start)}${edit.text}${result.slice(edit.end)}`;
  return result;
}

interface ContractPlan {
  readonly path: string;
  readonly snapshot: boolean;
  readonly oldHash: string;
  readonly newHash: string;
  readonly content: string;
  readonly datetimeEnums: ReadonlySet<string>;
}

const JSON_FILES_THAT_MUST_PARSE = new Set(['contract.json', 'migration.json']);

function parseRoot(args: readonly string[]): { readonly root: string; readonly errors: string[] } {
  const errors = args.filter((arg) => arg.startsWith('-')).map((arg) => `${arg}: unknown option`);
  const positional = args.filter((arg) => !arg.startsWith('-'));
  if (positional.length > 1) errors.push(`expected one project root, got ${positional.length}`);
  const root = resolve(positional[0] ?? process.cwd());
  if (errors.length === 0 && !isDirectory(root)) errors.push(`${root}: not a directory`);
  if (errors.length > 0) errors.push('Usage: node data-type-values.ts [project-root]');
  return { root, errors };
}

function main({
  root,
  errors,
}: {
  readonly root: string;
  readonly errors: readonly string[];
}): number {
  if (errors.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`${errors.join('\n')}\n`);
    return 1;
  }
  const display = (path: string): string => relative(root, path).split(sep).join('/');
  const files = listFiles(root);
  const plans: ContractPlan[] = [];
  const notices: string[] = [];
  const stops: string[] = [];
  let contractsFound = 0;

  for (const path of files.json) {
    const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    const contract = parseJson(text);
    if (
      contract === undefined &&
      (JSON_FILES_THAT_MUST_PARSE.has(basename(path)) || files.refs.includes(path))
    ) {
      stops.push(`${display(path)}: not valid JSON`);
      continue;
    }
    if (
      !isRecord(contract) ||
      contract['targetFamily'] !== 'sql' ||
      contract['target'] !== 'sqlite' ||
      !isRecord(contract['storage'])
    )
      continue;
    contractsFound++;
    const snapshot = isSnapshotContract(path);
    const stored = contract['storage']['storageHash'];
    const oldHash = snapshot ? basename(dirname(path)) : typeof stored === 'string' ? stored : '';
    const rewrite = rewriteContract(contract);
    if (!rewrite.changed) continue;
    if (computeStorageHash(contract) !== oldHash)
      notices.push(`${display(path)}: stored hash did not recompute; rehashed from content`);
    const newHash = computeStorageHash(rewrite.contract);
    const contractWithHash = withStorageHash(rewrite.contract, newHash);
    plans.push({
      path,
      snapshot,
      oldHash,
      newHash,
      content: snapshot ? snapshotForm(contractWithHash) : emittedForm(contractWithHash, text),
      datetimeEnums: rewrite.datetimeEnums,
    });
  }

  const hashes = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const plan of [...plans].sort((a, b) => Number(b.snapshot) - Number(a.snapshot)))
    if (plan.oldHash !== plan.newHash && !hashes.has(plan.oldHash))
      hashes.set(plan.oldHash, plan.newHash);

  const newDirectories = new Map<string, Map<string, string>>();
  const directorySources = new Map<string, string>();
  const sourceDirectories = new Set<string>();
  const removals = new Set<string>();
  const snapshotRewrites: [string, string][] = [];
  const referenceWrites = new Map<string, string>();
  const contractWrites = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const plan of plans) {
    const dtsPath = plan.snapshot
      ? join(dirname(plan.path), 'contract.d.ts')
      : `${plan.path.slice(0, -'.json'.length)}.d.ts`;
    const dtsHashes = plan.snapshot ? hashes : new Map([...hashes, [plan.oldHash, plan.newHash]]);
    const dts = existsSync(dtsPath)
      ? rewriteDts(readFileSync(dtsPath, 'utf8'), plan.datetimeEnums, dtsHashes)
      : undefined;
    if (!plan.snapshot) {
      if (dts !== undefined) referenceWrites.set(dtsPath, dts);
      contractWrites.set(plan.path, plan.content);
      continue;
    }
    const oldDir = dirname(plan.path);
    const newDir = join(dirname(oldDir), plan.newHash);
    sourceDirectories.add(oldDir);
    if (newDir === oldDir) {
      if (dts !== undefined) snapshotRewrites.push([dtsPath, dts]);
      snapshotRewrites.push([plan.path, plan.content]);
      continue;
    }
    removals.add(oldDir);
    const content = readDirectory(oldDir);
    content.set('contract.json', plan.content);
    if (dts !== undefined) content.set('contract.d.ts', dts);
    const planned = newDirectories.get(newDir);
    if (planned !== undefined && !sameFiles(planned, content)) {
      stops.push(`${display(newDir)}: snapshot directory already exists with different content`);
      continue;
    }
    newDirectories.set(newDir, content);
    directorySources.set(newDir, oldDir);
  }
  for (const [dir, content] of newDirectories) {
    if (sourceDirectories.has(dir) || !existsSync(dir)) continue;
    if (sameFiles(readDirectory(dir), content)) newDirectories.delete(dir);
    else stops.push(`${display(dir)}: snapshot directory already exists with different content`);
  }

  for (const path of files.migrationJson) {
    const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    const metadata = parseJson(text);
    if (!isRecord(metadata)) continue;
    const from = metadata['from'];
    const to = metadata['to'];
    const nextFrom = typeof from === 'string' ? (hashes.get(from) ?? from) : from;
    const nextTo = typeof to === 'string' ? (hashes.get(to) ?? to) : to;
    if (nextFrom === from && nextTo === to) continue;
    const opsPath = join(dirname(path), 'ops.json');
    const ops = existsSync(opsPath) ? parseJson(readFileSync(opsPath, 'utf8')) : undefined;
    if (existsSync(opsPath) && ops === undefined) {
      stops.push(`${display(opsPath)}: not valid JSON`);
      continue;
    }
    const oldMigrationHash = metadata['migrationHash'];
    let next = replaceQuotedHashes(text, hashes);
    if (
      ops !== undefined &&
      typeof oldMigrationHash === 'string' &&
      nextFrom !== undefined &&
      nextTo !== undefined
    ) {
      const migrationHash = computeMigrationHash({ ...metadata, from: nextFrom, to: nextTo }, ops);
      next = next.replace(`"${oldMigrationHash}"`, `"${migrationHash}"`);
    }
    referenceWrites.set(path, next);
  }
  for (const path of files.refs) {
    const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    const next = replaceQuotedHashes(text, hashes);
    if (next !== text) referenceWrites.set(path, next);
  }
  for (const path of files.migrationTs) {
    const text = readFileSync(path, 'utf8');
    const next = text.replace(
      /(?<![0-9a-f])[0-9a-f]{64}(?![0-9a-f])/g,
      (hash: string) => hashes.get(hash) ?? hash,
    );
    if (next !== text) referenceWrites.set(path, next);
  }

  if (stops.length > 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`${[...new Set(stops)].join('\n')}\n`);
    return 1;
  }

  try {
    for (const path of files.leftovers) rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true });
    for (const [dir, content] of newDirectories)
      writeDirectory(dir, content, directorySources.get(dir) ?? dir);
    for (const [path, text] of snapshotRewrites) writeFile(path, text);
    for (const [path, text] of referenceWrites) writeFile(path, text);
    for (const [path, text] of contractWrites) writeFile(path, text);
    for (const dir of removals) removeDirectory(dir);
  } catch (error) {
    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
    process.stderr.write(
      `${message}; the upgrade stopped partway, run the script again to finish it\n`,
    );
    return 1;
  }
  const rewrittenFiles = snapshotRewrites.length + referenceWrites.size + contractWrites.size;
  const lines = [
    ...notices,
    ...summary(root, contractsFound, rewrittenFiles, removals.size, hashes),
  ];
  process.stdout.write(`${lines.join('\n')}\n`);
  return 0;
}

process.exitCode = main(parseRoot(process.argv.slice(2)));
