````typescript
import {
  Body,
  Controller,
  Delete,
  Get,
  HttpCode,
  Param,
  ParseIntPipe,
  Patch,
  Post,
  Query,
} from '@nestjs/common';

import {
  ResourcesService,
  type CreateBatchInput,
  type CreateFeedstockInput,
  type CreateSupplierInput,
  type UpdateFeedstockInput,
  type UpdateSupplierInput,
} from './resources.service.js';

@Controller('api')
export class ResourcesController {
  constructor(private readonly resources: ResourcesService) {}

  // ── Suppliers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Get('suppliers')
  listSuppliers() {
    return this.resources.listSuppliers();
  }

  @Post('suppliers')
  createSupplier(@Body() body: CreateSupplierInput) {
    return this.resources.createSupplier(body);
  }

  @Get('suppliers/:id')
  getSupplier(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.resources.getSupplier(id);
  }

  @Patch('suppliers/:id')
  updateSupplier(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() body: UpdateSupplierInput,
  ) {
    return this.resources.updateSupplier(id, body);
  }

  @Delete('suppliers/:id')
  @HttpCode(204)
  deleteSupplier(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.resources.deleteSupplier(id);
  }

  // ── Feedstocks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Get('feedstocks')
  listFeedstocks(@Query('category') category?: string) {
    return this.resources.listFeedstocks(category);
  }

  @Get('feedstocks/:id')
  getFeedstock(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.resources.getFeedstock(id);
  }

  @Post('feedstocks')
  createFeedstock(@Body() body: CreateFeedstockInput) {
    return this.resources.createFeedstock(body);
  }

  @Patch('feedstocks/:id')
  updateFeedstock(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() body: UpdateFeedstockInput,
  ) {
    return this.resources.updateFeedstock(id, body);
  }

  @Delete('feedstocks/:id')
  @HttpCode(204)
  deleteFeedstock(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.resources.deleteFeedstock(id);
  }

  // ── Batches ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Get('batches')
  listBatches(
    @Query('supplierId') supplierId?: string,
    @Query('feedstockId') feedstockId?: string,
  ) {
    return this.resources.listBatches(
      supplierId ? parseInt(supplierId, 10) : undefined,
      feedstockId ? parseInt(feedstockId, 10) : undefined,
    );
  }

  @Get('batches/:id')
  getBatch(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.resources.getBatch(id);
  }

  @Post('batches')
  createBatch(@Body() body: CreateBatchInput) {
    return this.resources.createBatch(body);
  }

  @Patch('batches/:id')
  updateBatch(
    @Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number,
    @Body() body: Partial<CreateBatchInput>,
  ) {
    return this.resources.updateBatch(id, body);
  }

  @Delete('batches/:id')
  @HttpCode(204)
  deleteBatch(@Param('id', ParseIntPipe) id: number) {
    return this.resources.deleteBatch(id);
  }

  // ── Dashboard stats ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  @Get('stats')
  getStats() {
    return this.resources.getStats();
  }
}
````

````typescript
import {
  BadRequestException,
  Injectable,
  NotFoundException,
} from '@nestjs/common';
import { db } from '../prisma/db.js';

export type CreateSupplierInput = {
  name: string;
  siteName: string;
  county: string;
  town?: string;
};

export type UpdateSupplierInput = Partial<CreateSupplierInput>;

export type CreateFeedstockInput = {
  name: string;
  category: string;
  description?: string;
};

export type UpdateFeedstockInput = Partial<CreateFeedstockInput>;

export type CreateBatchInput = {
  batchCode: string;
  supplierId: number;
  feedstockId: number;
  quantity: number;
  quantityUnit: string;
  collectionDate: string;
  notes?: string;
};

@Injectable()
export class ResourcesService {
  // ── Suppliers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async listSuppliers() {
    return db.orm.public.Supplier.include('batches').all();
  }

  async getSupplier(id: number) {
    const supplier = await db.orm.public.Supplier
      .where({ id })
      .include('batches')
      .first();
    if (!supplier) throw new NotFoundException('Supplier not found');
    return supplier;
  }

  async createSupplier(input: CreateSupplierInput) {
    if (!input.name?.trim() || !input.siteName?.trim() || !input.county?.trim()) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Name, site name and county are required');
    }
    return db.orm.public.Supplier.create({
      name: input.name.trim(),
      siteName: input.siteName.trim(),
      county: input.county.trim(),
      town: input.town?.trim() || null,
    });
  }

  async updateSupplier(id: number, input: UpdateSupplierInput) {
    const existing = await db.orm.public.Supplier.where({ id }).first();
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Supplier not found');
    const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (input.name !== undefined) patch.name = input.name.trim();
    if (input.siteName !== undefined) patch.siteName = input.siteName.trim();
    if (input.county !== undefined) patch.county = input.county.trim();
    if (input.town !== undefined) patch.town = input.town?.trim() || null;
    if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0)
      throw new BadRequestException('No fields to update');
    return db.orm.public.Supplier.where({ id }).update(patch);
  }

  async deleteSupplier(id: number) {
    const existing = await db.orm.public.Supplier.where({ id }).first();
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Supplier not found');
    await db.orm.public.Supplier.where({ id }).delete();
  }

  // ── Feedstocks ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async listFeedstocks(category?: string) {
    const q = db.orm.public.Feedstock.include('batches');
    if (category) return q.where({ category }).all();
    return q.all();
  }

  async getFeedstock(id: number) {
    const feedstock = await db.orm.public.Feedstock
      .where({ id })
      .include('batches')
      .first();
    if (!feedstock) throw new NotFoundException('Feedstock not found');
    return feedstock;
  }

  async createFeedstock(input: CreateFeedstockInput) {
    if (!input.name?.trim() || !input.category?.trim()) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Name and category are required');
    }
    return db.orm.public.Feedstock.create({
      name: input.name.trim(),
      category: input.category.trim(),
      description: input.description?.trim() || null,
    });
  }

  async updateFeedstock(id: number, input: UpdateFeedstockInput) {
    const existing = await db.orm.public.Feedstock.where({ id }).first();
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Feedstock not found');
    const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (input.name !== undefined) patch.name = input.name.trim();
    if (input.category !== undefined) patch.category = input.category.trim();
    if (input.description !== undefined)
      patch.description = input.description?.trim() || null;
    if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0)
      throw new BadRequestException('No fields to update');
    return db.orm.public.Feedstock.where({ id }).update(patch);
  }

  async deleteFeedstock(id: number) {
    const existing = await db.orm.public.Feedstock.where({ id }).first();
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Feedstock not found');
    await db.orm.public.Feedstock.where({ id }).delete();
  }

  // ── Batches ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async listBatches(supplierId?: number, feedstockId?: number) {
    let q = db.orm.public.Batch.include('supplier').include('feedstock');
    if (supplierId) q = q.where({ supplierId });
    if (feedstockId) q = q.where({ feedstockId });
    return q.all();
  }

  async getBatch(id: number) {
    const batch = await db.orm.public.Batch
      .where({ id })
      .include('supplier')
      .include('feedstock')
      .first();
    if (!batch) throw new NotFoundException('Batch not found');
    return batch;
  }

  async createBatch(input: CreateBatchInput) {
    const date = new Date(input.collectionDate);
    if (
      !input.batchCode?.trim() ||
      !Number.isInteger(input.supplierId) ||
      !Number.isInteger(input.feedstockId) ||
      !Number.isFinite(input.quantity) ||
      input.quantity <= 0 ||
      !input.quantityUnit?.trim() ||
      !input.collectionDate ||
      Number.isNaN(date.getTime())
    ) {
      throw new BadRequestException('Invalid batch details');
    }
    // Verify FK existence
    const [supplier, feedstock] = await Promise.all([
      db.orm.public.Supplier.where({ id: input.supplierId }).first(),
      db.orm.public.Feedstock.where({ id: input.feedstockId }).first(),
    ]);
    if (!supplier) throw new BadRequestException('Supplier not found');
    if (!feedstock) throw new BadRequestException('Feedstock not found');

    return db.orm.public.Batch.create({
      batchCode: input.batchCode.trim(),
      supplierId: input.supplierId,
      feedstockId: input.feedstockId,
      quantity: input.quantity,
      quantityUnit: input.quantityUnit.trim(),
      collectionDate: date,
      notes: input.notes?.trim() || null,
    });
  }

  async updateBatch(id: number, input: Partial<CreateBatchInput>) {
    const existing = await db.orm.public.Batch.where({ id }).first();
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Batch not found');
    const patch: Record<string, unknown> = {};
    if (input.batchCode !== undefined) patch.batchCode = input.batchCode.trim();
    if (input.supplierId !== undefined) patch.supplierId = input.supplierId;
    if (input.feedstockId !== undefined) patch.feedstockId = input.feedstockId;
    if (input.quantity !== undefined) patch.quantity = input.quantity;
    if (input.quantityUnit !== undefined)
      patch.quantityUnit = input.quantityUnit.trim();
    if (input.collectionDate !== undefined) {
      const d = new Date(input.collectionDate);
      if (Number.isNaN(d.getTime()))
        throw new BadRequestException('Invalid collectionDate');
      patch.collectionDate = d;
    }
    if (input.notes !== undefined) patch.notes = input.notes?.trim() || null;
    if (Object.keys(patch).length === 0)
      throw new BadRequestException('No fields to update');
    return db.orm.public.Batch.where({ id }).update(patch);
  }

  async deleteBatch(id: number) {
    const existing = await db.orm.public.Batch.where({ id }).first();
    if (!existing) throw new NotFoundException('Batch not found');
    await db.orm.public.Batch.where({ id }).delete();
  }

  // ── Dashboard stats ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  async getStats() {
    const [suppliers, feedstocks, batches] = await Promise.all([
      db.orm.public.Supplier.all(),
      db.orm.public.Feedstock.all(),
      db.orm.public.Batch.all(),
    ]);
    const recentBatches = [...batches]
      .sort(
        (a, b) =>
          new Date(b.collectionDate).getTime() -
          new Date(a.collectionDate).getTime(),
      )
      .slice(0, 5);
    return {
      supplierCount: suppliers.length,
      feedstockCount: feedstocks.length,
      batchCount: batches.length,
      recentBatches,
    };
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { AppModule } from './app.module.js';

async function bootstrap() {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);

  const defaultOrigins = ['http://localhost:3000'];
  const configuredOrigins = (process.env.CORS_ORIGIN ?? '')
    .split(',')
    .map((o) => o.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  app.enableCors({
    origin: configuredOrigins.length > 0 ? configuredOrigins : defaultOrigins,
  });

  await app.listen(process.env.PORT ?? 3001);
}

await bootstrap();
````

````markdown
# BIOPATH AI — TEAM PROJECT BOARD
**Project period:** 22–27 November 2026  
**Monday's objective:** Finalise our case studies and produce the research needed to begin implementation.

## 1. PROJECT DIRECTION

BIOPATH AI is a decision-support platform that evaluates how agricultural and food-processing by-products could be converted into useful protein products.

We aim to combine:
- Feedstock composition and nutritional information.
- Microbiological conversion pathways.
- Food and feed nutritional requirements.
- Safety considerations.
- Economic and logistical feasibility.
- Eventually, machine learning predictions where sufficient experimental data is available.

For the hackathon, we will focus on a small number of well-researched case studies rather than attempting to cover every possible agricultural by-product.

---

# 2. TEAM ROLES AND ASSIGNMENTS

## WAMBUA / CALVIN — PRODUCT LEAD & FRONTEND DEVELOPER

**Primary responsibility:** Product direction, coordination and frontend development.

### Tasks
- Define the core user journey and what the application should demonstrate.
- Build the React frontend.
- Design the feedstock input interface.
- Design the nutritional information and pathway comparison interfaces.
- Create the results/dashboard interface.
- Coordinate frontend-backend integration.
- Ensure the frontend reflects the actual scientific capabilities of the project.

### Monday deliverables
1. A basic frontend structure and proposed user flow.
2. A list of the information users should enter.
3. A proposed layout for displaying pathway comparisons.
4. Agreement with Jonah on the initial API requirements.

**Priority:** High

## JONAH — BACKEND & DATABASE DEVELOPER

**Primary responsibility:** Backend architecture, database design and API development using NestJS and PostgreSQL.

### Tasks
- Design the initial database structure.
- Identify the entities and relationships required by the project.
- Build the NestJS backend structure.
- Establish API contracts with the frontend developer.
- Implement endpoints for feedstocks, measurements and conversion pathways.
- Handle validation and data processing.
- Prepare the backend to receive structured scientific research.
- Investigate how the ML component could eventually integrate with the backend.

### Monday deliverables
1. Initial database entity and relationship proposal.
2. Proposed API endpoints and their expected inputs/outputs.
3. Basic NestJS project structure.
4. Agreement with Calvin on the data the frontend needs.
5. A structured data template for receiving research from the scientific team.

**Priority:** Critical

## FIDEL — MICROBIOLOGY & BIOCONVERSION RESEARCH LEAD

**Primary responsibility:** Investigating the biological processes through which agricultural by-products and other suitable nutrient sources could produce protein-rich biomass or other useful products.

### Research stream A: Agricultural by-product conversion

- Identify microorganisms capable of utilising the selected feedstock.
- Investigate possible fermentation and bioconversion pathways.
- Establish the conditions required by each pathway.
- Identify the expected products.
- Research experimentally reported yields and productivity.
- Identify biological limitations and potential hazards.
- Provide scientific references for all important claims.

### Research stream B: Spirulina investigation

Investigate the possibility of using Spirulina (*Arthrospira platensis* and related cultivated strains) as an alternative protein source.

Specifically:

1. Understand Spirulina cultivation and its nutritional requirements.
2. Investigate its potential as a human-food and animal-feed protein ingredient.
3. Research whether nutrients recovered from agricultural by-products or processing waste streams could support its cultivation.
4. Identify potential waste streams that could supply nitrogen, phosphorus and other nutrients.
5. Investigate the pretreatment or nutrient-recovery processes that would be required.
6. Research cultivation conditions, including light, temperature, pH and nutrient availability.
7. Find experimentally reported biomass productivity and protein content.
8. Investigate contamination, heavy-metal and other safety concerns.
9. Assess whether Spirulina cultivation could be a viable case study for BIOPATH AI.

**Important:** Distinguish between using agricultural waste directly as a microbial substrate and recovering nutrients from waste to cultivate Spirulina. These are different biological processes.

### Monday deliverables
1. At least two documented conversion pathways for the proposed primary feedstock, if sufficient evidence exists.
2. A separate Spirulina research brief.
3. A shortlist of possible case studies for the microbiology component.
4. Supporting research papers and experimental data.
5. A recommendation on which biological pathways are most suitable for the hackathon demonstration.

**Priority:** Critical

## ADIJA — FOOD SCIENCE RESEARCH: HUMAN FOOD

**Primary responsibility:** Investigating the nutritional quality and potential human-food applications of the resulting protein products.

### Tasks
- Research the nutritional composition of the proposed feedstocks.
- Investigate protein content and quality.
- Research amino acid composition and essential amino acid requirements.
- Investigate protein digestibility and bioavailability.
- Identify relevant antinutritional factors.
- Investigate processing requirements for potential human-food applications.
- Research food-safety considerations, including microbiological and chemical hazards.
- Identify the tests required before a resulting ingredient could be considered suitable for human consumption.

### Case-study selection task
Work with Fidel to identify which feedstock-product combinations are worth investigating from a human-food perspective.

Possible directions include:
- Microbial protein produced from agricultural by-products.
- Fungal protein from suitable plant-processing residues.
- Spirulina biomass as an alternative protein ingredient.

### Monday deliverables
1. A shortlist of potential human-food case studies.
2. Nutritional requirements and important evaluation metrics.
3. Available nutritional data for the shortlisted materials/products.
4. Relevant food-safety concerns and testing requirements.
5. Supporting scientific references.

**Priority:** High

## VANESSA — FOOD SCIENCE RESEARCH: ANIMAL FEED

**Primary responsibility:** Investigating the nutritional suitability and potential animal-feed applications of alternative protein products.

### Tasks
- Identify the animal species that would be relevant to our case studies.
- Research species-specific protein and amino acid requirements.
- Investigate protein digestibility and nutritional value.
- Research possible applications of microbial protein and Spirulina biomass in animal feed.
- Investigate antinutritional factors and relevant feed-safety concerns.
- Research possible inclusion levels and limitations where reliable studies are available.
- Identify nutritional and safety tests that would be required.

### Case-study selection task
Work with Fidel to identify promising feedstock-product combinations for animal-feed applications.

Possible directions include:
- Single-cell protein from agricultural by-products.
- Fungal biomass.
- Spirulina as a protein ingredient in aquaculture or poultry feed.

### Monday deliverables
1. A shortlist of potential animal-feed case studies.
2. A proposed target animal species.
3. Nutritional requirements and relevant evaluation metrics.
4. Available nutritional and digestibility data.
5. Safety considerations and supporting references.

**Priority:** High

## NJANE KARANJA — FINANCE, SOURCING & LOGISTICS

**Primary responsibility:** Determining whether the proposed feedstocks and conversion processes are practically and economically viable.

### Tasks
- Investigate locally available agricultural and food-processing by-products.
- Identify possible suppliers or industries producing these materials.
- Estimate material availability and quantities.
- Research collection, transportation and storage requirements.
- Investigate the costs of obtaining and preparing the raw materials.
- Estimate relevant processing and operational costs.
- Investigate the economic requirements of the proposed conversion pathways.
- Identify potential economic advantages and limitations.

### Case-study selection task
Evaluate the proposed feedstocks from a Kenyan sourcing and logistics perspective.

For Spirulina, investigate:
- Availability and cost of cultivation inputs.
- Water, nutrient and energy requirements.
- Possible cultivation infrastructure.
- Harvesting and drying costs.

### Monday deliverables
1. A shortlist of locally relevant feedstocks.
2. Potential sources and suppliers where identifiable.
3. Indicative sourcing and transportation costs.
4. Major processing cost categories.
5. An initial feasibility comparison between candidate case studies.

**Priority:** High

---

# 3. MONDAY CASE-STUDY SELECTION

This is one of our most important immediate tasks.

We need to select the specific examples that our application will use to demonstrate its capabilities.

Rather than selecting materials arbitrarily, the scientific team should propose candidates and evaluate them using the following criteria:

| Selection criterion | What we need to establish |
|---|---|
| Availability | Can the feedstock realistically be sourced? |
| Nutritional composition | Do we have reliable composition data? |
| Biological feasibility | Is there evidence supporting a conversion pathway? |
| Experimental evidence | Are there published studies with measurable results? |
| Product relevance | Is the resulting product potentially useful? |
| Safety | Are the major hazards and testing requirements identifiable? |
| Economic feasibility | Can we estimate the main processing costs? |
| Data availability | Is there enough information to represent the case study in our system? |

### Proposed case-study structure

We should aim to select:

**Case study 1 — Primary agricultural by-product**

One feedstock with at least two scientifically documented conversion pathways.

**Case study 2 — Alternative protein cultivation**

Spirulina, investigating whether agricultural or processing waste-derived nutrients could support its cultivation.

These are proposed directions, not final commitments. The meeting should determine whether both can be supported by sufficient evidence and completed within the available time.

### Who selects what?

- Fidel: Biological feasibility and conversion pathways.
- Adija: Human-food suitability.
- Vanessa: Animal-feed suitability.
- Njane: Local availability and economics.
- Wambua: Product scope and final prioritisation.
- Jonah: Data availability and technical feasibility.

**Deadline: Monday, 23 November.**

---

# 4. HOW RESEARCH SHOULD BE SUBMITTED

We need research that can actually be used by the application, not just paragraphs of general information.

For each case study, record:

### A. Feedstock information
- Name
- Source
- Origin
- Moisture content
- Protein content
- Carbohydrate content
- Fibre content
- Fat content
- Ash content
- pH
- Measurement units and wet/dry basis
- Source of each measurement

### B. Conversion pathway
- Pathway name
- Microorganism or biological agent
- Feedstock used
- Pretreatment requirements
- Process conditions
- Expected product
- Reported yield or productivity
- Limitations
- Supporting publication

### C. Product information
- Product name
- Protein content
- Amino acid profile, if available
- Digestibility, if available
- Potential application
- Safety concerns
- Required testing

### D. Economic information
- Raw material cost
- Transportation cost
- Preparation cost
- Processing requirements
- Energy requirements
- Other operational costs
- Assumptions and sources

Where information is unavailable, mark it as **unknown** rather than estimating or inventing it.

Every scientific measurement should have a source and its measurement basis.

---

# 5. DEVELOPMENT AND INTEGRATION PLAN

Research and software development will proceed in parallel.

### Backend — Jonah
- Establish the project structure.
- Propose the database entities and relationships.
- Define the initial API contract.
- Prepare endpoints for feedstocks, measurements and pathways.
- Wait for the agreed case-study structure before bulk data entry.

### Frontend — Wambua / Calvin
- Establish the React project.
- Build the basic application layout.
- Create feedstock input and display interfaces.
- Build a pathway comparison interface using clearly labelled sample data.
- Coordinate API integration with Jonah.

### Scientific research — Fidel, Adija and Vanessa
- Select case studies.
- Collect experimental results.
- Standardise measurements.
- Document sources
````

## File: frontend/docs/data-fetching.md
````markdown
# Server data

Use a route loader for data needed to render a page. Use a server function when that loader or a component needs server-only configuration, credentials, or APIs. Server-function input is public input: validate it at runtime with `.validator(...)`.

This example requires you to configure `ITEMS_API_URL` with your own server's absolute URL. It doesn't add a data source to Basic.

```ts
import { createServerFn } from "@tanstack/react-start";
import { z } from "zod";

const itemsSchema = z.array(z.object({ id: z.string(), name: z.string() }));

export const getItems = createServerFn({ method: "GET" }).handler(async () => {
  const url = process.env.ITEMS_API_URL;
  if (!url) throw new Error("ITEMS_API_URL is required");

  const response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not load items");
  return itemsSchema.parse(await response.json());
});
```

Put the server function in `src/lib/items.functions.ts`. A page can then use:

```tsx
import { createFileRoute } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { getItems } from "@/lib/items.functions";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/items")({
  loader: () => getItems(),
  pendingComponent: () => <p role="status">Loading items…</p>,
  component: ItemsPage,
});

function ItemsPage() {
  const items = Route.useLoaderData();
  if (items.length === 0) return <p>No items yet.</p>;
  return (
    <ul>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <li key={item.id}>{item.name}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

Create `src/routes/items.tsx` when using this example. The root route already handles unexpected loader failures and offers retry. For detail pages, use `throw notFound()` for missing records. Replace a text loading state with local Skeleton components when the content layout is known.

Keep secrets in server code; don't expose them in loader return values or `VITE_*` variables. Use absolute URLs for server-side `fetch`. In browser-only event handlers, same-origin relative API paths are appropriate. Validate remote responses and check HTTP statuses before using their contents.

For mutations, validate with `.validator(z.object(...))`, await the write, and invalidate affected route data after success. Choose the appropriate Netlify data/auth skill for the feature instead of inventing storage or authentication.

Add TanStack Query when client-side caching, background refresh, or mutation coordination is needed. Create its QueryClient inside `getRouter()` so server requests don't share cached user data, wire its provider and router context together, and use the installed TanStack SSR integration for cache dehydration/hydration. Don't add a module-level shared server cache or a provider without the corresponding SSR setup.
````

## File: frontend/docs/forms.md
````markdown
# Form pattern

`src/examples/validated-form.tsx` is an unmounted, type-checked example. It uses React Hook Form, Zod, and the local Form components. It has no backend or persistence. Import it into a route only when building a feature that needs it, then replace its email schema and copy with that feature's fields.

The example validates before submission, links field errors to the input, disables submission while pending, preserves input on failure, and announces success only after the required handler resolves. The handler must reject when the server rejects the request. `fetch` resolving does not mean the response succeeded.

After implementing your own `/api/contact` handler, connect it like this:

```tsx
import { ValidatedForm } from "@/examples/validated-form";

export function ContactForm() {
  return (
    <ValidatedForm
      onSubmit={async (values) => {
        const response = await fetch("/api/contact", {
          method: "POST",
          headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
          body: JSON.stringify(values),
        });
        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error("Submission failed");
        }
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

The endpoint is an example address, not a route supplied by Basic. Validate input again on the server. Don't return success until the requested operation has completed.

For Netlify Forms, use the supplied Netlify Forms skill instead of this JSON endpoint: mirror the fields in static HTML, send URL-encoded data to that static path, and check the response status. Keep the example's validation, pending, and failure behaviour.

Keep a visible label for every field. Give required fields both a schema rule and a `required` attribute. Use `FormDescription` for hints and `FormMessage` for field errors. Show submission failures in a separate `role="alert"` message without displaying internal exception details. Test invalid input, a rejected response, pending submission, success, and retry.
````

## File: frontend/src/components/charts/bar-chart.tsx
````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { useWidth } from "./use-width";
import { ChartTooltip } from "./chart-tooltip";

export interface BarSeries {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  color: string;
  values: number[];
  format?: (v: number) => string;
}

/**
 * Grouped vertical bar chart in the style of the Stitch "Intelligence overview":
 * dashed gridlines, rounded 4px bars, muted axis labels.
 */
export function GroupedBarChart({
  categories,
  series,
  height = 240,
  yMax,
  yTicks = 4,
  yFormat = (v) => `${v}`,
  ariaLabel,
  onSelect,
  selectedIndex,
}: {
  categories: string[];
  series: BarSeries[];
  height?: number;
  yMax?: number;
  yTicks?: number;
  yFormat?: (v: number) => string;
  ariaLabel: string;
  onSelect?: (index: number) => void;
  selectedIndex?: number;
}) {
  const [ref, width] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const pad = { top: 12, right: 8, bottom: 28, left: 40 };
  const max = yMax ?? Math.max(1, ...series.flatMap((s) => s.values)) * 1.1;
  const innerW = width - pad.left - pad.right;
  const innerH = height - pad.top - pad.bottom;
  const groupW = innerW / Math.max(1, categories.length);
  const barW = Math.min(24, (groupW * 0.62) / series.length);
  const gap = 4;
  const y = (v: number) => pad.top + innerH - (v / max) * innerH;
  const ticks = Array.from(
    { length: yTicks + 1 },
    (_, i) => (max / yTicks) * i,
  );
  const narrow = groupW < 64;

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative w-full">
      <svg
        width={width}
        height={height}
        role="img"
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        className="block text-on-surface-variant"
      >
        {ticks.map((t, i) => (
          <g key={i}>
            <line
              x1={pad.left}
              x2={width - pad.right}
              y1={y(t)}
              y2={y(t)}
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeOpacity={i === 0 ? 0.25 : 0.12}
              strokeDasharray={i === 0 ? undefined : "3 3"}
            />
            <text
              x={pad.left - 8}
              y={y(t) + 4}
              fontSize="11"
              textAnchor="end"
              fill="currentColor"
              className="tnum"
            >
              {yFormat(Math.round(t))}
            </text>
          </g>
        ))}
        {categories.map((c, ci) => {
          const gx = pad.left + groupW * ci + groupW / 2;
          const total = series.length * barW + (series.length - 1) * gap;
          const active = hover === ci || selectedIndex === ci;
          return (
            <g
              key={c}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHover(ci)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
              onClick={() => onSelect?.(ci)}
              style={{ cursor: onSelect ? "pointer" : "default" }}
            >
              <rect
                x={pad.left + groupW * ci}
                y={pad.top}
                width={groupW}
                height={innerH}
                fill={active ? "var(--surface-container-low)" : "transparent"}
                rx={6}
              />
              {series.map((s, si) => {
                const v = s.values[ci] ?? 0;
                const bx = gx - total / 2 + si * (barW + gap);
                return (
                  <rect
                    key={s.key}
                    x={bx}
                    y={y(v)}
                    width={barW}
                    height={Math.max(0, y(0) - y(v))}
                    rx={4}
                    fill={s.color}
                    className="transition-[y,height] duration-500 motion-reduce:transition-none"
                  />
                );
              })}
              <text
                x={gx}
                y={height - 8}
                fontSize="11"
                textAnchor="middle"
                fill="currentColor"
                fontWeight={selectedIndex === ci ? 600 : 400}
              >
                {narrow && c.length > 9 ? `${c.slice(0, 8)}…` : c}
              </text>
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
      {hover !== null && (
        <ChartTooltip
          x={pad.left + groupW * hover + groupW / 2}
          y={pad.top}
          containerWidth={width}
        >
          <p className="mb-1 font-semibold text-on-surface">
            {categories[hover]}
          </p>
          {series.map((s) => (
            <p key={s.key} className="flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-on-surface-variant">
                <span
                  className="size-2 rounded-sm"
                  style={{ background: s.color }}
                />
                {s.label}
              </span>
              <span className="type-data text-on-surface">
                {s.format ? s.format(s.values[hover]) : s.values[hover]}
              </span>
            </p>
          ))}
        </ChartTooltip>
      )}
      {/* Accessible data table fallback */}
      <table className="sr-only">
        <caption>{ariaLabel}</caption>
        <thead>
          <tr>
            <th>Category</th>
            {series.map((s) => (
              <th key={s.key}>{s.label}</th>
            ))}
          </tr>
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {categories.map((c, i) => (
            <tr key={c}>
              <td>{c}</td>
              {series.map((s) => (
                <td key={s.key}>{s.values[i]}</td>
              ))}
            </tr>
          ))}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import type { ReactNode } from "react";

export function ChartTooltip({
  x,
  y,
  children,
  containerWidth,
}: {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  children: ReactNode;
  containerWidth: number;
}) {
  const flip = x > containerWidth - 180;
  return (
    <div
      className="pointer-events-none absolute z-10 min-w-36 rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-card px-3 py-2 text-xs shadow-float"
      style={{
        left: flip ? undefined : x + 12,
        right: flip ? containerWidth - x + 12 : undefined,
        top: Math.max(0, y - 12),
      }}
      role="status"
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function LegendSwatch({
  color,
  label,
  muted = false,
}: {
  color: string;
  label: ReactNode;
  muted?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={
        muted
          ? "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-on-surface-variant"
          : "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-on-surface"
      }
    >
      <span
        className="size-2.5 shrink-0 rounded-sm"
        style={{ background: color }}
      />
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { useWidth } from "./use-width";
import { ChartTooltip } from "./chart-tooltip";
import { fmt } from "@/lib/format";

export interface ControlPoint {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: number;
}

/** Individuals control chart: points with mean and ±2σ limits. */
export function ControlChart({
  points,
  mean,
  sd,
  unit,
  height = 240,
  ariaLabel,
  onSelect,
  selectedId,
}: {
  points: ControlPoint[];
  mean: number;
  sd: number;
  unit: string;
  height?: number;
  ariaLabel: string;
  onSelect?: (id: string) => void;
  selectedId?: string;
}) {
  const [ref, width] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const pad = { top: 16, right: 52, bottom: 28, left: 44 };
  const ucl = mean + 2 * sd;
  const lcl = mean - 2 * sd;
  const vals = points.map((p) => p.value);
  const lo = Math.min(lcl - sd * 0.6, ...vals);
  const hi = Math.max(ucl + sd * 0.6, ...vals);
  const innerW = width - pad.left - pad.right;
  const innerH = height - pad.top - pad.bottom;
  const x = (i: number) =>
    pad.left +
    (points.length <= 1 ? innerW / 2 : (i / (points.length - 1)) * innerW);
  const y = (v: number) => pad.top + innerH - ((v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * innerH;
  const path = points
    .map((p, i) => `${i ? "L" : "M"}${x(i)},${y(p.value)}`)
    .join(" ");
  const ticks = [lo, (lo + mean) / 2, mean, (mean + hi) / 2, hi];
  const every = Math.ceil(points.length / Math.max(2, Math.floor(innerW / 70)));

  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="relative w-full">
      <svg
        width={width}
        height={height}
        role="img"
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        className="block text-on-surface-variant"
      >
        <rect
          x={pad.left}
          y={y(ucl)}
          width={innerW}
          height={y(lcl) - y(ucl)}
          fill="var(--sage)"
          opacity={0.7}
        />
        {ticks.map((t, i) => (
          <text
            key={i}
            x={pad.left - 8}
            y={y(t) + 4}
            fontSize="11"
            textAnchor="end"
            fill="currentColor"
            className="tnum"
          >
            {fmt(t, 1)}
          </text>
        ))}
        {[
          { v: ucl, l: "+2σ" },
          { v: mean, l: "Mean" },
          { v: lcl, l: "−2σ" },
        ].map((ln) => (
          <g key={ln.l}>
            <line
              x1={pad.left}
              x2={pad.left + innerW}
              y1={y(ln.v)}
              y2={y(ln.v)}
              stroke={ln.l === "Mean" ? "var(--brand)" : "var(--outline)"}
              strokeDasharray={ln.l === "Mean" ? undefined : "4 3"}
              strokeOpacity={0.8}
            />
            <text
              x={pad.left + innerW + 6}
              y={y(ln.v) + 4}
              fontSize="10.5"
              fill="currentColor"
            >
              {ln.l}
            </text>
          </g>
        ))}
        <path
          d={path}
          fill="none"
          stroke="var(--forest)"
          strokeWidth={1.5}
          strokeOpacity={0.6}
        />
        {points.map((p, i) => {
          const out = p.value > ucl || p.value < lcl;
          const sel = selectedId === p.id;
          return (
            <g
              key={p.id}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHover(i)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
              onClick={() => onSelect?.(p.id)}
              style={{ cursor: onSelect ? "pointer" : "default" }}
            >
              <circle cx={x(i)} cy={y(p.value)} r={10} fill="transparent" />
              <circle
                cx={x(i)}
                cy={y(p.value)}
                r={sel ? 5.5 : out ? 4.5 : 3.5}
                fill={out ? "var(--risk)" : sel ? "var(--brand)" : "#fff"}
                stroke={out ? "var(--risk)" : "var(--brand)"}
                strokeWidth={1.75}
              />
            </g>
          );
        })}
        {points.map((p, i) =>
          i % every === 0 ? (
            <text
              key={p.id}
              x={x(i)}
              y={height - 8}
              fontSize="10.5"
              textAnchor="middle"
              fill="currentColor"
            >
              {p.label}
            </text>
          ) : null,
        )}
      </svg>
      {hover !== null && points[hover] && (
        <ChartTooltip
          x={x(hover)}
          y={y(points[hover].value) - 20}
          containerWidth={width}
        >
          <p className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{points[hover].id}</p>
          <p className="text-on-surface-variant">
            {points[hover].label} ·{" "}
            <span className="type-data text-on-surface">
              {fmt(points[hover].value, 2)}
            </span>{" "}
            {unit}
          </p>
          <p className="text-on-surface-variant">
            z ={" "}
            <span className="type-data">
              {fmt((points[hover].value - mean) / sd, 2)}
            </span>
          </p>
        </ChartTooltip>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { useWidth } from "./use-width";
import { fmtCompact } from "@/lib/format";

export interface Flow {
  source: string;
  target: string;
  value: number;
}

const PALETTE = [
  "#25834b",
  "#3d6753",
  "#123d2c",
  "#6ccb72",
  "#a4d0b9",
  "#d99b35",
  "#6f7a6f",
  "#7fda98",
];

/** Two-column flow (Sankey-style) diagram: sources on the left, targets on the right. */
export function FlowDiagram({
  flows,
  sourceLabel,
  targetLabel,
  unit,
  ariaLabel,
}: {
  flows: Flow[];
  sourceLabel: string;
  targetLabel: string;
  unit: string;
  ariaLabel: string;
}) {
  const [ref, width] = useWidth<HTMLDivElement>();
  const [hover, setHover] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const compact = width < 520;
  const nodeW = 10;
  const labelW = compact ? 92 : 150;
  const gap = 10;
  const layout = useMemo(() => {
    const sources = [...new Set(flows.map((f) => f.source))];
    const targets = [...new Set(flows.map((f) => f.target))];
    const sTot = (n: string) =>
      flows.filter((f) => f.source === n).reduce((a, f) => a + f.value, 0);
    const tTot = (n: string) =>
      flows.filter((f) => f.target === n).reduce((a, f) => a + f.value, 0);
    sources.sort((a, b) => sTot(b) - sTot(a));
    targets.sort((a, b) => tTot(b) - tTot(a));
    const total = flows.reduce((a, f) => a + f.value, 0) || 1;
    const rows = Math.max(sources.length, targets.length);
    const height = Math.max(220, rows * 46);
    const avail = height - 24 - gap * (rows - 1);
    const scale = avail / total;
    const place = (names: string[], tot: (n: string) => number) => {
      let yy = 12;
      const extra =
        (height -
          24 -
          names.reduce((a, n) => a + tot(n) * scale, 0) -
          gap * (names.length - 1)) /
        2;
      yy += Math.max(0, extra);
      return Object.fromEntries(
        names.map((n) => {
          const h = Math.max(2, tot(n) * scale);
          const r = { y: yy, h, total: tot(n) };
          yy += h + gap;
          return [n, r];
        }),
      );
    };
    return {
      sources,
      targets,
      sPos: place(sources, sTot),
      tPos: place(targets, tTot),
      scale,
      height,
    };
  }, [flows]);

  const x0 = labelW;
  const x1 = width - labelW;
  const sOff: Record<string, number> = {};
  const tOff: Record<string, number> = {};
  const color = (s: string) =>
    PALETTE[layout.sources.indexOf(s) % PALETTE.length];

  if (!flows.length) return null;
  return (
    <div ref={ref} className="w-full">
      <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="type-eyebrow">{sourceLabel}</span>
        <span className="type-eyebrow">{targetLabel}</span>
      </div>
      <svg
        width={width}
        height={layout.height}
        role="img"
        aria-label={ariaLabel}
        className="block"
      >
        {flows.map((f) => {
          const s = layout.sPos[f.source];
          const t = layout.tPos[f.target];
          const h = Math.max(1, f.value * layout.scale);
          const sy = s.y + (sOff[f.source] ?? 0);
          const ty = t.y + (tOff[f.target] ?? 0);
          sOff[f.source] = (sOff[f.source] ?? 0) + h;
          tOff[f.target] = (tOff[f.target] ?? 0) + h;
          const a = x0 + nodeW;
          const b = x1;
          const mid = (a + b) / 2;
          const d = `M${a},${sy} C${mid},${sy} ${mid},${ty} ${b},${ty} L${b},${ty + h} C${mid},${ty + h} ${mid},${sy + h} ${a},${sy + h} Z`;
          const dim = hover && hover !== f.source && hover !== f.target;
          return (
            <path
              key={`${f.source}-${f.target}`}
              d={d}
              fill={color(f.source)}
              fillOpacity={dim ? 0.08 : 0.32}
              className="transition-[fill-opacity] duration-200"
            >
              <title>{`${f.source} → ${f.target}: ${fmtCompact(f.value)} ${unit}`}</title>
            </path>
          );
        })}
        {layout.sources.map((n) => {
          const p = layout.sPos[n];
          return (
            <g
              key={n}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHover(n)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
              className="cursor-default"
            >
              <rect
                x={x0}
                y={p.y}
                width={nodeW}
                height={p.h}
                rx={2}
                fill={color(n)}
              />
              <text
                x={x0 - 8}
                y={p.y + p.h / 2 - 2}
                fontSize="11.5"
                textAnchor="end"
                fill="var(--on-surface)"
                fontWeight={500}
              >
                {compact && n.length > 13 ? `${n.slice(0, 12)}…` : n}
              </text>
              <text
                x={x0 - 8}
                y={p.y + p.h / 2 + 11}
                fontSize="10.5"
                textAnchor="end"
                fill="var(--on-surface-variant)"
                className="tnum"
              >
                {fmtCompact(p.total)} {unit}
              </text>
            </g>
          );
        })}
        {layout.targets.map((n) => {
          const p = layout.tPos[n];
          return (
            <g
              key={n}
              onMouseEnter={() => setHover(n)}
              onMouseLeave={() => setHover(null)}
            >
              <rect
                x={x1}
                y={p.y}
                width={nodeW}
                height={p.h}
                rx={2}
                fill="var(--forest)"
              />
              <text
                x={x1 + nodeW + 8}
                y={p.y + p.h / 2 - 2}
                fontSize="11.5"
                fill="var(--on-surface)"
                fontWeight={500}
              >
                {compact && n.length > 13 ? `${n.slice(0, 12)}…` : n}
              </text>
              <text
                x={x1 + nodeW + 8}
                y={p.y + p.h / 2 + 11}
                fontSize="10.5"
                fill="var(--on-surface-variant)"
                className="tnum"
              >
                {fmtCompact(p.total)} {unit}
              </text>
            </g>
          );
        })}
      </svg>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
export interface RadarSeries {
  label: string;
  color: string;
  values: number[]; // 0–100
}

export function RadarChart({
  axes,
  series,
  size = 300,
  ariaLabel,
}: {
  axes: string[];
  series: RadarSeries[];
  size?: number;
  ariaLabel: string;
}) {
  const cx = size / 2;
  const cy = size / 2;
  const r = size / 2 - 48;
  const angle = (i: number) => (Math.PI * 2 * i) / axes.length - Math.PI / 2;
  const pt = (i: number, v: number) => [
    cx + Math.cos(angle(i)) * r * (v / 100),
    cy + Math.sin(angle(i)) * r * (v / 100),
  ];
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}
      className="mx-auto block w-full max-w-[340px] text-on-surface-variant"
      role="img"
      aria-label={ariaLabel}
    >
      {[25, 50, 75, 100].map((ring) => (
        <polygon
          key={ring}
          points={axes.map((_, i) => pt(i, ring).join(",")).join(" ")}
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeOpacity={ring === 100 ? 0.22 : 0.1}
          strokeDasharray={ring === 100 ? undefined : "3 3"}
        />
      ))}
      {axes.map((a, i) => {
        const [x, y] = pt(i, 100);
        const [lx, ly] = pt(i, 122);
        const anchor =
          Math.abs(lx - cx) < 8 ? "middle" : lx > cx ? "start" : "end";
        return (
          <g key={a}>
            <line
              x1={cx}
              y1={cy}
              x2={x}
              y2={y}
              stroke="currentColor"
              strokeOpacity={0.1}
            />
            <text
              x={lx}
              y={ly + 4}
              fontSize="10.5"
              textAnchor={anchor}
              fill="currentColor"
            >
              {a}
            </text>
          </g>
        );
      })}
      {series.map((s) => (
        <g key={s.label}>
          <polygon
            points={s.values.map((v, i) => pt(i, v).join(",")).join(" ")}
            fill={s.color}
            fillOpacity={0.12}
            stroke={s.color}
            strokeWidth={1.75}
            strokeLinejoin="round"
          />
          {s.values.map((v, i) => {
            const [x, y] = pt(i, v);
            return (
              <circle
                key={i}
                cx={x}
                cy={y}
                r={2.6}
                fill="#fff"
                stroke={s.color}
                strokeWidth={1.5}
              />
            );
          })}
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/components/charts/use-width.ts
````typescript
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";

/** Tracks an element's width so SVG charts can lay out in real pixels. */
export function useWidth<T extends HTMLElement>(fallback = 640) {
  const ref = useRef<T>(null);
  const [width, setWidth] = useState(fallback);
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(([entry]) =>
      setWidth(Math.max(240, Math.floor(entry.contentRect.width))),
    );
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);
  return [ref, width] as const;
}
````

````typescript
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

export function SectionHeader({
  title,
  description,
  badge,
  actions,
  className,
  as: As = "h2",
}: {
  title: string;
  description?: ReactNode;
  badge?: ReactNode;
  actions?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
  as?: "h2" | "h3";
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <div className="min-w-0">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <As className="type-title font-sans text-on-surface">{title}</As>
          {badge}
        </div>
        {description && (
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
            {description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      {actions && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">{actions}</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/** White data panel: 1px hairline border, 12px radius, 24px padding. */
export function Panel({
  className,
  children,
  padded = true,
  ...rest
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & { padded?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-card shadow-card",
        padded && "p-5 sm:p-6",
        className,
      )}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatCard({
  label,
  value,
  icon,
  delta,
  deltaTone = "brand",
  footnote,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: ReactNode;
  icon?: string;
  delta?: ReactNode;
  deltaTone?: "brand" | "muted" | "amber" | "risk";
  footnote?: ReactNode;
}) {
  const tone = {
    brand: "text-brand-strong",
    muted: "text-on-surface-variant",
    amber: "text-amber-ink",
    risk: "text-risk",
  }[deltaTone];
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col justify-between gap-4 rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-card p-5 shadow-card transition-shadow hover:shadow-float sm:p-6">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <span className="type-eyebrow text-on-surface-variant">{label}</span>
        {icon && <Icon name={icon} className="text-brand-strong" />}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-3 gap-y-1">
        <span className="type-headline tnum text-on-surface">{value}</span>
        {delta && <span className={cn("type-data", tone)}>{delta}</span>}
      </div>
      {footnote && (
        <div className="-mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{footnote}</div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export function EmptyState({
  icon = "search_off",
  title,
  description,
  action,
  className,
}: {
  icon?: string;
  title: string;
  description?: ReactNode;
  action?: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-outline-variant bg-surface-low px-6 py-12 text-center",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-sage text-brand-strong">
        <Icon name={icon} size={22} />
      </span>
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <p className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{title}</p>
        {description && (
          <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
            {description}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ErrorState({
  title = "This data couldn’t load",
  description = "The request failed. Try again in a moment.",
  action,
}: {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  action?: ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      role="alert"
      className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-risk/30 bg-risk-soft/40 px-6 py-12 text-center"
    >
      <span className="grid size-11 place-items-center rounded-full bg-risk-soft text-risk-ink">
        <Icon name="error" size={22} />
      </span>
      <div className="space-y-1">
        <p className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{title}</p>
        <p className="max-w-md text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
          {description}
        </p>
      </div>
      {action}
    </div>
  );
}

export function StatusPill({
  tone = "sage",
  children,
  className,
}: {
  tone?: "sage" | "neutral" | "amber" | "risk" | "outline";
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  const t = {
    sage: "bg-mint text-on-mint",
    neutral: "bg-surface-high text-on-surface-variant",
    amber: "bg-amber-soft text-amber-ink",
    risk: "bg-risk-soft text-risk-ink",
    outline: "border border-hairline bg-card text-on-surface",
  }[tone];
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center gap-1 rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap",
        t,
        className,
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </span>
  );
}

/** Horizontal score bar 0–100 with tabular value. */
export function ScoreBar({
  value,
  max = 100,
  tone = "brand",
  showValue = true,
  className,
  label,
}: {
  value: number;
  max?: number;
  tone?: "brand" | "amber" | "risk" | "mint";
  showValue?: boolean;
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  const pct = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (value / max) * 100));
  const bar = {
    brand: "bg-brand",
    amber: "bg-amber",
    risk: "bg-risk",
    mint: "bg-mint-dim",
  }[tone];
  return (
    <div className={cn("flex items-center gap-2", className)}>
      <div
        className="h-1.5 flex-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-surface-high"
        role="meter"
        aria-valuenow={Math.round(value)}
        aria-valuemin={0}
        aria-valuemax={max}
        aria-label={label}
      >
        <div
          className={cn(
            "h-full rounded-full transition-[width] duration-500 motion-reduce:transition-none",
            bar,
          )}
          style={{ width: `${pct}%` }}
        />
      </div>
      {showValue && (
        <span className="type-data w-8 text-right text-on-surface">
          {Math.round(value)}
        </span>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export const scoreTone = (v: number): "brand" | "amber" | "risk" =>
  v >= 65 ? "brand" : v >= 40 ? "amber" : "risk";

export function SegmentedControl<T extends string>({
  value,
  onChange,
  options,
  label,
  className,
}: {
  value: T;
  onChange: (v: T) => void;
  options: { value: T; label: ReactNode }[];
  label: string;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div
      role="radiogroup"
      aria-label={label}
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex rounded-lg border border-hairline bg-surface-low p-0.5",
        className,
      )}
    >
      {options.map((o) => (
        <button
          key={o.value}
          type="button"
          role="radio"
          aria-checked={value === o.value}
          onClick={() => onChange(o.value)}
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand",
            value === o.value
              ? "bg-card text-on-surface shadow-card"
              : "text-on-surface-variant hover:text-on-surface",
          )}
        >
          {o.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Labelled range slider styled to the design system. */
export function RangeField({
  id,
  label,
  value,
  min,
  max,
  step = 1,
  onChange,
  format = (v: number) => String(v),
  hint,
}: {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  value: number;
  min: number;
  max: number;
  step?: number;
  onChange: (v: number) => void;
  format?: (v: number) => string;
  hint?: string;
}) {
  const fill = ((value - min) / (max - min)) * 100;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-2">
      <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
        <label htmlFor={id} className="text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
          {label}
        </label>
        <span className="type-data text-brand-strong">{format(value)}</span>
      </div>
      <input
        id={id}
        type="range"
        className="bp-range"
        min={min}
        max={max}
        step={step}
        value={value}
        onChange={(e) => onChange(Number(e.target.value))}
        style={{ ["--fill" as string]: `${fill}%` }}
        aria-describedby={hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined}
      />
      {hint && (
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          {hint}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import {
  Tooltip,
  TooltipContent,
  TooltipTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/tooltip";
import { DATASET_STATUS } from "@/data/api";
import type { Measure, Provenance } from "@/data/types";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { fmt } from "@/lib/format";

export const PROVENANCE_META: Record<
  Provenance,
  { label: string; short: string; className: string; description: string }
> = {
  measured: {
    label: "Measured",
    short: "LAB",
    className: "bg-sage text-forest border-mint-dim",
    description: "Laboratory or field measurement on actual samples.",
  },
  literature: {
    label: "Literature",
    short: "LIT",
    className:
      "bg-surface-lowest text-on-surface-variant border-outline-variant",
    description:
      "Taken from published sources; citation attached in the evidence register.",
  },
  estimated: {
    label: "Estimated",
    short: "EST",
    className: "bg-amber-soft text-amber-ink border-amber/40",
    description:
      "Modelled, calculated by difference or estimated from surveys.",
  },
  demo: {
    label: "Demo",
    short: "DEMO",
    className:
      "bg-surface-high text-on-surface-variant border-dashed border-outline",
    description: "Placeholder value for demonstration only.",
  },
};

/** Compact provenance tag. Tooltip explains the class and the demo status. */
export function ProvenanceTag({
  kind,
  className,
  full = false,
}: {
  kind: Provenance;
  className?: string;
  full?: boolean;
}) {
  const meta = PROVENANCE_META[kind];
  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
        <span
          tabIndex={0}
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex h-[18px] shrink-0 cursor-help items-center rounded border px-1.5 font-data text-[10px] leading-none font-medium tracking-wide outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-sage",
            meta.className,
            className,
          )}
          aria-label={`${meta.label} data class${DATASET_STATUS.simulated ? ", simulated value" : ""}`}
        >
          {full ? meta.label : meta.short}
          {DATASET_STATUS.simulated && kind !== "demo" && (
            <span className="ml-0.5 opacity-60">*</span>
          )}
        </span>
      </TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent className="max-w-64">
        <p className="font-medium">{meta.label}</p>
        <p className="opacity-80">{meta.description}</p>
        {DATASET_STATUS.simulated && kind !== "demo" && (
          <p className="mt-1 opacity-80">
            * Simulated in this prototype — not a verified value.
          </p>
        )}
      </TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}

/** A value with unit, optional range and provenance tag. */
export function MeasureValue({
  m,
  digits = 1,
  showRange = false,
  className,
}: {
  m: Measure;
  digits?: number;
  showRange?: boolean;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-1.5 gap-y-1",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <span className="type-data text-on-surface">{fmt(m.value, digits)}</span>
      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{m.unit}</span>
      {showRange && m.range && (
        <span className="type-data text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
          ({fmt(m.range[0], digits)}–{fmt(m.range[1], digits)})
        </span>
      )}
      <ProvenanceTag kind={m.provenance} className="self-center" />
    </span>
  );
}

export function ProvenanceLegend({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground",
        className,
      )}
    >
      <span className="type-eyebrow text-outline">Data provenance</span>
      {(Object.keys(PROVENANCE_META) as Provenance[]).map((k) => (
        <span key={k} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <ProvenanceTag kind={k} />
          {PROVENANCE_META[k].label}
        </span>
      ))}
      {DATASET_STATUS.simulated && <span>* simulated in this prototype</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

export function DemoChip({
  className,
  label = DATASET_STATUS.label,
}: {
  className?: string;
  label?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <Tooltip>
      <TooltipTrigger asChild>
        <span
          tabIndex={0}
          className={cn(
            "inline-flex cursor-help items-center rounded-full bg-mint px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-on-mint outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand",
            className,
          )}
        >
          {label}
        </span>
      </TooltipTrigger>
      <TooltipContent className="max-w-72">
        {DATASET_STATUS.description}
      </TooltipContent>
    </Tooltip>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { useNavigate } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import {
  Dialog,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import { FEEDSTOCKS } from "@/data/feedstocks";
import { PATHWAYS } from "@/data/pathways";
import { END_USES } from "@/data/end-uses";
import { ALL_NAV_ITEMS } from "@/lib/navigation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type Result = {
  id: string;
  group: string;
  label: string;
  meta: string;
  icon: string;
  go: () => void;
};

/** Command-palette style search across feedstocks, pathways, end-uses and modules. ⌘K / Ctrl+K. */
export function GlobalSearch({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [q, setQ] = useState("");
  const [rawIndex, setRawIndex] = useState(0);
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLUListElement>(null);

  // A new query always rebuilds the result list, so reset the highlight in the
  // same event that changes the query — no effect needed.
  const handleQueryChange = (v: string) => {
    setQ(v);
    setRawIndex(0);
  };

  // Reset query and index on close inside the event handler rather than an
  // effect, so there is no synchronous setState-in-effect cascade.
  const handleOpenChange = (v: boolean) => {
    if (!v) {
      setQ("");
      setRawIndex(0);
    }
    onOpenChange(v);
  };

  const results = useMemo<Result[]>(() => {
    const term = q.trim().toLowerCase();
    const match = (...s: string[]) =>
      !term || s.some((x) => x.toLowerCase().includes(term));
    const close = () => onOpenChange(false);
    const out: Result[] = [];
    FEEDSTOCKS.filter((f) => match(f.name, f.category, f.sourceType, ...f.tags))
      .slice(0, term ? 8 : 4)
      .forEach((f) =>
        out.push({
          id: `f-${f.id}`,
          group: "Feedstocks",
          label: f.name,
          meta: f.category,
          icon: "eco",
          go: () => {
            close();
            void navigate({
              to: "/feedstocks/$feedstockId",
              params: { feedstockId: f.id },
            });
          },
        }),
      );
    PATHWAYS.filter((p) => match(p.name, p.short, p.family, p.product))
      .slice(0, term ? 5 : 3)
      .forEach((p) =>
        out.push({
          id: `p-${p.id}`,
          group: "Pathways",
          label: p.name,
          meta: `${p.family} · TRL ${p.trl}`,
          icon: "alt_route",
          go: () => {
            close();
            void navigate({ to: "/pathways", search: { focus: p.id } });
          },
        }),
      );
    END_USES.filter((e) => match(e.name, e.sector))
      .slice(0, term ? 5 : 2)
      .forEach((e) =>
        out.push({
          id: `e-${e.id}`,
          group: "End uses",
          label: e.name,
          meta: e.sector,
          icon: "category",
          go: () => {
            close();
            void navigate({ to: "/end-use", search: { endUse: e.id } });
          },
        }),
      );
    ALL_NAV_ITEMS.filter((n) => match(n.label))
      .slice(0, term ? 6 : 0)
      .forEach((n) =>
        out.push({
          id: `n-${n.label}`,
          group: "Modules",
          label: n.label,
          meta: n.moduleId ? "Module brief" : "Screen",
          icon: n.icon,
          go: () => {
            close();
            if (n.moduleId)
              void navigate({
                to: "/modules/$moduleId",
                params: { moduleId: n.moduleId },
              });
            else void navigate({ to: n.to });
          },
        }),
      );
    return out;
  }, [q, navigate, onOpenChange]);

  // Clamp the highlighted index to the current list length (derived, not stored).
  const index = Math.min(rawIndex, Math.max(0, results.length - 1));

  useEffect(() => {
    listRef.current
      ?.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`[data-index="${index}"]`)
      ?.scrollIntoView({ block: "nearest" });
  }, [index]);

  const groups = [...new Set(results.map((r) => r.group))];

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent
        className="top-[12%] translate-y-0 gap-0 overflow-hidden p-0 sm:max-w-xl"
        showCloseButton={false}
      >
        <DialogTitle className="sr-only">Search BIOPATH AI</DialogTitle>
        <DialogDescription className="sr-only">
          Search feedstocks, pathways, end uses and modules. Use arrow keys to
          move and Enter to open.
        </DialogDescription>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b border-hairline px-4">
          <Icon name="search" className="text-on-surface-variant" />
          <input
            autoFocus
            value={q}
            onChange={(e) => handleQueryChange(e.target.value)}
            onKeyDown={(e) => {
              if (e.key === "ArrowDown") {
                e.preventDefault();
                setRawIndex((i) => Math.min(results.length - 1, i + 1));
              }
              if (e.key === "ArrowUp") {
                e.preventDefault();
                setRawIndex((i) => Math.max(0, i - 1));
              }
              if (e.key === "Enter") results[index]?.go();
            }}
            placeholder="Search feedstocks, pathways, end uses…"
            className="h-14 flex-1 bg-transparent text-base outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
            aria-label="Search"
            role="combobox"
            aria-expanded="true"
            aria-controls="global-search-results"
            aria-activedescendant={
              results[index] ? `gs-${results[index].id}` : undefined
            }
          />
          <kbd className="type-data rounded border border-hairline px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            Esc
          </kbd>
        </div>
        <ul
          id="global-search-results"
          ref={listRef}
          role="listbox"
          className="max-h-[60vh] overflow-y-auto p-2"
        >
          {results.length === 0 && (
            <li className="px-3 py-10 text-center text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
              No matches for "{q}". Try a feedstock name such as "okara", or a
              pathway such as "fermentation".
            </li>
          )}
          {groups.map((g) => (
            <li key={g} role="presentation">
              <div className="type-eyebrow px-3 pt-3 pb-1 text-outline">
                {g}
              </div>
              <ul role="presentation">
                {results
                  .filter((r) => r.group === g)
                  .map((r) => {
                    const i = results.indexOf(r);
                    return (
                      <li
                        key={r.id}
                        id={`gs-${r.id}`}
                        role="option"
                        aria-selected={i === index}
                        data-index={i}
                        onMouseEnter={() => setRawIndex(i)}
                        onClick={r.go}
````

````typescript
import { Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import type { NavItem } from "@/lib/navigation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const base =
  "flex items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm transition-colors outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-brand";
const idle =
  "text-on-surface-variant hover:bg-surface-high hover:text-on-surface";
const active = "bg-mint font-semibold text-on-mint";

export function SidebarLink({
  item,
  onNavigate,
}: {
  item: NavItem;
  onNavigate?: () => void;
}) {
  const content = (
    <>
      <Icon name={item.icon} />
      <span className="truncate">{item.label}</span>
    </>
  );
  if (item.moduleId) {
    return (
      <Link
        to="/modules/$moduleId"
        params={{ moduleId: item.moduleId }}
        onClick={onNavigate}
        className={cn(base, idle)}
        activeProps={{ className: cn(base, active), "aria-current": "page" }}
        inactiveProps={{ className: cn(base, idle) }}
      >
        {content}
      </Link>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Link
      to={item.to}
      onClick={onNavigate}
      activeOptions={{ exact: item.to === "/" }}
      activeProps={{ className: cn(base, active), "aria-current": "page" }}
      inactiveProps={{ className: cn(base, idle) }}
    >
      {content}
    </Link>
  );
}
````

````typescript
          >
````

````typescript
          <DemoChip className="hidden md:inline-flex" />
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Search"
            className={cn(iconBtn, "lg:hidden")}
            onClick={() => setSearchOpen(true)}

            <Icon name="search" />

          <Popover onOpenChange={(o) => o && setUnread(0)}>

          <DropdownMenu>

              >
                <img
                  src="/.netlify/images?url=/img/avatar.jpg&w=64&h=64&fit=cover&fm=webp"
                  alt=""

                  height={32}

                />
              </button>
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-56">
              <DropdownMenuLabel>
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold">Researcher</p>
                <p className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">
````

````typescript
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { Checkbox } from "./checkbox";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "./radio-group";
import { Switch } from "./switch";
import {
  Accordion,
  AccordionContent,
  AccordionItem,
  AccordionTrigger,
} from "./accordion";
import { Label } from "./label";

describe("form controls", () => {
  it("supports labelled checkbox and switch keyboard interaction", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(
      <div>
        <Checkbox id="updates" />
        <Label htmlFor="updates">Updates</Label>
        <Switch id="notifications" />
        <Label htmlFor="notifications">Notifications</Label>
      </div>,
    );

    await user.tab();
    expect(screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: "Updates" })).toHaveFocus();
    await user.keyboard(" ");
    expect(screen.getByRole("checkbox", { name: "Updates" })).toBeChecked();
    await user.tab();
    expect(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: "Notifications" })).toHaveFocus();
    await user.keyboard(" ");
    expect(screen.getByRole("switch", { name: "Notifications" })).toBeChecked();
  });

  it("allows radio selection with arrow keys", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(
      <RadioGroup defaultValue="daily" aria-label="Frequency">
        <RadioGroupItem value="daily" id="daily" />
        <Label htmlFor="daily">Daily</Label>
        <RadioGroupItem value="weekly" id="weekly" />
        <Label htmlFor="weekly">Weekly</Label>
      </RadioGroup>,
    );

    await user.tab();
    await user.keyboard("{ArrowDown>}");
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: "Weekly" })).toBeChecked();
    });
    await user.keyboard("{/ArrowDown}");
  });

  it("exposes accordion state and content to keyboard users", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(
      <Accordion type="single" collapsible>
        <AccordionItem value="details">
          <AccordionTrigger>Details</AccordionTrigger>
          <AccordionContent>Additional information</AccordionContent>
        </AccordionItem>
      </Accordion>,
    );

    await user.tab();
    await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Details" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-expanded",
      "true",
    );
    expect(screen.getByText("Additional information")).toBeVisible();
    await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Details" })).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-expanded",
      "false",
    );
  });
});
````

## File: frontend/src/components/ui/form.tsx
````typescript
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type * as LabelPrimitive from "@radix-ui/react-label";
import * as Slot from "@radix-ui/react-slot";
import {
  Controller,
  FormProvider,
  useFormContext,
  useFormState,
  type ControllerProps,
  type FieldPath,
  type FieldValues,
} from "react-hook-form";

import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";

const Form = FormProvider;

type FormFieldContextValue<
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
> = {
  name: TName;
};

const FormFieldContext = React.createContext<FormFieldContextValue>(
  {} as FormFieldContextValue,
);

const FormField = <
  TFieldValues extends FieldValues = FieldValues,
  TName extends FieldPath<TFieldValues> = FieldPath<TFieldValues>,
>({
  ...props
}: ControllerProps<TFieldValues, TName>) => {
  return (
    <FormFieldContext.Provider value={{ name: props.name }}>
      <Controller {...props} />
    </FormFieldContext.Provider>
  );
};

const useFormField = () => {
  const fieldContext = React.useContext(FormFieldContext);
  const itemContext = React.useContext(FormItemContext);
  const { getFieldState } = useFormContext();
  const formState = useFormState({ name: fieldContext.name });
  const fieldState = getFieldState(fieldContext.name, formState);

  if (!fieldContext) {
    throw new Error("useFormField should be used within <FormField>");
  }

  const { id } = itemContext;

  return {
    id,
    name: fieldContext.name,
    formItemId: `${id}-form-item`,
    formDescriptionId: `${id}-form-item-description`,
    formMessageId: `${id}-form-item-message`,
    ...fieldState,
  };
};

type FormItemContextValue = {
  id: string;
};

const FormItemContext = React.createContext<FormItemContextValue>(
  {} as FormItemContextValue,
);

function FormItem({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  const id = React.useId();

  return (
    <FormItemContext.Provider value={{ id }}>
      <div
        data-slot="form-item"
        className={cn("grid gap-2", className)}
        {...props}
      />
    </FormItemContext.Provider>
  );
}

function FormLabel({
  className,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof LabelPrimitive.Root>) {
  const { error, formItemId } = useFormField();

  return (
    <Label
      data-slot="form-label"
      data-error={!!error}
      className={cn("data-[error=true]:text-destructive", className)}
      htmlFor={formItemId}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function FormControl({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof Slot.Root>) {
  const { error, formItemId, formDescriptionId, formMessageId } =
    useFormField();

  return (
    <Slot.Root
      data-slot="form-control"
      id={formItemId}
      aria-describedby={
        !error
          ? `${formDescriptionId}`
          : `${formDescriptionId} ${formMessageId}`
      }
      aria-invalid={!!error}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function FormDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  const { formDescriptionId } = useFormField();

  return (
    <p
      data-slot="form-description"
      id={formDescriptionId}
      className={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
}

function FormMessage({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  const { error, formMessageId } = useFormField();
  const body = error ? String(error?.message ?? "") : props.children;

  if (!body) {
    return null;
  }

  return (
    <p
      data-slot="form-message"
      id={formMessageId}
      className={cn("text-sm text-destructive", className)}
      {...props}
    >
      {body}
    </p>
  );
}

export {
  useFormField,
  Form,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormMessage,
  FormField,
};
````
