## File: frontend/src/components/ui/overlays.test.tsx
````typescript
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSub,
  DropdownMenuSubContent,
  DropdownMenuSubTrigger,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "./dropdown-menu";
import { PopoverTitle } from "./popover";

describe("overlays", () => {
  it("renders submenu actions outside the scrolling menu and permits selection", async () => {
    const selected = vi.fn();
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    render(
      <DropdownMenu defaultOpen>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger>Actions</DropdownMenuTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuContent>
          <DropdownMenuSub>
            <DropdownMenuSubTrigger>Export</DropdownMenuSubTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuSubContent>
              <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={selected}>
                Export PDF
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            </DropdownMenuSubContent>
          </DropdownMenuSub>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>,
    );
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Export" }));
    const action = await screen.findByRole("menuitem", { name: "Export PDF" });
    const parentMenu = screen
      .getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Export" })
      .closest('[role="menu"]');
    expect(parentMenu).not.toContainElement(action);
    action.focus();
    await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
    expect(selected).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });

  it("exposes the popover title as a level-two heading", () => {
    render(<PopoverTitle>Display settings</PopoverTitle>);
    expect(
      screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 2, name: "Display settings" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
  });
});
````

## File: frontend/src/components/error-pages.test.tsx
````typescript
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import {
  createMemoryHistory,
  createRootRoute,
  createRoute,
  createRouter,
  RouterProvider,
} from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { NotFoundPage, RouteErrorPage } from "./error-pages";

describe("error pages", () => {
  it("offers navigation home when a route is missing", async () => {
    const root = createRootRoute({ notFoundComponent: NotFoundPage });
    const index = createRoute({
      getParentRoute: () => root,
      path: "/",
      component: () => <h1>Home</h1>,
    });
    const router = createRouter({
      routeTree: root.addChildren([index]),
      scrollRestoration: false,
      history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ["/missing"] }),
    });
    await router.load();
    render(<RouterProvider router={router} />);

    expect(
      await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Page not found" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent
      .setup()
      .click(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "Go home" }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Home" })).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("retries a failed loader without exposing its error to the page", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const loader = vi
      .fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("Internal credentials must not appear"))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined);
    const root = createRootRoute({ errorComponent: RouteErrorPage });
    const index = createRoute({
      getParentRoute: () => root,
      path: "/",
      loader,
      component: () => <h1>Loaded</h1>,
    });
    const router = createRouter({
      routeTree: root.addChildren([index]),
      scrollRestoration: false,
      history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ["/"] }),
    });
    await router.load();
    render(<RouterProvider router={router} />);

    expect(
      await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "This page couldn’t load" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(
      screen.queryByText("Internal credentials must not appear"),
    ).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByRole("heading", { name: "Loaded" }),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(loader).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});
````

````typescript
/**
 * Data access layer.
 *
 * Every screen reads data through these async functions — never from the
 * fixture modules directly — so a real backend (Netlify Database + server
 * routes) can replace them without touching the UI. Client-side calls add a
 * short simulated latency so loading states are exercised.
 */
import { FEEDSTOCKS } from "./feedstocks";
import { PATHWAYS } from "./pathways";
import { END_USES } from "./end-uses";
import { REGIONS } from "./regions";
import { backendApi } from "./backend-api";
import {
  ACTIVITY,
  BATCHES,
  NOTIFICATIONS,
  PROJECTS,
  REPORTS,
  evidenceFor,
} from "./workspace";

/** Shown wherever data is displayed. Flip when real data sources are connected. */
export const DATASET_STATUS = {
  simulated: true,
  label: "Prototype / Demo Data",
  description:
    "All figures in this prototype are simulated for demonstration. Provenance tags show the class of evidence each field is designed to hold — they do not indicate verified results.",
} as const;

const latency = (ms = 260) =>
  typeof window === "undefined"
    ? Promise.resolve()
    : new Promise<void>((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));

export async function listFeedstocks() {
  await latency();
  return FEEDSTOCKS;
}

export async function getFeedstock(id: string) {
  await latency();
  const feedstock = FEEDSTOCKS.find((f) => f.id === id);
  if (!feedstock) return null;
  return {
    feedstock,
    batches: BATCHES.filter((b) => b.feedstockId === id),
    evidence: evidenceFor(id),
  };
}

export async function listPathways() {
  await latency(180);
  return PATHWAYS;
}

export async function listEndUses() {
  await latency(180);
  return END_USES;
}

export async function listRegions() {
  await latency(180);
  return REGIONS;
}

export async function listBatches() {
  await latency();
  return BATCHES;
}

export async function listReports() {
  await latency();
  return REPORTS;
}

export async function getDashboard() {
  await latency(120);
  const qcPass =
    BATCHES.filter((b) => b.qc === "pass").length / Math.max(1, BATCHES.length);
  return {
    kpis: {
      feedstocks: FEEDSTOCKS.length,
      newThisMonth: 3,
      batches: BATCHES.length,
      qcPassRate: qcPass,
      pathwaysEvaluated:
        FEEDSTOCKS.filter((f) => f.status !== "pending").length *
        PATHWAYS.length,
      sourcesIndexed: 1240,
      sourcesNew: 42,
    },
    projects: PROJECTS,
    activity: ACTIVITY,
  };
}

export async function listNotifications() {
  return NOTIFICATIONS;
}
// Live backend data

export const createLiveSupplier = backendApi.suppliers.create;

export const getLiveFeedstock = (id: number) => backendApi.feedstocks.get(id);
````

````typescript
const API_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? "http://localhost:3001/api";

async function request<T>(path: string, options?: RequestInit): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}${path}`, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...options?.headers,
    },
  });

  if (response.status === 204) return undefined as T;

  let body: unknown;
  try {
    body = await response.json();
  } catch {
    body = undefined;
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const message =
      (body as { message?: string | string[] })?.message ??
      `API request failed: ${response.status}`;
    throw new Error(
      Array.isArray(message) ? message.join(", ") : String(message),
    );
  }
  return body as T;
}

}

  name: string;

  description: string | null;
  createdAt?: string;
  updatedAt?: string;

}

  id: number;
  batchCode: string;
  supplierId: number;
  feedstockId: number;
  quantity: number;

  createdAt?: string;
  supplier?: Pick<LiveSupplier, "id" | "name" | "siteName" | "county">;
  feedstock?: Pick<LiveFeedstock, "id" | "name" | "category">;
}

export interface CreateSupplierPayload {
  name: string;
  siteName: string;
  county: string;
  town?: string;
}

export interface CreateFeedstockPayload {
  name: string;
  category: string;
  description?: string;
}

export interface CreateBatchPayload {
  batchCode: string;
  supplierId: number;
  feedstockId: number;
  quantity: number;
  quantityUnit: string;

}

export interface LiveStats {

  feedstockCount: number;
  batchCount: number;

}

export interface LiveReport {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  type: string;
  status: string;
  summary: string;
  feedstockId: number | null;
  sections: string; // pipe-delimited
  content: string;
  author: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  feedstock?: Pick<LiveFeedstock, "id" | "name" | "category"> | null;
}

export interface CreateReportPayload {
  title: string;
  type: string;
  summary?: string;
  feedstockId?: number;
  sections?: string[];
  content?: string;
  author?: string;
}

export const backendApi = {
  suppliers: {
    list: () => request<LiveSupplier[]>("/suppliers"),
    get: (id: number) => request<LiveSupplier>(`/suppliers/${id}`),
    create: (data: CreateSupplierPayload) =>
      request<LiveSupplier>("/suppliers", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    update: (id: number, data: Partial<CreateSupplierPayload>) =>
      request<LiveSupplier>(`/suppliers/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    remove: (id: number) =>
      request<void>(`/suppliers/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  },

  feedstocks: {
    list: (category?: string) =>
      request<LiveFeedstock[]>(
        category
          ? `/feedstocks?category=${encodeURIComponent(category)}`
          : "/feedstocks",
      ),
    get: (id: number) => request<LiveFeedstock>(`/feedstocks/${id}`),
    create: (data: CreateFeedstockPayload) =>
      request<LiveFeedstock>("/feedstocks", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    update: (id: number, data: Partial<CreateFeedstockPayload>) =>
      request<LiveFeedstock>(`/feedstocks/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    remove: (id: number) =>
      request<void>(`/feedstocks/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  },

  batches: {
    list: (filter?: { supplierId?: number; feedstockId?: number }) => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (filter?.supplierId)
        params.set("supplierId", String(filter.supplierId));
      if (filter?.feedstockId)
        params.set("feedstockId", String(filter.feedstockId));
      const qs = params.toString();
      return request<LiveBatch[]>(`/batches${qs ? `?${qs}` : ""}`);
    },
    get: (id: number) => request<LiveBatch>(`/batches/${id}`),
    create: (data: CreateBatchPayload) =>
      request<LiveBatch>("/batches", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    update: (id: number, data: Partial<CreateBatchPayload>) =>
      request<LiveBatch>(`/batches/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    remove: (id: number) =>
      request<void>(`/batches/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  },

  stats: {
    get: () => request<LiveStats>("/stats"),
  },

  reports: {
    list: () => request<LiveReport[]>("/reports"),
    get: (id: number) => request<LiveReport>(`/reports/${id}`),
    create: (data: CreateReportPayload) =>
      request<LiveReport>("/reports", {
        method: "POST",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    update: (
      id: number,
      data: Partial<CreateReportPayload> & { status?: string },
    ) =>
      request<LiveReport>(`/reports/${id}`, {
        method: "PATCH",
        body: JSON.stringify(data),
      }),
    remove: (id: number) =>
      request<void>(`/reports/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
  },
};
````

````typescript
/**
 * DEMO END-USE CATALOGUE
 * Fit scores and evidence levels are illustrative expert-style judgements for
 * prototyping, not a regulatory or scientific determination.

type FitTuple = [0 | 1 | 2 | 3, EvidenceLevel, string];
````

````typescript
function build(r: Row): Feedstock {
  const [moisture, protein, lipid, fibre, ash] = r.comp;
  const carb = Math.max(0, +(100 - protein - lipid - fibre - ash).toFixed(1));
  const spread = (v: number, pct: number): [number, number] => [
    +(v * (1 - pct / 100)).toFixed(1),
    +(v * (1 + pct / 100)).toFixed(1),
  ];
  const n = r.compProv === "measured" ? Math.max(3, r.batches) : undefined;
  return {
    id: r.id,
    name: r.name,
    category: r.category,
    summary: r.summary,
    description: r.description,
    image: r.image,
    region: r.region,
    sourceType: r.sourceType,
    annualVolume: m(r.volume, "t/yr", "estimated", spread(r.volume, 20)),
    availability: r.availability,
    seasonality: r.season,
    transportKm: r.km,
    cost: m(r.cost, "USD/t", "estimated"),
    composition: {
      moisture: m(
        moisture,
        "% as received",
        r.compProv,
        spread(moisture, 6),
        n,
      ),
      protein: m(protein, "% DM", r.compProv, spread(protein, r.cv), n),
      lipid: m(lipid, "% DM", r.compProv, spread(lipid, r.cv + 4), n),
      fibre: m(fibre, "% DM", r.compProv, spread(fibre, 10), n),
      ash: m(ash, "% DM", r.compProv, spread(ash, 12), n),
      carbohydrate: m(carb, "% DM", "estimated"),
    },
    aminoAcids: Object.fromEntries(
      AA_KEYS.map((k, i) => [k, r.aa[i]]),
    ) as Record<AminoAcidKey, number>,
    aminoAcidProvenance: r.compProv === "measured" ? "measured" : "literature",
    physical: {
      bulkDensity: m(r.phys[0], "kg/m³", r.compProv),
      particleSize: m(r.phys[1], "mm (D50)", "estimated"),
      ph: m(r.phys[2], "pH", r.compProv),
      shelfLife: m(r.phys[3], "days, ambient", "estimated"),
    },
    variabilityCv: r.cv,
    flags: r.flags.map((f) => FLAGS[f]),
    status: r.status,
    batchCount: r.batches,
    lastUpdated: r.updated,
    tags: r.tags,
  };
}

export const FEEDSTOCKS: Feedstock[] = ROWS.map(build);

export const FEEDSTOCK_CATEGORIES = Array.from(
  new Set(FEEDSTOCKS.map((f) => f.category)),
);

/** Feedstocks highlighted in the dashboard spotlight (Stitch design order). */

  "coffee-pulp",
````

## File: frontend/src/data/types.ts
````typescript
/**
 * Domain types for BIOPATH AI.
 *
 * Every number shown in the UI travels with a `provenance` so the interface can
 * always tell measured, literature-sourced, estimated and demo values apart.
 * In this prototype ALL values are simulated (see `DATASET_STATUS`); the
 * provenance records the class of evidence the field is designed to hold.
 */

export type Provenance = "measured" | "literature" | "estimated" | "demo";

export interface Measure {
  value: number;
  unit: string;
  provenance: Provenance;
  /** Observed or expected range, when known. */
  range?: [number, number];
  /** Number of samples behind a measured value. */
  n?: number;
  note?: string;
}

export type RegionId =
  | "central-highlands"
  | "rift-valley"
  | "lake-basin"
  | "coastal-belt"
  | "western-plateau"
  | "eastern-lowlands";

export interface Region {
  id: RegionId;
  name: string;
  climate: string;
  processingHubs: number;
  /** 0–100 composite of road quality and cold-chain access (demo). */
  logisticsIndex: number;
  /** Map placement on the schematic region grid (0–100). */
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

export type FeedstockCategory =
  | "Agro-industrial residue"
  | "Brewery & distillery co-product"
  | "Oilseed cake"
  | "Fruit processing residue"
  | "Cereal milling by-product"
  | "Dairy & fishery side-stream"
  | "Aquatic biomass"
  | "Sugar industry co-product";

export type FlagSeverity = "info" | "warning" | "critical";

export interface RiskFlag {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  severity: FlagSeverity;
  detail: string;
}

export type ProfileStatus = "profiled" | "screening" | "pending";

export interface Composition {
  /** % as received */
  moisture: Measure;
  /** % dry matter */
  protein: Measure;
  lipid: Measure;
  fibre: Measure;
  ash: Measure;
  /** Non-structural carbohydrate, % DM, calculated by difference. */
  carbohydrate: Measure;
}

export type AminoAcidKey =
  "his" | "ile" | "leu" | "lys" | "saa" | "aaa" | "thr" | "trp" | "val";

export interface Feedstock {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  category: FeedstockCategory;
  summary: string;
  description: string;
  image?: string;
  region: RegionId;
  sourceType: string;
  annualVolume: Measure;
  availability: "Year-round" | "Seasonal" | "Intermittent";
  /** Relative monthly availability, Jan–Dec, 0–1. */
  seasonality: number[];
  transportKm: number;
  cost: Measure;
  composition: Composition;
  /** g per 100 g protein */
  aminoAcids: Record<AminoAcidKey, number>;
  aminoAcidProvenance: Provenance;
  physical: {
    bulkDensity: Measure;
    particleSize: Measure;
    ph: Measure;
    shelfLife: Measure;
  };
  /** Batch-to-batch coefficient of variation for protein, %. */
  variabilityCv: number;
  flags: RiskFlag[];
  status: ProfileStatus;
  batchCount: number;
  lastUpdated: string;
  tags: string[];
}

export type PathwayFamily =
  "Fermentation" | "Extraction" | "Bioconversion" | "Cultivation";

export interface Pathway {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  short: string;
  family: PathwayFamily;
  description: string;
  product: string;
  productProtein: [number, number];
  trl: number;
  durationDays: [number, number];
  waterM3PerT: number;
  energyKwhPerT: number;
  opexUsdPerT: number;
  capex: "Low" | "Medium" | "High";
  /** 1–5: ease of scaling with locally available equipment (demo). */
  scalability: number;
  requirements: string[];
  risks: string[];
}

export type EndUseSector =
  "Human food" | "Animal feed" | "Pet food" | "Industrial" | "Agriculture";

export type EvidenceLevel = "established" | "emerging" | "theoretical";

export interface PathwayFit {
  /** 0 = not suitable, 3 = strong fit */
  score: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3;
  evidence: EvidenceLevel;
  note: string;
}

export interface EndUse {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  sector: EndUseSector;
  description: string;
  minProtein: number;
  valueTier: "High" | "Medium" | "Low";
  indicativePrice: Measure;
  requirements: string[];
  regulatory: string;
  /** Flags that block this end-use until cleared. */
  blockingFlags: string[];
  pathwayFit: Record<string, PathwayFit>;
}

export interface Batch {
  lot: string;
  feedstockId: string;
  sampledOn: string;
  moisture: number;
  protein: number;
  lipid: number;
  ash: number;
  qc: "pass" | "review" | "fail";
  lab: string;
  provenance: Provenance;
}

export interface ResearchProject {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  feedstockId: string;
  stage: "In Progress" | "Pathway Review" | "Fingerprinting";
  updated: string;
  completion: number;
  image: string;
}

export interface ActivityItem {
  id: string;
  icon: string;
  title: string;
  detail: string;
  ago: string;
  tone: "default" | "critical";
  to?: string;
}

export type ReportType =
  | "Feedstock profile"
  | "Pathway comparison"
  | "Allocation scenario"
  | "End-use assessment"
  | "Batch QC summary";

export interface Report {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  type: ReportType;
  status: "Draft" | "In review" | "Published";
  createdOn: string;
  author: string;
  feedstockIds: string[];
  sections: string[];
  summary: string;
  pages: number;
}

export interface EvidenceRecord {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  kind: Provenance;
  scope: string;
  date: string;
}
````

````typescript
/* ---------- Batches: deterministic pseudo-random generation ---------- */

function mulberry32(seed: number) {
  return () => {
    seed |= 0;
    seed = (seed + 0x6d2b79f5) | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(seed ^ (seed >>> 15), 1 | seed);
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

const LABS = ["Partner lab A", "Partner lab B", "On-site QC"];

function lotPrefix(id: string) {
  return id
    .split("-")
    .map((w) => w[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase()
    .slice(0, 3);
}

function generateBatches(): Batch[] {
  const out: Batch[] = [];
  FEEDSTOCKS.forEach((f, fi) => {
    const rand = mulberry32(1000 + fi * 97);
    const gauss = () => {
      const u = Math.max(rand(), 1e-9);
      const v = rand();
      return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
    };
    const base = new Date("2026-11-24T00:00:00Z").getTime();
    const prefix = lotPrefix(f.id);
    const start = f.id === "coffee-pulp" ? 204 - f.batchCount + 1 : 100;
    for (let i = 0; i < f.batchCount; i++) {
      const sd = (f.composition.protein.value * f.variabilityCv) / 100;
      let protein = f.composition.protein.value + gauss() * sd;
      // a deliberate out-of-control point for the coffee pulp demo
      if (f.id === "coffee-pulp" && i === f.batchCount - 7)
        protein = f.composition.protein.value - 2.4 * sd;
      const moisture = f.composition.moisture.value + gauss() * 2.2;
      const lipid = Math.max(
        0.1,
        f.composition.lipid.value + gauss() * f.composition.lipid.value * 0.12,
      );
      const ash = Math.max(
        0.1,
        f.composition.ash.value + gauss() * f.composition.ash.value * 0.1,
      );
      const z = Math.abs(protein - f.composition.protein.value) / sd;
      const qc: Batch["qc"] = z > 2.2 ? "fail" : z > 1.8 ? "review" : "pass";
      const daysAgo = (f.batchCount - 1 - i) * 6 + Math.floor(rand() * 3);
      out.push({
        lot: `${prefix}-${start + i}`,
        feedstockId: f.id,
        sampledOn: new Date(base - daysAgo * 86400000)
          .toISOString()
          .slice(0, 10),
        moisture: +moisture.toFixed(1),
        protein: +protein.toFixed(2),
        lipid: +lipid.toFixed(2),
        ash: +ash.toFixed(2),
        qc,
        lab: LABS[Math.floor(rand() * LABS.length)],
        provenance: "measured",
      });
    }
  });
  return out.sort((a, b) => b.sampledOn.localeCompare(a.sampledOn));
}

export const BATCHES: Batch[] = generateBatches();

/* ---------- Reports ---------- */

export const REPORTS: Report[] = [

/* ---------- Evidence register (per feedstock, generic, demo) ---------- */

export function evidenceFor(feedstockId: string): EvidenceRecord[] {
  const f = FEEDSTOCKS.find((x) => x.id === feedstockId);
  if (!f) return [];
  const recs: EvidenceRecord[] = [];
  if (f.batchCount > 0)
    recs.push({
      id: `EV-${lotPrefix(f.id)}-01`,
      title: `Proximate analysis across ${f.batchCount} batches`,
      kind: "measured",
      scope: "Moisture, protein, lipid, fibre, ash",
      date: f.lastUpdated.slice(0, 10),
    });
  recs.push({
    id: `EV-${lotPrefix(f.id)}-02`,
    title: `Literature composition range — ${f.category.toLowerCase()}`,
    kind: "literature",
    scope: "Reference ranges for comparison (citation to be attached)",
    date: "2026-09-30",
  });
  recs.push({
    id: `EV-${lotPrefix(f.id)}-03`,
    title: "Annual volume estimate from processor survey",
    kind: "estimated",
    scope: "Volume, seasonality, logistics",
    date: "2026-08-14",
  });
  recs.push({
    id: `EV-${lotPrefix(f.id)}-04`,
    title: "Pathway yield model output (BIOPATH heuristic v0.3)",
    kind: "estimated",
    scope: "Protein yield, water, energy, cost",
    date: "2026-11-01",
  });
  recs.push({
    id: `EV-${lotPrefix(f.id)}-05`,
    title: "Prototype placeholder values",
    kind: "demo",
    scope: "All figures in this prototype dataset",
    date: "2026-11-24",
  });
  return recs;
}
````

````typescript
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ValidatedForm } from "./validated-form";

describe("ValidatedForm", () => {
  it("validates input before calling the submit handler", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const onSubmit = vi.fn();
    render(<ValidatedForm onSubmit={onSubmit} />);

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Email"), "invalid");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));

    expect(
      await screen.findByText("Enter a valid email address."),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Email")).toHaveAttribute(
      "aria-invalid",
      "true",
    );
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Email")).toHaveAccessibleDescription(
      "Use the address where we can reach you. Enter a valid email address.",
    );
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("prevents duplicate submissions while saving", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const onSubmit = vi.fn(() => new Promise<void>(() => {}));
    render(<ValidatedForm onSubmit={onSubmit} />);

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Email"), "test@example.com");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));
    const saving = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Saving…" });
    await user.click(saving);

    expect(saving).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Email")).toBeDisabled();
    expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shows success when the submit handler resolves", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const onSubmit = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    render(<ValidatedForm onSubmit={onSubmit} />);

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Email"), "test@example.com");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));

    expect(await screen.findByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent(
      "Your submission was saved.",
    );
    expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ email: "test@example.com" });

    await user.clear(screen.getByLabelText("Email"));
    expect(screen.queryByRole("status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("preserves input on failure and allows retry", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const onSubmit = vi
      .fn()
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("Service unavailable"))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(undefined);
    render(<ValidatedForm onSubmit={onSubmit} />);

    await user.type(screen.getByLabelText("Email"), "test@example.com");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));

    expect(await screen.findByRole("alert")).toHaveTextContent(
      "Your submission couldn’t be saved. Please try again.",
    );
    expect(screen.getByLabelText("Email")).toHaveValue("test@example.com");
    expect(screen.queryByRole("status")).not.toBeInTheDocument();

    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Submit" }));
    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(screen.queryByRole("alert")).not.toBeInTheDocument(),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByRole("status")).toBeVisible();
    expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });
});
````

````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm } from "react-hook-form";
import { zodResolver } from "@hookform/resolvers/zod";
import { z } from "zod";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  Form,
  FormControl,
  FormDescription,
  FormField,
  FormItem,
  FormLabel,
  FormMessage,
} from "@/components/ui/form";

const emailSchema = z.object({
  email: z.email("Enter a valid email address."),
});

type EmailValues = z.infer<typeof emailSchema>;

export function ValidatedForm({
  onSubmit,
}: {
  onSubmit: (values: EmailValues) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [submitted, setSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const form = useForm<EmailValues>({
    resolver: zodResolver(emailSchema),
    defaultValues: { email: "" },
  });

  const submit = form.handleSubmit(async (values) => {
    setSubmitted(false);
    form.clearErrors("root");
    try {
      await onSubmit(values);
      setSubmitted(true);
    } catch {
      form.setError("root", {
        message: "Your submission couldn’t be saved. Please try again.",
      });
    }
  });

  return (
    <Form {...form}>
      <form
        onSubmit={submit}
        onChange={() => setSubmitted(false)}
        noValidate
        className="max-w-md space-y-6"
      >
        <fieldset disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting} className="space-y-6">
          <FormField
            control={form.control}
            name="email"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <FormItem>
                <FormLabel>Email</FormLabel>
                <FormControl>
                  <Input
                    type="email"
                    autoComplete="email"
                    required
                    {...field}
                  />
                </FormControl>
                <FormDescription>
                  Use the address where we can reach you.
                </FormDescription>
                <FormMessage />
              </FormItem>
            )}
          />
          {form.formState.errors.root && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-destructive">
              {form.formState.errors.root.message}
            </p>
          )}
          {submitted && <p role="status">Your submission was saved.</p>}
          <Button type="submit" disabled={form.formState.isSubmitting}>
            {form.formState.isSubmitting ? "Saving…" : "Submit"}
          </Button>
        </fieldset>
      </form>
    </Form>
  );
}
````

````typescript
const nf = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US");

export function fmt(v: number, digits = 0) {
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("en-US", {
    minimumFractionDigits: digits,
    maximumFractionDigits: digits,
  }).format(v);
}

export function fmtInt(v: number) {
  return nf.format(Math.round(v));
}

/** Compact large numbers: 42,000 → 42k, 1.2M. */
export function fmtCompact(v: number) {
  if (Math.abs(v) >= 1_000_000) return `${fmt(v / 1_000_000, 1)}M`;
  if (Math.abs(v) >= 10_000) return `${fmt(v / 1000, 0)}k`;
  if (Math.abs(v) >= 1000) return `${fmt(v / 1000, 1)}k`;
  return fmt(v, v < 10 && v % 1 ? 1 : 0);
}

export function fmtDate(iso: string) {
  return new Date(iso).toLocaleDateString("en-GB", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "short",
    year: "numeric",
    timeZone: "UTC",
  });
}

export const MONTHS = [
  "Jan",
  "Feb",
  "Mar",
  "Apr",
  "May",
  "Jun",
  "Jul",
  "Aug",
  "Sep",
  "Oct",
  "Nov",
  "Dec",
];
````

````typescript
import { AA_REFERENCE, FEEDSTOCKS } from "@/data/feedstocks";
import { END_USES } from "@/data/end-uses";
import { PATHWAYS } from "@/data/pathways";
import type {
  AminoAcidKey,
  EndUse,
  EndUseSector,
  Feedstock,
  Pathway,
} from "@/data/types";

/**
 * BIOPATH heuristic scoring model (v0.3, demo).
 *
 * Transparent rule-based estimates used to rank options in the prototype.
 * Outputs are planning-grade ESTIMATES derived from demo inputs — they are not
 * validated process models and should be replaced by calibrated models.
 */

const clamp = (v: number, lo = 0, hi = 100) => Math.min(hi, Math.max(lo, v));

/** Score how close `v` is to a target band, 100 inside it, decaying outside. */
function band(v: number, lo: number, hi: number, softness: number) {
  if (v >= lo && v <= hi) return 100;
  const d = v < lo ? lo - v : v - hi;
  return clamp(100 - (d / softness) * 100);
}

const has = (f: Feedstock, id: string) => f.flags.some((x) => x.id === id);

export interface SuitabilityResult {
  score: number;
  reasons: string[];
}

/** Technical suitability of a feedstock for a pathway, 0–100. */
export function suitability(f: Feedstock, p: Pathway): SuitabilityResult {
  const c = f.composition;
  const protein = c.protein.value;
  const carb = c.carbohydrate.value;
  const fibre = c.fibre.value;
  const lipid = c.lipid.value;
  const moisture = c.moisture.value;
  const reasons: string[] = [];
  let s = 60;

  switch (p.id) {
    case "fungal-ssf": {
      s =
        0.4 * band(moisture, 50, 75, 30) +
        0.35 * clamp(carb * 2 + fibre * 0.6) +
        0.25 * clamp(100 - lipid * 3);
      if (moisture < 30 || moisture > 90)
        reasons.push("Moisture far from SSF window — adjustment needed");
      if (has(f, "caffeine") || has(f, "tannins"))
        reasons.push("Fungi can degrade polyphenols during fermentation");
      if (moisture > 90) s -= 15;
      break;
    }
    case "submerged-myco": {
      s =
        0.6 * clamp(carb * 1.6) +
        0.2 * clamp(100 - fibre) +
        0.2 * clamp(100 - lipid * 3);
      if (fibre > 40)
        reasons.push("Fibrous solids need hydrolysis before liquid culture");
      break;
    }
    case "enzymatic-hydrolysis": {
      s =
        0.6 * clamp(((protein - 8) / 30) * 100) +
        0.25 * clamp(100 - lipid * 3) +
        0.15 * clamp(100 - fibre * 0.8);
      if (protein < 15)
        reasons.push("Protein below 15% DM limits recoverable yield");
      break;
    }
    case "alkaline-extraction": {
      s =
        0.7 * clamp(((protein - 12) / 30) * 100) + 0.3 * clamp(100 - lipid * 4);
      if (protein < 20)
        reasons.push("Protein below 20% DM — extraction yields are low");
      if (lipid > 10)
        reasons.push("Residual oil requires defatting before extraction");
      break;
    }
    case "insect-bsf": {
      s =
        0.45 * band(moisture, 60, 82, 30) +
        0.35 * clamp(protein * 3 + carb) +
        0.2 * clamp(100 - fibre);
      if (has(f, "metals"))
        reasons.push("Larvae can bioaccumulate metals from substrate");
      if (f.category === "Dairy & fishery side-stream")
        reasons.push(
          "Animal-origin substrates restricted for insect feed in many markets",
        );
      break;
    }
    case "yeast-scp": {
      s =
        0.75 * clamp(((carb - 10) / 50) * 100) +
        0.25 * clamp(100 - fibre * 1.2);
      if (carb < 30)
        reasons.push("Limited fermentable sugars without hydrolysis");
      break;
    }
    case "microalgae-mixo": {
      s = 0.6 * clamp(carb * 1.2) + 0.4 * band(moisture, 85, 100, 40);
      if (moisture < 80)
        reasons.push(
          "Requires dissolution or a liquid extract as carbon source",
        );
      break;
    }
  }

  if (
    has(f, "lignin") &&
    ["submerged-myco", "yeast-scp", "enzymatic-hydrolysis"].includes(p.id)
  ) {
    s -= 15;
    reasons.push("Lignin recalcitrance — pretreatment adds cost");
  }
  if (has(f, "cyanogenic")) {
    s -= 8;
    reasons.push("Detoxification step required first");
  }
  if (has(f, "spoilage") && p.durationDays[0] > 7) {
    s -= 5;
  }
  return { score: Math.round(clamp(s)), reasons };
}

export interface PathwayEstimate {
  pathway: Pathway;
  suitability: number;
  reasons: string[];
  /** kg protein per tonne feedstock DM */
  proteinYield: number;
  /** m³ water per tonne DM */
  water: number;
  /** kWh per tonne DM */
  energy: number;
  /** USD per kg protein produced */
  costPerKgProtein: number;
  scalability: number;
  endUseFit: number;
}

/** Protein output per tonne DM, kg — heuristic mass balance. */
export function proteinYield(
  f: Feedstock,
  p: Pathway,
  suit = suitability(f, p).score,
) {
  const pr = f.composition.protein.value * 10; // kg protein per t DM in substrate
  const cb = f.composition.carbohydrate.value * 10;
  const fb = f.composition.fibre.value * 10;
  let y = 0;
  switch (p.id) {
    case "fungal-ssf":
      y = pr * 0.85 + (cb + fb * 0.25) * 0.11;
      break;
    case "submerged-myco":
      y = pr * 0.4 + (cb + fb * 0.1) * 0.2;
      break;
    case "enzymatic-hydrolysis":
      y = pr * 0.68;
      break;
    case "alkaline-extraction":
      y = pr * 0.58;
      break;
    case "insect-bsf":
      y = (180 + pr * 0.15) * 0.42;
      break;
    case "yeast-scp":
      y = pr * 0.15 + cb * 0.24;
      break;
    case "microalgae-mixo":
      y = cb * 0.17;
      break;
  }
  // suitability acts as a realisation factor
  return Math.round(y * (0.55 + 0.45 * (suit / 100)));
}

export function endUseFitFor(p: Pathway, sector?: EndUseSector | "Any") {
  const pool =
    sector && sector !== "Any"
      ? END_USES.filter((e) => e.sector === sector)
      : END_USES;
  if (!pool.length) return 0;
  const best = Math.max(...pool.map((e) => e.pathwayFit[p.id]?.score ?? 0));
  const avg =
    pool.reduce((a, e) => a + (e.pathwayFit[p.id]?.score ?? 0), 0) /
    pool.length;
  return Math.round(((best * 0.6 + avg * 0.4) / 3) * 100);
}

export function estimate(
  f: Feedstock,
  p: Pathway,
  sector: EndUseSector | "Any" = "Any",
): PathwayEstimate {
  const s = suitability(f, p);
  const y = proteinYield(f, p, s.score);
  const fibrePenalty = 1 + Math.max(0, f.composition.fibre.value - 40) / 100;
  const water = +(p.waterM3PerT * fibrePenalty).toFixed(1);
  const energy = Math.round(p.energyKwhPerT * fibrePenalty);
  // single dry-matter fraction shared by both cost terms; guarded against a zero denominator
  const dmFraction = 1 - f.composition.moisture.value / 100;
  const dm = dmFraction > 0 ? dmFraction : 1;
  const feedCost = f.cost.value / dm;
  const transport = (f.transportKm * 0.12) / dm;
  const cost =
    y > 0 ? +((p.opexUsdPerT + feedCost + transport) / y).toFixed(2) : 99;
  return {
    pathway: p,
    suitability: s.score,
    reasons: s.reasons,
    proteinYield: y,
    water,
    energy,
    costPerKgProtein: cost,
    scalability: p.scalability,
    endUseFit: endUseFitFor(p, sector),
  };
}

export type Criterion =
  | "suitability"
  | "yield"
  | "water"
  | "energy"
  | "cost"
  | "scalability"
  | "endUse";

export const CRITERIA: { id: Criterion; label: string; hint: string }[] = [
  {
    id: "suitability",
    label: "Feedstock suitability",
    hint: "Composition fit to pathway requirements",
  },
  {
    id: "yield",
    label: "Protein yield",
    hint: "kg protein per tonne dry matter",
  },
  { id: "water", label: "Water intensity", hint: "Lower is better" },
  { id: "energy", label: "Energy intensity", hint: "Lower is better" },
  {
    id: "cost",
    label: "Economic feasibility",
    hint: "Cost per kg protein — lower is better",
  },
  {
    id: "scalability",
    label: "Scalability",
    hint: "Ease of scale-up with local equipment",
  },
  {
    id: "endUse",
    label: "End-use fit",
    hint: "Fit to the selected target market",
  },
];

export type Weights = Record<Criterion, number>;

export const DEFAULT_WEIGHTS: Weights = {
  suitability: 5,
  yield: 4,
  water: 3,
  energy: 3,
  cost: 4,
  scalability: 2,
  endUse: 3,
};

export interface RankedPathway extends PathwayEstimate {
  normalized: Record<Criterion, number>;
  total: number;
}

/** Min–max normalise each criterion across candidates and combine with weights. */
export function rankPathways(
  f: Feedstock,
  weights: Weights,
  sector: EndUseSector | "Any" = "Any",
  pathways = PATHWAYS,
): RankedPathway[] {
  const est = pathways.map((p) => estimate(f, p, sector));
  const norm = (vals: number[], v: number, invert = false) => {
    const lo = Math.min(...vals);
    const hi = Math.max(...vals);
    if (hi === lo) return 100;
    const r = ((v - lo) / (hi - lo)) * 100;
    return invert ? 100 - r : r;
  };
  const col = (k: keyof PathwayEstimate) => est.map((e) => e[k] as number);
  const totalW = Object.values(weights).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) || 1;
  return est
    .map((e) => {
      const normalized: Record<Criterion, number> = {
        suitability: e.suitability,
        yield: norm(col("proteinYield"), e.proteinYield),
        water: norm(col("water"), e.water, true),
        energy: norm(col("energy"), e.energy, true),
        cost: norm(col("costPerKgProtein"), e.costPerKgProtein, true),
        scalability: (e.scalability / 5) * 100,
        endUse: e.endUseFit,
      };
      const total =
        (Object.keys(weights) as Criterion[]).reduce(
          (a, k) => a + normalized[k] * weights[k],
          0,
        ) / totalW;
      return { ...e, normalized, total: Math.round(total) };
    })
    .sort((a, b) => b.total - a.total);
}

/* ---------- Protein quality ---------- */

export function aminoAcidScore(f: Feedstock) {
  const ratios = (Object.keys(AA_REFERENCE) as AminoAcidKey[]).map((k) => ({
    key: k,
    ratio: f.aminoAcids[k] / AA_REFERENCE[k],
  }));
  const limiting = ratios.reduce((a, b) => (b.ratio < a.ratio ? b : a));
  return { score: Math.min(1, limiting.ratio), limiting: limiting.key, ratios };
}

/* ---------- End-use suitability for a feedstock ---------- */

export interface EndUseAssessment {
  endUse: EndUse;
  score: number;
  bestPathway: Pathway;
  blocked: string[];
  evidence: EndUse["pathwayFit"][string]["evidence"];
}

export function assessEndUses(f: Feedstock): EndUseAssessment[] {
  return END_USES.map((e) => {
    let best: { p: Pathway; v: number } | null = null;
    for (const p of PATHWAYS) {
      const fit = e.pathwayFit[p.id]?.score ?? 0;
      const s = suitability(f, p).score;
      const v = (fit / 3) * 0.55 * 100 + s * 0.45;
      if (!best || v > best.v) best = { p, v };
    }
    const blocked = f.flags
      .filter((fl) => e.blockingFlags.includes(fl.id))
      .map((fl) => fl.label);
    const pf = e.pathwayFit[best!.p.id];
    return {
      endUse: e,
      score: Math.round(blocked.length ? best!.v * 0.5 : best!.v),
      bestPathway: best!.p,
      blocked,
      evidence: pf.evidence,
    };
  }).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
}

/* ---------- Resource allocation ---------- */

export interface AllocationInput {
  feedstockIds: string[];
  /** share of each feedstock's annual volume made available, 0–1 */
  availableShare: number;
  waterCap: number; // m³/yr
  energyCap: number; // MWh/yr
  objective: "protein" | "water" | "cost";
  sector: EndUseSector | "Any";
  minSuitability: number;
}

export interface AllocationLine {
  feedstock: Feedstock;
  pathway: Pathway;
  tonnesDm: number;
  protein: number; // t/yr
  water: number; // m³/yr
  energy: number; // MWh/yr
  cost: number; // USD/yr
  suitability: number;
}

export interface AllocationResult {
  lines: AllocationLine[];
  unallocated: { feedstock: Feedstock; tonnesDm: number; reason: string }[];
  totals: {
    protein: number;
    water: number;
    energy: number;
    cost: number;
    tonnesDm: number;
    availableDm: number;
  };
  binding: string[];
}

/**
 * Greedy allocation: rank every feasible feedstock×pathway pair by the chosen
 * objective per unit of the scarcest resource, then fill until volume, water
 * or energy caps bind. Transparent and fast — a placeholder for an LP solver.
 */
export function allocate(input: AllocationInput): AllocationResult {
  const fs = FEEDSTOCKS.filter((f) => input.feedstockIds.includes(f.id));
  const remaining = new Map(
    fs.map((f) => [
      f.id,
      f.annualVolume.value *
        (1 - f.composition.moisture.value / 100) *
        input.availableShare,
    ]),
  );
  const availableDm = [...remaining.values()].reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  let water = input.waterCap;
  let energy = input.energyCap;
  const binding = new Set<string>();

  const pairs = fs.flatMap((f) =>
    PATHWAYS.map((p) => ({ f, p, e: estimate(f, p, input.sector) })).filter(
      (x) =>
        x.e.suitability >= input.minSuitability &&
        x.e.endUseFit > 0 &&
        x.e.proteinYield > 0,
    ),
  );
  const value = (x: (typeof pairs)[number]) => {
    const kg = x.e.proteinYield;
    if (input.objective === "protein")
      return kg * (0.6 + x.e.suitability / 250);
    if (input.objective === "water") return kg / Math.max(0.5, x.e.water);
    return kg / Math.max(0.1, x.e.costPerKgProtein * kg);
  };
  pairs.sort((a, b) => value(b) - value(a));

  const lines: AllocationLine[] = [];
  for (const x of pairs) {
    const left = remaining.get(x.f.id) ?? 0;
    if (left <= 1) continue;
    const byWater = x.e.water > 0 ? water / x.e.water : Infinity;
    const byEnergy = x.e.energy > 0 ? (energy * 1000) / x.e.energy : Infinity;
    const t = Math.floor(Math.min(left, byWater, byEnergy));
    if (t <= 0) {
      if (byWater < 1) binding.add("Water cap");
      if (byEnergy < 1) binding.add("Energy cap");
      continue;
    }
    if (t < left) {
      if (byWater <= byEnergy && byWater < left) binding.add("Water cap");
      else if (byEnergy < left) binding.add("Energy cap");
    }
    remaining.set(x.f.id, left - t);
    water -= t * x.e.water;
    energy -= (t * x.e.energy) / 1000;
    const protein = (t * x.e.proteinYield) / 1000;
    lines.push({
      feedstock: x.f,
      pathway: x.p,
      tonnesDm: t,
      protein,
      water: t * x.e.water,
      energy: (t * x.e.energy) / 1000,
      cost: protein * 1000 * x.e.costPerKgProtein,
      suitability: x.e.suitability,
    });
  }

  const unallocated = fs
    .map((f) => ({
      feedstock: f,
      tonnesDm: Math.round(remaining.get(f.id) ?? 0),
    }))
    .filter((u) => u.tonnesDm > 1)
    .map((u) => ({
      ...u,
      reason: pairs.some((p) => p.f.id === u.feedstock.id)
        ? [...binding].join(" & ") || "Resource cap reached"
        : "No pathway meets suitability threshold",
    }));

  const sum = (
    k: keyof Pick<
      AllocationLine,
      "protein" | "water" | "energy" | "cost" | "tonnesDm"
    >,
  ) => lines.reduce((a, l) => a + l[k], 0);
  return {
    lines,
    unallocated,
    totals: {
      protein: sum("protein"),
      water: sum("water"),
      energy: sum("energy"),
      cost: sum("cost"),
      tonnesDm: sum("tonnesDm"),
      availableDm,
    },
    binding: [...binding],
  };
}
````

````typescript
import { clsx, type ClassValue } from "clsx";
import { twMerge } from "tailwind-merge";
````

````typescript
import { fmt, fmtCompact, fmtInt } from "@/lib/format";
import type { EndUseSector, Feedstock } from "@/data/types";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/allocation")({
  component: AllocationPage,
});

function AllocationPage() {
  const [feedstocks, setFeedstocks] = useState<Feedstock[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [availableShare, setAvailableShare] = useState(60);
  const [waterCap, setWaterCap] = useState(120_000);
  const [energyCap, setEnergyCap] = useState(8_000);
  const [minSuitability, setMinSuitability] = useState(40);
  const [objective, setObjective] = useState<"protein" | "water" | "cost">(
    "protein",
  );
  const [sector] = useState<EndUseSector | "Any">("Any");

  useEffect(() => {
    listFeedstocks().then((data) => {
      setFeedstocks(data);
      // Default: spotlight feedstocks
      const def = new Set(
        [
          "coffee-pulp",
          "brewers-spent-grain",
          "soy-okara",
          "cane-molasses",
          "fish-processing",
        ].filter((id) => data.some((f) => f.id === id)),
      );
      setSelected(def);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const input: AllocationInput = useMemo(
    () => ({
      feedstockIds: [...selected],
      availableShare: availableShare / 100,
      waterCap,
      energyCap,
      objective,
      sector,
      minSuitability,
    }),
    [
      selected,
      availableShare,
      waterCap,
      energyCap,
      objective,
      sector,
      minSuitability,
    ],
  );

  const result = useMemo(
    () => (selected.size > 0 && feedstocks.length > 0 ? allocate(input) : null),
    [input, feedstocks, selected],
  );

  const toggle = (id: string) =>
    setSelected((prev) => {
      const next = new Set(prev);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Bioconversion"
        title="Resource Allocation"
        description="Greedy allocation of feedstock volumes to pathways under water, energy and volume constraints. A transparent placeholder for an LP solver."
        actions={<DemoChip />}
      />

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
        <StatCard
          label="Protein output"
          value={
            result ? `${fmtCompact(result.totals.protein * 1000)} kg` : "—"
          }
          icon="science"
          footnote="per year, dry-matter basis"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Feedstock allocated"
          value={result ? `${fmtInt(result.totals.tonnesDm)} t` : "—"}
          icon="eco"
          delta={
            result
              ? `${fmt(Math.round((result.totals.tonnesDm / Math.max(1, result.totals.availableDm)) * 100))}%`
              : undefined
          }
          deltaTone="brand"
          footnote="of available dry matter"
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Water use"
          value={result ? `${fmtCompact(result.totals.water)} m³` : "—"}
          icon="water_drop"
          delta={result ? `cap ${fmtCompact(waterCap)} m³` : undefined}
          deltaTone={
            result && result.totals.water > waterCap * 0.95 ? "risk" : "muted"
          }
        />
        <StatCard
          label="Energy use"
          value={result ? `${fmtCompact(result.totals.energy)} MWh` : "—"}
          icon="bolt"
          delta={result ? `cap ${fmtCompact(energyCap)} MWh` : undefined}
          deltaTone={
            result && result.totals.energy > energyCap * 0.95 ? "risk" : "muted"
          }
        />
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12">
        {/* Inputs panel */}
        <Panel className="space-y-5 lg:col-span-5">
          <SectionHeader
            title="Scenario inputs"
            description="Select feedstocks and set constraints."
          />

          {loading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-64" />
          ) : (
            <div className="max-h-72 space-y-1 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
              {feedstocks.map((f) => (
                <label
                  key={f.id}
                  className="flex cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-1.5 hover:bg-surface-high"
                >
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={selected.has(f.id)}
                    onChange={() => toggle(f.id)}
                    className="size-4 accent-brand"
                  />
                  <span className="flex-1 text-sm text-on-surface">
                    {f.name}
                  </span>
                  <span className="type-data text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {fmtCompact(f.annualVolume.value)} t/yr
                  </span>
                </label>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="space-y-4 border-t border-hairline pt-4">
            <RangeField
              id="alloc-share"
              label="Available share"
              value={availableShare}
              min={10}
              max={100}
              step={5}
              onChange={setAvailableShare}
              format={(v) => `${v}%`}
              hint="Fraction of each feedstock's annual volume diverted to protein production."
            />
            <RangeField
              id="alloc-water"
              label="Water cap"
              value={waterCap}
              min={20_000}
              max={500_000}
              step={10_000}
              onChange={setWaterCap}
              format={(v) => `${fmtCompact(v)} m³/yr`}
            />
            <RangeField
              id="alloc-energy"
              label="Energy cap"
              value={energyCap}
              min={1_000}
              max={50_000}
              step={500}
              onChange={setEnergyCap}
              format={(v) => `${fmtCompact(v)} MWh/yr`}
            />
            <RangeField
              id="alloc-suit"
              label="Min suitability"
              value={minSuitability}
              min={20}
              max={80}
              step={5}
              onChange={setMinSuitability}
              format={(v) => `${v}%`}
              hint="Discard feedstock × pathway pairs below this technical suitability."
            />
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">Objective</p>
              <SegmentedControl
                label="Optimisation objective"
                value={objective}
                onChange={setObjective}
                options={[
                  { value: "protein", label: "Max protein" },
                  { value: "water", label: "Water-efficient" },
                  { value: "cost", label: "Cost-efficient" },
                ]}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </Panel>

        {/* Results */}
        <div className="space-y-6 lg:col-span-7">
          {!result || result.lines.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon="pie_chart"
              title="No allocation"
              description={
                selected.size === 0
                  ? "Select at least one feedstock to run the allocation."
                  : "No feedstock × pathway pair meets the suitability threshold. Try lowering it."
              }
              action={
                selected.size === 0 ? null : (
                  <Button
                    variant="outline"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setMinSuitability(Math.max(20, minSuitability - 10))
                    }
                  >
                    Lower threshold to {Math.max(20, minSuitability - 10)}%
                  </Button>
                )
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <Panel>
                <SectionHeader
                  title="Allocation result"
                  badge={
                    result.binding.length > 0 ? (
                      <StatusPill tone="amber">
                        Binding: {result.binding.join(" & ")}
                      </StatusPill>
                    ) : (
                      <StatusPill tone="sage">Within all caps</StatusPill>
                    )
                  }
                />
                <div className="mt-4 overflow-x-auto">
                  <Table>
                    <TableHeader>
                      <TableRow>
                        <TableHead>Feedstock</TableHead>
                        <TableHead>Pathway</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">t DM</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Protein</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Water</TableHead>
                        <TableHead className="text-right">Suit.</TableHead>
                      </TableRow>
                    </TableHeader>
                    <TableBody>
                      {result.lines.map((l, i) => (
                        <TableRow
                          key={`${l.feedstock.id}-${l.pathway.id}-${i}`}
                        >
                          <TableCell className="font-medium">
                            {l.feedstock.name}

                            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                              {l.pathway.short}
                            </span>
                          </TableCell>

                            {fmtInt(l.tonnesDm)}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="type-data text-right">
                            {fmt(l.protein, 1)} t
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="type-data text-right">

                            <ScoreBar

                              tone={scoreTone(l.suitability)}
                            />

                        </TableRow>
                      ))}
                    </TableBody>
                  </Table>
                </div>
              </Panel>

              <Panel>
                <SectionHeader title="Protein output by feedstock" />
                <div className="mt-4">
                  <GroupedBarChart
                    ariaLabel="Protein output by feedstock"
                    categories={result.lines.map(
                      (l) => l.feedstock.name.split(" ")[0],
                    )}
                    series={[
                      {
                        key: "protein",
                        label: "Protein (t/yr)",
                        color: "var(--brand)",
                        values: result.lines.map(

                      },
                    ]}
                    yFormat={(v) => `${v}t`}

              {result.unallocated.length > 0 && (
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { z } from "zod";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import {
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  Panel,
  SectionHeader,
  StatusPill,
  scoreTone,
} from "@/components/common/page";
import { MeasureValue } from "@/components/common/provenance";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { listFeedstocks, listEndUses } from "@/data/api";
import { assessEndUses, type EndUseAssessment } from "@/lib/scoring";
import type { EndUse, EndUseSector, Feedstock } from "@/data/types";
import { fmt } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/end-use")({
  validateSearch: z.object({ endUse: z.string().optional() }),
  component: EndUsePage,
});

const SECTOR_COLORS: Record<EndUseSector, string> = {
  "Human food": "bg-mint text-on-mint",
  "Animal feed": "bg-amber-soft text-amber-ink",
  "Pet food": "bg-surface-high text-on-surface-variant",
  Industrial: "bg-surface-low text-on-surface-variant",
  Agriculture: "bg-sage text-forest",
};

function EndUsePage() {
  const [feedstocks, setFeedstocks] = useState<Feedstock[]>([]);
  const [endUses, setEndUses] = useState<EndUse[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [feedstockId, setFeedstockId] = useState("");
  const [sectorFilter, setSectorFilter] = useState<EndUseSector | "All">("All");

  useEffect(() => {
    Promise.all([listFeedstocks(), listEndUses()]).then(([fs, eu]) => {
      setFeedstocks(fs);
      setEndUses(eu);
      if (fs.length > 0) setFeedstockId(fs[0].id);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const feedstock = feedstocks.find((f) => f.id === feedstockId);
  const assessments: EndUseAssessment[] = useMemo(
    () => (feedstock ? assessEndUses(feedstock) : []),
    [feedstock],
  );

  const filtered = useMemo(
    () =>
      sectorFilter === "All"
        ? assessments
        : assessments.filter((a) => a.endUse.sector === sectorFilter),
    [assessments, sectorFilter],
  );

  const sectors = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(endUses.map((e) => e.sector))),
    [endUses],
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Product & Market"
        title="End-Use Intelligence"
        description="Evaluate feedstock × pathway suitability for food, feed, pet food and industrial applications. Fit scores are expert-style heuristic judgements."
      />

      {/* Controls */}
      <Panel className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <div className="flex-1 min-w-48">
          <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
            Feedstock
          </label>
          {loading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-10 w-full" />
          ) : (
            <Select value={feedstockId} onValueChange={setFeedstockId}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {feedstocks.map((f) => (
                  <SelectItem key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {f.name}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="min-w-40">
          <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
            Sector
          </label>
          <Select
            value={sectorFilter}
            onValueChange={(v) => setSectorFilter(v as typeof sectorFilter)}
          >
            <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="All">All sectors</SelectItem>
              {sectors.map((s) => (
                <SelectItem key={s} value={s}>
                  {s}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </Panel>

      {!feedstock ? (
        loading ? (
          <Skeleton className="h-96 rounded-xl" />
        ) : (
          <EmptyState icon="category" title="No feedstocks loaded" />
        )
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <Link
              to="/feedstocks/$feedstockId"
              params={{ feedstockId: feedstock.id }}
              className="flex items-center gap-2 text-brand-strong hover:underline"
            >
              <Icon name="eco" size={18} />
              <span className="font-medium">{feedstock.name}</span>
            </Link>
            <Badge variant="outline">{feedstock.category}</Badge>
            {feedstock.flags.map((f) => (
              <Badge
                key={f.id}
                variant="outline"
                className={cn(
                  "text-xs",
                  f.severity === "critical"
                    ? "border-risk/40 text-risk-ink"
                    : f.severity === "warning"
                      ? "border-amber/40 text-amber-ink"
                      : "",
                )}
              >
                {f.severity === "critical" && (
                  <Icon name="warning" size={12} className="mr-1 text-risk" />
                )}
                {f.label}
              </Badge>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4">
            {loading ? (
              Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
                <Skeleton key={i} className="h-32 rounded-xl" />
              ))
            ) : filtered.length === 0 ? (
              <EmptyState title="No end uses match the selected sector" />
            ) : (
              filtered.map((a) => (
                <EndUseCard
                  key={a.endUse.id}
                  assessment={a}
                  feedstock={feedstock}
                />
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      {/* End-use catalogue */}
      <section className="space-y-4">
        <SectionHeader
          title="End-use catalogue"
          description="All product categories with minimum protein requirements and pathway compatibility."
        />
        <div className="overflow-x-auto rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-card">
          <Table>
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow>
                <TableHead>End use</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Sector</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Min protein</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Value tier</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Price (est.)</TableHead>
                <TableHead>Blocking flags</TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {endUses.map((e) => (
                <TableRow key={e.id}>
                  <TableCell>
                    <p className="font-medium">{e.name}</p>
                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-xs">
                      {e.description}
                    </p>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <span
                      className={cn(
                        "inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium",
                        SECTOR_COLORS[e.sector],
                      )}
                    >
                      {e.sector}
                    </span>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="type-data">{e.minProtein}%</TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <StatusPill
                      tone={
                        e.valueTier === "High"
                          ? "sage"
                          : e.valueTier === "Medium"
                            ? "amber"
                            : "neutral"
                      }
                    >
                      {e.valueTier}
                    </StatusPill>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell>
                    <MeasureValue m={e.indicativePrice} />
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="max-w-xs text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    {e.blockingFlags.join(", ")}
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              ))}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function EndUseCard({
  assessment,
  feedstock,
}: {
  assessment: EndUseAssessment;
  feedstock: Feedstock;
}) {
  const { endUse: eu, score, bestPathway, blocked, evidence } = assessment;
  const blocked_bool = blocked.length > 0;

  return (
    <Card className={cn("p-5", blocked_bool && "opacity-70")}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <p className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{eu.name}</p>
            <span
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium",
                SECTOR_COLORS[eu.sector],
              )}
            >
              {eu.sector}
            </span>
            <StatusPill
              tone={
                eu.valueTier === "High"
                  ? "sage"
                  : eu.valueTier === "Medium"
                    ? "amber"
                    : "neutral"
              }
            >
              {eu.valueTier} value
            </StatusPill>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs">
              Evidence: {evidence}
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
            {eu.description}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right">
          <span
            className={cn(
              "text-2xl font-bold",
              scoreTone(score) === "brand"
                ? "text-brand-strong"
                : scoreTone(score) === "amber"
                  ? "text-amber-ink"
                  : "text-risk-ink",
            )}
          >
            {score}
          </span>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">fit score</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-3 grid gap-x-6 gap-y-2 text-xs sm:grid-cols-3">
        <div>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Best pathway: </span>
          <span className="font-medium text-on-surface">
            {bestPathway.name}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Min protein: </span>
          <span className="type-data font-medium">
            {eu.minProtein}% · feedstock has{" "}
            {fmt(feedstock.composition.protein.value, 1)}%
          </span>
        </div>
        <div>
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">Price: </span>
          <MeasureValue m={eu.indicativePrice} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {blocked_bool && (
        <div className="mt-3 rounded-lg border border-risk/30 bg-risk-soft/40 px-3 py-2 text-xs text-risk-ink">
          <strong>Blocked:</strong> {blocked.join(" · ")}
          <span className="ml-2 text-muted-foreground">
            — these risk flags must be resolved before use in this application.
          </span>
        </div>
      )}

      {eu.regulatory && (
        <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
          <Icon name="gavel" size={12} className="mr-1 inline-block" />
          {eu.regulatory}
        </p>
      )}
    </Card>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link, useRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import {
  EmptyState,
  ErrorState,
  PageHeader,

  SectionHeader,
  StatusPill,
} from "@/components/common/page";

} from "@/components/charts/control-chart";

  TableCell,
  TableHead,

} from "@/components/ui/table";

import { getFeedstock } from "@/data/api";
import {
  backendApi,
  type LiveFeedstock,
  type LiveBatch,
} from "@/data/backend-api";
import { AMINO_ACID_LABELS, AA_REFERENCE } from "@/data/feedstocks";
import { rankPathways } from "@/lib/scoring";
import { aminoAcidScore } from "@/lib/scoring";
import { fmt, fmtDate } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/feedstocks/$feedstockId")({
  component: FeedstockDetailPage,
});

const MONTH = ["J", "F", "M", "A", "M", "J", "J", "A", "S", "O", "N", "D"];

const FLAG_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  critical: "text-risk-ink bg-risk-soft border-risk/30",
  warning: "text-amber-ink bg-amber-soft border-amber/30",
  info: "text-on-surface-variant bg-surface-high border-hairline",
};

const STATUS_TONE: Record<
  string,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof StatusPill>["tone"]
> = {
  profiled: "sage",
  screening: "amber",
  pending: "neutral",
};

function FeedstockDetailPage() {
  const { feedstockId } = Route.useParams();
  const router = useRouter();

  // Try to load from demo data or live DB
  const isNumeric = /^\d+$/.test(feedstockId);

  const [demoData, setDemoData] = useState<Awaited<
    ReturnType<typeof getFeedstock>
  > | null>(null);
  const [liveData, setLiveData] = useState<{
    feedstock: LiveFeedstock;
    batches: LiveBatch[];
  } | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    if (isNumeric) {
      Promise.all([
        backendApi.feedstocks.get(Number(feedstockId)),
        backendApi.batches.list({ feedstockId: Number(feedstockId) }),
      ])
        .then(([fs, batches]) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setLiveData({ feedstock: fs, batches });
          setError(null);
          setLoading(false);
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setError(String(e.message ?? e));
          setLoading(false);
        });
    } else {
      getFeedstock(feedstockId)
        .then((data) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          if (!data) {
            setError("Feedstock not found");
            setLoading(false);
            return;
          }
          setDemoData(data);
          setError(null);
          setLoading(false);
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          if (cancelled) return;
          setError(String(e.message ?? e));
          setLoading(false);
        });
    }
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [feedstockId, isNumeric]);

  if (loading) return <DetailSkeleton />;
  if (error)
    return (
      <div className="pt-6">
        <ErrorState
          title="Feedstock not found"
          description={error}
          action={
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => router.history.back()}>
              Go back
            </Button>
          }
        />
      </div>
    );

  if (liveData) return <LiveFeedstockDetail data={liveData} />;
  if (demoData) return <DemoFeedstockDetail data={demoData} />;
  return null;
}

// ── Live feedstock (from DB) ───────────────────────────────────────────────

function QcBadge({ qc }: { qc: "pass" | "review" | "fail" }) {
  const cls =
    qc === "pass"
      ? "bg-mint text-on-mint"
      : qc === "review"
        ? "bg-amber-soft text-amber-ink"
        : "bg-risk-soft text-risk-ink";
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium",
        cls,
      )}
    >
      {qc}
    </span>
  );
}

function DetailSkeleton() {
  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <Skeleton className="h-3 w-28" />
        <Skeleton className="h-9 w-72" />
        <Skeleton className="h-4 w-96" />
      </div>
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12">
        <Skeleton className="h-96 rounded-xl lg:col-span-5" />
        <Skeleton className="h-96 rounded-xl lg:col-span-7" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

function FeedstocksPage() {

    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([listFeedstocks(), backendApi.feedstocks.list()])
      .then(([d, l]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setDemo(d);
        setLive(l);
        setError(null);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(String(e.message ?? e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [reload, liveCreated]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => {
      if (query !== (search.q ?? ""))
        navigate({
          search: (prev) => ({ ...prev, q: query || undefined }),
          replace: true,
        });
    }, 300);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [query, search.q, navigate]);

  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const filteredDemo = useMemo(() => {
    if (!demo) return [];
    let rows = demo.filter((f) => {
      if (category !== "all" && f.category !== category) return false;
      if (availability !== "all" && f.availability !== availability)
        return false;
      if (!q) return true;
      return (
        f.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.summary.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.sourceType.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.category.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        f.tags.some((t) => t.toLowerCase().includes(q))
      );
    });
    if (sort === "protein")
      rows = [...rows].sort(
        (a, b) => b.composition.protein.value - a.composition.protein.value,
      );
    if (sort === "volume")
      rows = [...rows].sort(
        (a, b) => b.annualVolume.value - a.annualVolume.value,
      );
    if (sort === "name")
      rows = [...rows].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
    return rows;

  const filteredLive = useMemo(() => {

            />
            <Input

            />
          </div>
          <Select value={category} onValueChange={setCategory}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-52" aria-label="Filter by category">
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">All categories</SelectItem>
              {FEEDSTOCK_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
````
