````typescript
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Select value={availability} onValueChange={setAvailability}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-40" aria-label="Filter by availability">
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="all">Any availability</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="Year-round">Year-round</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="Seasonal">Seasonal</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="Intermittent">Intermittent</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <Select value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
            <SelectTrigger className="w-44" aria-label="Sort results">
              <SelectValue />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              <SelectItem value="relevance">Sort: Relevance</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="protein">Sort: Protein (high→low)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="volume">Sort: Volume (high→low)</SelectItem>
              <SelectItem value="name">Sort: Name (A→Z)</SelectItem>
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
        </div>
      </Panel>

      {error && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertTitle>Could not load feedstocks</AlertTitle>
          <AlertDescription>{error}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}

      {/* Live feedstocks */}
      <section aria-label="Workspace feedstocks" className="space-y-4">
        <SectionHeader
          title="Workspace feedstocks"
          description="Registered in the live database, linked to suppliers and collection batches."
          badge={
            <StatusPill tone="sage">{filteredLive.length} live</StatusPill>
          }
        />
        {loading ? (
          <Panel>
            <div className="space-y-2">
              {Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                <Skeleton key={i} className="h-12" />
              ))}
            </div>
          </Panel>
        ) : filteredLive.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon="eco"
            title="No workspace feedstocks yet"
            description="Register a feedstock to start tracking collection batches, suppliers and traceability."
            action={
              <Button onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}>
                <Icon name="add" size={18} />
                Register feedstock
              </Button>
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <Panel padded={false}>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Name</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Category</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Batches</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Actions</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {filteredLive.map((f) => (
                    <TableRow key={f.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Link
                          to="/feedstocks/$feedstockId"
                          params={{ feedstockId: String(f.id) }}
                          className="font-medium text-brand-strong hover:underline"
                        >
                          {f.name}
                        </Link>
                        {f.description && (
                          <p className="mt-0.5 max-w-md truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {f.description}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant="outline">{f.category}</Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <span className="type-data">
                          {f.batches?.length ?? 0}
                        </span>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="type-data text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {f.createdAt
                          ? new Date(f.createdAt).toLocaleDateString("en-GB")
                          : "—"}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          onClick={async () => {
                            if (
                              !confirm(
                                `Delete feedstock "${f.name}"? This also unlinks its batches.`,
                              )
                            )
                              return;
                            await backendApi.feedstocks.remove(f.id);
                            setReload((n) => n + 1);
                          }}
                          aria-label={`Delete ${f.name}`}
                        >
                          <Icon name="delete" size={16} />
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>
          </Panel>
        )}
      </section>

      {/* Demo feedstock grid */}
      <section aria-label="Demo feedstock profiles" className="space-y-4">
        <SectionHeader
          title="Demo feedstock profiles"

        />
        {loading ? (

            {Array.from({ length: 6 }).map((_, i) => (

            title="No feedstocks match your filters"

            action={

              >
                Clear filters

          />
        ) : (
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">

}

function CreateFeedstockDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onCreated,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  onCreated: () => void;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState<string>("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setFormError(null);
    if (!name.trim()) return setFormError("Name is required");
    if (!category) return setFormError("Category is required");
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await backendApi.feedstocks.create({
        name: name.trim(),
        category,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
      });
      onCreated();
      onOpenChange(false);
      setName("");
      setCategory("");
      setDescription("");
    } catch (err) {
      setFormError(String((err as Error).message ?? err));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Register feedstock</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Add a feedstock to the workspace database. It can then be linked to
            suppliers and collection batches.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="fs-name">Name *</Label>
            <Input
              id="fs-name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Coffee pulp"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="fs-category">Category *</Label>
            <Select value={category} onValueChange={setCategory}>
              <SelectTrigger id="fs-category" className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Choose a category" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {FEEDSTOCK_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c} value={c}>
                    {c}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="fs-desc">Description</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="fs-desc"
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Origin, generation process, seasonal notes…"
              rows={3}
            />
          </div>
          {formError && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-risk-ink">
              {formError}
            </p>
          )}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
              {submitting ? "Saving…" : "Save feedstock"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import {
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  Panel,
  SectionHeader,
  StatCard,
  StatusPill,
} from "@/components/common/page";
import {
  ControlChart,
  type ControlPoint,
} from "@/components/charts/control-chart";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import { listBatches } from "@/data/api";
import { FEEDSTOCKS } from "@/data/feedstocks";
import { fmt } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/fingerprinting")({
  component: FingerprintingPage,
});

function FingerprintingPage() {
  const [feedstockId, setFeedstockId] = useState("");
  const [batches, setBatches] = useState<Awaited<
    ReturnType<typeof listBatches>
  > | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    listBatches().then((data) => {
      setBatches(data);
      // pick the feedstock with most batches by default
      const counts = new Map<string, number>();
      data.forEach((b) =>
        counts.set(b.feedstockId, (counts.get(b.feedstockId) ?? 0) + 1),
      );
      const top = [...counts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
      setFeedstockId(top?.[0] ?? FEEDSTOCKS[0].id);
      setLoading(false);
    });
  }, []);

  const profiled = FEEDSTOCKS.filter((f) => f.batchCount > 0);
  const feedstock = FEEDSTOCKS.find((f) => f.id === feedstockId);
  const feedstockBatches = useMemo(
    () => (batches ?? []).filter((b) => b.feedstockId === feedstockId),
    [batches, feedstockId],
  );

  const mean = feedstock ? feedstock.composition.protein.value : 0;
  const sd = feedstock ? (mean * feedstock.variabilityCv) / 100 : 1;
  const passRate =
    feedstockBatches.length > 0
      ? feedstockBatches.filter((b) => b.qc === "pass").length /
        feedstockBatches.length
      : 0;

  const controlPoints: ControlPoint[] = feedstockBatches
    .slice()
    .reverse()
    .map((b) => ({
      id: b.lot,
      label: b.sampledOn.slice(5),
      value: b.protein,
    }));

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Intelligence"
        title="Batch Fingerprinting"
        description="Batch-to-batch composition monitoring with statistical process control. Values are simulated indicative data."
      />

      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end gap-3">
        <div className="min-w-64 flex-1 sm:max-w-sm">
          <label className="mb-1.5 block text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
            Feedstock
          </label>
          {loading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-10 w-full" />
          ) : (
            <Select value={feedstockId} onValueChange={setFeedstockId}>
              <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                <SelectValue />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {profiled.map((f) => (
                  <SelectItem key={f.id} value={f.id}>
                    {f.name} ({f.batchCount} batches)
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          )}
        </div>
        {feedstock && (
          <Link
            to="/feedstocks/$feedstockId"
            params={{ feedstockId: feedstock.id }}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-brand-strong hover:underline"
          >
            View profile <Icon name="arrow_forward" size={14} />
          </Link>
        )}
      </div>

      {loading ? (
        <Skeleton className="h-96 rounded-xl" />
      ) : !feedstock || feedstockBatches.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon="fingerprint"
          title="No batches for this feedstock"
          description="Choose a feedstock with recorded batch history."
        />
      ) : (
        <>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
            <StatCard
              label="Batches"
              value={feedstockBatches.length}
              icon="inventory_2"
            />
            <StatCard
              label="Mean protein"
              value={`${fmt(mean, 1)}% DM`}
              icon="science"
            />
            <StatCard
              label="Variability (CV)"
              value={`${fmt(feedstock.variabilityCv, 1)}%`}
              icon="monitoring"
              deltaTone={feedstock.variabilityCv > 15 ? "risk" : "brand"}
            />
            <StatCard
              label="QC pass rate"
              value={`${fmt(passRate * 100, 0)}%`}
              icon="verified"
              deltaTone={
                passRate >= 0.9 ? "brand" : passRate >= 0.75 ? "amber" : "risk"
              }
            />
          </div>

          <Panel>
            <SectionHeader
              title="Protein individuals control chart"
              description="Mean and ±2σ control limits. Points outside limits are out of control and trigger investigation."
            />
            <div className="mt-4">
              <ControlChart
                points={controlPoints}
                mean={mean}
                sd={sd}
                unit="% DM"
                ariaLabel={`Protein control chart for ${feedstock.name}`}
              />
            </div>
          </Panel>

          <Panel padded={false}>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-hairline px-5 py-4">
              <SectionHeader
                title="Batch records"
                description="Composition values per batch, with QC verdict."
                as="h3"
              />
              <StatusPill tone="sage">
                {feedstockBatches.length} lots
              </StatusPill>
            </div>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>Lot</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Sampled</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Protein %</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">z-score</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Moisture %</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Lipid %</TableHead>
                    <TableHead className="text-right">Ash %</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>QC</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Lab</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {feedstockBatches.map((b) => {
                    const z = (b.protein - mean) / sd;
                    return (
                      <TableRow
                        key={b.lot}
                        className={Math.abs(z) > 2 ? "bg-risk-soft/30" : ""}
                      >
                        <TableCell className="type-data font-medium">
                          {b.lot}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="type-data text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {b.sampledOn}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="type-data text-right">
                          {fmt(b.protein, 2)}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell
                          className={cn(
                            "type-data text-right",
                            Math.abs(z) > 2
                              ? "font-bold text-risk-ink"
                              : "text-muted-foreground",
                          )}
                        >
                          {fmt(z, 2)}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="type-data text-right">
                          {fmt(b.moisture, 1)}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="type-data text-right">
                          {fmt(b.lipid, 2)}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="type-data text-right">
                          {fmt(b.ash, 2)}
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell>
                          <QcBadge qc={b.qc} />
                        </TableCell>
                        <TableCell className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {b.lab}
                        </TableCell>
                      </TableRow>
                    );
                  })}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>
          </Panel>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function QcBadge({ qc }: { qc: string }) {
  const cls =
    qc === "pass"
      ? "bg-mint text-on-mint"
      : qc === "review"
        ? "bg-amber-soft text-amber-ink"
        : "bg-risk-soft text-risk-ink";
  return (
    <span
      className={cn(
        "inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium",
        cls,
      )}
    >
      {qc}
    </span>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link, notFound } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import { PageHeader, Panel, SectionHeader } from "@/components/common/page";
import { moduleById } from "@/data/modules";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/modules/$moduleId")({
  component: ModulePage,
  notFoundComponent: () => {
    throw notFound();
  },
});

function ModulePage() {
  const { moduleId } = Route.useParams();
  const mod = moduleById(moduleId);

  if (!mod) {
    return (
      <div className="pt-6">
        <div className="rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-card p-8 text-center">
          <Icon
            name="extension_off"
            size={32}
            className="text-muted-foreground"
          />
          <p className="mt-3 font-semibold text-on-surface">Unknown module</p>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
            No module brief exists for “{moduleId}”.
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow={`${mod.layer} layer`}
        title={mod.title}
        description={mod.summary}
      />

      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-12">
        <Panel className="lg:col-span-7">
          <SectionHeader title="Planned capabilities" />
          <ul className="mt-4 space-y-2.5">
            {mod.capabilities.map((c) => (
              <li
                key={c}
                className="flex items-start gap-2.5 text-sm text-on-surface-variant"
              >
                <Icon
                  name="check_circle"
                  size={18}
                  className="mt-0.5 shrink-0 text-brand-strong"
                />
                {c}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </Panel>

        <Panel className="lg:col-span-5">
          <SectionHeader title="Data inputs" />
          {mod.inputs.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              This module has no upstream dependencies.
            </p>
          ) : (
            <div className="mt-4 space-y-2">
              {mod.inputs.map((i) => (
                <Link
                  key={i.label}
                  to={i.to as never}
                  className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-lg border border-hairline px-3 py-2 text-sm text-on-surface transition-colors hover:border-brand/40"
                >
                  <span>{i.label}</span>
                  <Icon
                    name="arrow_forward"
                    size={16}
                    className="text-brand-strong"
                  />
                </Link>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </Panel>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
function PathwayRadar({ rankings }: { rankings: RankedPathway[] }) {
  const top3 = rankings.slice(0, 3);
  const COLORS = ["var(--brand)", "var(--forest)", "var(--amber)"];
  const axes = CRITERIA.map((c) => c.label);
  const series = top3.map((r, i) => ({
    label: r.pathway.short,
    color: COLORS[i],
    values: CRITERIA.map((c) => r.normalized[c.id]),
  }));

  return (
    <Panel>
      <SectionHeader
        title="Multi-criteria radar (top 3 pathways)"
        description="Normalised scores per criterion — wider polygon is better overall."
      />
      <div className="mt-4 flex flex-col gap-6 lg:flex-row">
        <RadarChart
          axes={axes}
          series={series}
          size={360}
          ariaLabel="Pathway comparison radar chart"
        />
        <div className="flex-1 space-y-3">
          {top3.map((r, i) => (
            <div key={r.pathway.id} className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div
                className="size-3 rounded-sm"
                style={{ background: COLORS[i] }}
              />
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
                    {r.pathway.short}
                  </span>
                  <span className="type-data text-brand-strong">{r.total}</span>
                </div>
                <ScoreBar
                  value={r.total}
                  tone={scoreTone(r.total)}
                  showValue={false}
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    </Panel>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

import {

} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

} from "@/components/ui/select";

} from "@/components/ui/table";

} from "@/data/backend-api";
import { REPORTS, REPORT_TEMPLATES } from "@/data/workspace";
import { fmtDate } from "@/lib/format";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/reports")({
  component: ReportsPage,
});

const REPORT_TYPES = [
  "Feedstock profile",
  "Pathway comparison",
  "Allocation scenario",
  "End-use assessment",
  "Batch QC summary",
];

const STATUS_TONE: Record<
  string,
  React.ComponentProps<typeof StatusPill>["tone"]
> = {
  Draft: "neutral",
  "In review": "amber",
  Published: "sage",
};

function ReportsPage() {
  const [liveReports, setLiveReports] = useState<LiveReport[]>([]);
  const [feedstocks, setFeedstocks] = useState<LiveFeedstock[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [dialogOpen, setDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [viewReport, setViewReport] = useState<LiveReport | null>(null);
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([backendApi.reports.list(), backendApi.feedstocks.list()])
      .then(([r, f]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setLiveReports(r);
        setFeedstocks(f);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [reload]);

  async function handleDelete(id: number, title: string) {
    if (!confirm(`Delete report "${title}"?`)) return;
    await backendApi.reports.remove(id);
    toast.success("Report deleted");
    setReload((n) => n + 1);
  }

  async function handlePublish(id: number, current: string) {
    const next = current === "Published" ? "In review" : "Published";
    await backendApi.reports.update(id, { status: next });
    toast.success(`Report marked as ${next}`);
    setReload((n) => n + 1);
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Operations"
        title="Reports"

        actions={
          <Button onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}>

          </Button>
        }
      />

      <Tabs defaultValue="live">

          <TabsTrigger value="live">
            Live reports ({loading ? "…" : liveReports.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="demo">
            Demo examples ({REPORTS.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="templates">Templates</TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="live" className="mt-4">
          {loading ? (
            <Skeleton className="h-64 rounded-xl" />
          ) : liveReports.length === 0 ? (
            <EmptyState
              icon="assessment"
              title="No live reports yet"
              description="Generate a report to build a persistent record backed by workspace data."
              action={
                <Button onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}>
                  <Icon name="add" size={18} />
                  Generate report
                </Button>
              }
            />
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              {liveReports.map((r) => (
                <Card key={r.id} className="p-5">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
                    <div className="min-w-0">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                        <p className="font-semibold text-on-surface">

                        <StatusPill tone={STATUS_TONE[r.status] ?? "neutral"}>
                          {r.status}
                        </StatusPill>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">

                        <span>{r.author}</span>
                        <span>·</span>
                        <span>{fmtDate(r.createdAt)}</span>
                        {r.feedstock && (
                          <>
                            <span>·</span>
                            <Link
                              to="/feedstocks/$feedstockId"
                              params={{ feedstockId: String(r.feedstockId) }}
                              className="text-brand-strong hover:underline"
                            >
                              {r.feedstock.name}
                            </Link>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                        {r.summary}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-2">
                      <Button
                        variant="outline"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => setViewReport(r)}
                      >
                        <Icon name="visibility" size={16} />
                        View
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => handlePublish(r.id, r.status)}
                        title={
                          r.status === "Published"
                            ? "Mark as In review"
                            : "Publish"
                        }
                      >
                        <Icon
                          name={
                            r.status === "Published" ? "unpublished" : "publish"
                          }
                          size={16}
                        />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id, r.title)}
                        aria-label={`Delete ${r.title}`}
                      >
                        <Icon name="delete" size={16} />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="demo" className="mt-4">
          <Panel padded={false}>
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <Table>
                <TableHeader>
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableHead>ID</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Title</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Type</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Status</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Author</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Created</TableHead>
                    <TableHead>Pages</TableHead>
                  </TableRow>
                </TableHeader>
                <TableBody>
                  {REPORTS.map((r) => (
                    <TableRow key={r.id}>
                      <TableCell className="type-data text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {r.id}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <p className="font-medium text-on-surface">{r.title}</p>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 max-w-xs truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {r.summary}
                        </p>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant="outline">{r.type}</Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <StatusPill tone={STATUS_TONE[r.status] ?? "neutral"}>
                          {r.status}
                        </StatusPill>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm">{r.author}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="type-data text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {r.createdOn}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="type-data">{r.pages}</TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  ))}
                </TableBody>
              </Table>
            </div>
          </Panel>
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="templates" className="mt-4">
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
            {REPORT_TEMPLATES.map((t) => (
              <Card key={t.type} className="p-4 space-y-3">
                <p className="font-semibold text-on-surface">{t.type}</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
                  {t.description}
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
                  {t.sections.map((s) => (
                    <Badge key={s} variant="outline" className="text-xs">
                      {s}
                    </Badge>
                  ))}
                </div>
                <Button
                  variant="outline"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setDialogOpen(true)}
                >
                  Use template
                </Button>
              </Card>
            ))}
          </div>
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      <GenerateReportDialog
        open={dialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setDialogOpen}
        feedstocks={feedstocks}
        onCreated={() => setReload((n) => n + 1)}
      />

      {viewReport && (
        <ReportViewDialog
          report={viewReport}
          onClose={() => setViewReport(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function GenerateReportDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  feedstocks,
  onCreated,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  feedstocks: LiveFeedstock[];
  onCreated: () => void;
}) {
  const [title, setTitle] = useState("");
  const [type, setType] = useState("Feedstock profile");
  const [feedstockId, setFeedstockId] = useState<string>("none");
  const [author, setAuthor] = useState("Research team");
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErr(null);
    if (!title.trim()) return setErr("Title is required");
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const payload: CreateReportPayload = {
        title: title.trim(),
        type,
        author: author.trim() || "Research team",
        content: notes.trim() || undefined,
      };
      if (feedstockId !== "none") payload.feedstockId = parseInt(feedstockId);
      await backendApi.reports.create(payload);
      toast.success("Report generated");
      onCreated();
      onOpenChange(false);
      setTitle("");
      setType("Feedstock profile");
      setFeedstockId("none");
      setNotes("");
      setAuthor("Research team");
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Generate report</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Creates a report backed by live workspace records — suppliers,
            feedstocks, batches. All data cited traces to persisted database
            entries.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="rpt-title">Title *</Label>
            <Input
              id="rpt-title"
              value={title}
              onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Coffee pulp — batch QC Q4 2026"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="rpt-type">Report type *</Label>
              <Select value={type} onValueChange={setType}>
                <SelectTrigger id="rpt-type" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {REPORT_TYPES.map((t) => (
                    <SelectItem key={t} value={t}>
                      {t}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="rpt-fs">Focus feedstock</Label>
              <Select value={feedstockId} onValueChange={setFeedstockId}>
                <SelectTrigger id="rpt-fs" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  <SelectItem value="none">All feedstocks</SelectItem>
                  {feedstocks.map((f) => (
                    <SelectItem key={f.id} value={String(f.id)}>
                      {f.name}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="rpt-author">Author</Label>
            <Input
              id="rpt-author"
              value={author}
              onChange={(e) => setAuthor(e.target.value)}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="rpt-notes">Analysis notes</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="rpt-notes"
              value={notes}
              onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Findings, pathway notes or recommendations to include in the report…"
              rows={4}
            />
          </div>
          {err && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-risk-ink">
              {err}
            </p>
          )}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
              {submitting ? "Generating…" : "Generate report"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function ReportViewDialog({
  report,
  onClose,
}: {
  report: LiveReport;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <Dialog open onOpenChange={onClose}>
      <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>{report.title}</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            {report.type} · {report.author} · {fmtDate(report.createdAt)}
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">Summary</p>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-on-surface-variant">
              {report.summary}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">Sections</p>
            <div className="mt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-1">
              {report.sections.split("|").map((s) => (
                <Badge key={s} variant="outline">
                  {s}
                </Badge>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <p className="mb-2 text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">
              Content
            </p>
            <pre className="whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-xl border border-hairline bg-surface-low px-4 py-3 text-xs text-on-surface-variant font-mono leading-relaxed">
              {report.content}
            </pre>
          </div>
        </div>
        <DialogFooter>
          <Button onClick={onClose}>Close</Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import {
  EmptyState,
  PageHeader,
  Panel,
  StatusPill,
} from "@/components/common/page";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import {
  Dialog,

  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,

} from "@/components/ui/dialog";

  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select";
import {
  Table,
  TableBody,
  TableCell,
  TableHead,
  TableHeader,
  TableRow,
} from "@/components/ui/table";
import {
  backendApi,
  type LiveSupplier,
  type LiveFeedstock,
  type LiveBatch,
} from "@/data/backend-api";
import { FEEDSTOCK_CATEGORIES } from "@/data/feedstocks";
import { fmtDate } from "@/lib/format";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/source-intelligence")({
  component: SourceIntelligencePage,
});

function useSourceData(reload: number) {
  const [suppliers, setSuppliers] = useState<LiveSupplier[]>([]);
  const [feedstocks, setFeedstocks] = useState<LiveFeedstock[]>([]);
  const [batches, setBatches] = useState<LiveBatch[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([
      backendApi.suppliers.list(),
      backendApi.feedstocks.list(),
      backendApi.batches.list(),
    ])
      .then(([s, f, b]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setSuppliers(s);
        setFeedstocks(f);
        setBatches(b);
        setError(null);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(String(e.message ?? e));
        setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [reload]);

  return { suppliers, feedstocks, batches, loading, error };
}

// ── Main page ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

function SourceIntelligencePage() {
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
  const refresh = () => setReload((n) => n + 1);
  const { suppliers, feedstocks, batches, loading, error } =
    useSourceData(reload);

  const [supplierDialogOpen, setSupplierDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [feedstockDialogOpen, setFeedstockDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [batchDialogOpen, setBatchDialogOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Intelligence"
        title="Source Intelligence"
        description="Register suppliers, record collection batches and maintain full traceability from field to process."
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setSupplierDialogOpen(true)}
            >
              <Icon name="business" size={18} />
              Add supplier
            </Button>
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => setFeedstockDialogOpen(true)}
            >
              <Icon name="eco" size={18} />
              Add feedstock
            </Button>
            <Button onClick={() => setBatchDialogOpen(true)}>
              <Icon name="add" size={18} />
              Create batch
            </Button>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {error && (
        <div
          role="alert"
          className="rounded-xl border border-risk/30 bg-risk-soft/40 p-4 text-sm text-risk-ink"
        >
          {error}
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-3">
        {[
          { icon: "business", label: "Suppliers", value: suppliers.length },
          { icon: "eco", label: "Feedstocks", value: feedstocks.length },
          { icon: "inventory_2", label: "Batches", value: batches.length },
        ].map((s) => (
          <Card key={s.label} className="flex items-center gap-4 p-5">
            <div className="grid size-10 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-surface-high text-brand-strong">
              <Icon name={s.icon} size={20} />
            </div>
            {loading ? (
              <Skeleton className="h-8 w-16" />
            ) : (
              <div>
                <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-on-surface">{s.value}</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant">{s.label}</p>
              </div>
            )}
          </Card>
        ))}
      </div>

      <Tabs defaultValue="batches">
        <TabsList>
          <TabsTrigger value="batches">Batches ({batches.length})</TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="suppliers">
            Suppliers ({suppliers.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
          <TabsTrigger value="feedstocks">
            Feedstocks ({feedstocks.length})
          </TabsTrigger>
        </TabsList>

        <TabsContent value="batches" className="mt-4">
          <BatchTable
            batches={batches}
            loading={loading}
            onDelete={async (id) => {
              await backendApi.batches.remove(id);
              toast.success("Batch deleted");
              refresh();
            }}
            onCreate={() => setBatchDialogOpen(true)}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="suppliers" className="mt-4">
          <SupplierTable
            suppliers={suppliers}
            loading={loading}
            onDelete={async (id, name) => {
              if (!confirm(`Delete supplier "${name}"?`)) return;
              await backendApi.suppliers.remove(id);
              toast.success("Supplier deleted");
              refresh();
            }}
            onCreate={() => setSupplierDialogOpen(true)}
          />
        </TabsContent>

        <TabsContent value="feedstocks" className="mt-4">
          <FeedstockTable
            feedstocks={feedstocks}
            loading={loading}
            onDelete={async (id, name) => {
              if (
                !confirm(
                  `Delete feedstock "${name}"? This also removes its batches.`,
                )
              )
                return;
              await backendApi.feedstocks.remove(id);
              toast.success("Feedstock deleted");
              refresh();
            }}
            onCreate={() => setFeedstockDialogOpen(true)}
          />
        </TabsContent>
      </Tabs>

      <SupplierDialog
        open={supplierDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setSupplierDialogOpen}
        onCreated={refresh}
      />
      <FeedstockDialog
        open={feedstockDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setFeedstockDialogOpen}
        onCreated={refresh}
      />
      <BatchDialog
        open={batchDialogOpen}
        onOpenChange={setBatchDialogOpen}
        suppliers={suppliers}
        feedstocks={feedstocks}
        onCreated={refresh}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

                </TableCell>

                  <Button

  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  onCreated: () => void;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [siteName, setSiteName] = useState("");
  const [county, setCounty] = useState("");
  const [town, setTown] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErr(null);
    if (!name.trim() || !siteName.trim() || !county.trim())
      return setErr("Name, site name and county are required");
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await backendApi.suppliers.create({
        name: name.trim(),
        siteName: siteName.trim(),
        county: county.trim(),
        town: town.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success("Supplier registered");
      onCreated();
      onOpenChange(false);
      setName("");
      setSiteName("");
      setCounty("");
      setTown("");
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Register supplier</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Add a feedstock supplier. The site name identifies the specific
            collection location.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label htmlFor="sup-name">Organisation name *</Label>
              <Input
                id="sup-name"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Highland Coffee Co."
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label htmlFor="sup-site">Site / plant name *</Label>
              <Input
                id="sup-site"
                value={siteName}
                onChange={(e) => setSiteName(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Nyeri Wet Mill"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="sup-county">County *</Label>
              <Input
                id="sup-county"
                value={county}
                onChange={(e) => setCounty(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Nyeri"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="sup-town">Town</Label>
              <Input
                id="sup-town"
                value={town}
                onChange={(e) => setTown(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Karatina"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {err && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-risk-ink">
              {err}
            </p>
          )}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
              {submitting ? "Saving…" : "Save supplier"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function FeedstockDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onCreated,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  onCreated: () => void;
}) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [description, setDescription] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErr(null);
    if (!name.trim() || !category)
      return setErr("Name and category are required");
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await backendApi.feedstocks.create({
        name: name.trim(),
        category,
        description: description.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success("Feedstock registered");
      onCreated();
      onOpenChange(false);
      setName("");
      setCategory("");
      setDescription("");
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-md">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Register feedstock</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Add a feedstock to the workspace database.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="fsd-name">Name *</Label>
            <Input
              id="fsd-name"
              value={name}
              onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="e.g. Coffee pulp"
              required
            />
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="fsd-cat">Category *</Label>
            <Select value={category} onValueChange={setCategory}>
              <SelectTrigger id="fsd-cat" className="w-full">
                <SelectValue placeholder="Choose a category" />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent>
                {FEEDSTOCK_CATEGORIES.map((c) => (
                  <SelectItem key={c} value={c}>
                    {c}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <Label htmlFor="fsd-desc">Description</Label>
            <Textarea
              id="fsd-desc"
              value={description}
              onChange={(e) => setDescription(e.target.value)}
              rows={2}
            />
          </div>
          {err && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-risk-ink">
              {err}
            </p>
          )}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button type="submit" disabled={submitting}>
              {submitting ? "Saving…" : "Save feedstock"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function BatchDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  suppliers,
  feedstocks,
  onCreated,
}: {
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (v: boolean) => void;
  suppliers: LiveSupplier[];
  feedstocks: LiveFeedstock[];
  onCreated: () => void;
}) {
  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const [batchCode, setBatchCode] = useState("");
  const [supplierId, setSupplierId] = useState<string>("");
  const [feedstockId, setFeedstockId] = useState<string>("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("");
  const [unit, setUnit] = useState("t");
  const [date, setDate] = useState(today);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState("");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [err, setErr] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function submit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErr(null);
    if (!batchCode.trim()) return setErr("Batch code is required");
    if (!supplierId) return setErr("Select a supplier");
    if (!feedstockId) return setErr("Select a feedstock");
    if (!quantity || isNaN(parseFloat(quantity)) || parseFloat(quantity) <= 0)
      return setErr("Enter a positive quantity");
    setSubmitting(true);
    try {
      await backendApi.batches.create({
        batchCode: batchCode.trim(),
        supplierId: parseInt(supplierId),
        feedstockId: parseInt(feedstockId),
        quantity: parseFloat(quantity),
        quantityUnit: unit,
        collectionDate: date,
        notes: notes.trim() || undefined,
      });
      toast.success(`Batch ${batchCode} created`);
      onCreated();
      onOpenChange(false);
      setBatchCode("");
      setSupplierId("");
      setFeedstockId("");
      setQuantity("");
      setUnit("t");
      setDate(today);
      setNotes("");
    } catch (e) {
      setErr(String((e as Error).message ?? e));
    } finally {
      setSubmitting(false);
    }
  }

  const noSuppliers = suppliers.length === 0;
  const noFeedstocks = feedstocks.length === 0;

  return (
    <Dialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <DialogContent className="sm:max-w-lg">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle>Create collection batch</DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription>
            Record a collected batch. The batch code must be unique and links
            the supplier, feedstock and quantity for traceability.
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>
        {(noSuppliers || noFeedstocks) && (
          <div className="rounded-lg border border-amber/40 bg-amber-soft px-4 py-3 text-sm text-amber-ink">
            {noSuppliers && noFeedstocks
              ? "Register at least one supplier and one feedstock first."
              : noSuppliers
                ? "Register a supplier before creating a batch."
                : "Register a feedstock before creating a batch."}
          </div>
        )}
        <form onSubmit={submit} className="space-y-4">
          <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-code">Batch code *</Label>
              <Input
                id="bc-code"
                value={batchCode}
                onChange={(e) => setBatchCode(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. CP-205"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-sup">Supplier *</Label>
              <Select
                value={supplierId}
                onValueChange={setSupplierId}
                disabled={noSuppliers}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="bc-sup" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select supplier" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {suppliers.map((s) => (
                    <SelectItem key={s.id} value={String(s.id)}>
                      {s.name} — {s.siteName}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-fs">Feedstock *</Label>
              <Select
                value={feedstockId}
                onValueChange={setFeedstockId}
                disabled={noFeedstocks}
              >
                <SelectTrigger id="bc-fs" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue placeholder="Select feedstock" />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {feedstocks.map((f) => (
                    <SelectItem key={f.id} value={String(f.id)}>
                      {f.name}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-qty">Quantity *</Label>
              <Input
                id="bc-qty"
                type="number"
                min="0.001"
                step="any"
                value={quantity}
                onChange={(e) => setQuantity(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. 12.5"
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-unit">Unit</Label>
              <Select value={unit} onValueChange={setUnit}>
                <SelectTrigger id="bc-unit" className="w-full">
                  <SelectValue />
                </SelectTrigger>
                <SelectContent>
                  {["t", "kg", "m³", "L", "bags"].map((u) => (
                    <SelectItem key={u} value={u}>
                      {u}
                    </SelectItem>
                  ))}
                </SelectContent>
              </Select>
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-date">Collection date *</Label>
              <Input
                id="bc-date"
                type="date"
                value={date}
                onChange={(e) => setDate(e.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1.5 sm:col-span-2">
              <Label htmlFor="bc-notes">Notes</Label>
              <Textarea
                id="bc-notes"
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                rows={2}
                placeholder="Storage conditions, moisture at collection, QC observations…"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          {err && (
            <p role="alert" className="text-sm text-risk-ink">
              {err}
            </p>
          )}
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button
              type="button"
              variant="outline"
              onClick={() => onOpenChange(false)}
            >
              Cancel
            </Button>
            <Button
              type="submit"
              disabled={submitting || noSuppliers || noFeedstocks}
            >
              {submitting ? "Saving…" : "Save batch"}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </form>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

function TableSkeleton() {
  return (
    <Panel className="space-y-2">
      {Array.from({ length: 5 }).map((_, i) => (
        <Skeleton key={i} className="h-10" />
      ))}
    </Panel>
  );
}
````

## File: frontend/src/router.ssr.test.tsx
````typescript
// @vitest-environment node
import { renderToString } from "react-dom/server";
import {
  createMemoryHistory,
  createRootRoute,
  createRoute,
  createRouter,
  RouterProvider,
} from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { expect, it } from "vitest";
import { getRouter } from "./router";
import { RouteErrorPage } from "./components/error-pages";

it("uses the safe router default for child loader failures during SSR", async () => {
  const root = createRootRoute({ errorComponent: RouteErrorPage });
  const child = createRoute({
    getParentRoute: () => root,
    path: "/failure",
    loader: () => {
      throw new Error("Private loader diagnostics");
    },
    component: () => <h1>Loaded</h1>,
  });
  const router = createRouter({
    defaultErrorComponent: getRouter().options.defaultErrorComponent,
    routeTree: root.addChildren([child]),
    history: createMemoryHistory({ initialEntries: ["/failure"] }),
    isServer: true,
  });
  await router.load();
  const html = renderToString(<RouterProvider router={router} />);
  expect(html).toContain("This page couldn’t load");
  expect(html).not.toContain("Private loader diagnostics");
  expect(html).toContain("Go home");
});
````

````typescript
import { createRouter } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { RouteErrorPage } from "@/components/error-pages";
import { PageSkeleton } from "@/components/common/skeletons";

// Import the generated route tree
import { routeTree } from "./routeTree.gen";

// Create a new router instance
export const getRouter = () => {
  const router = createRouter({
    routeTree,
    defaultErrorComponent: RouteErrorPage,
    scrollRestoration: true,
    defaultPreloadStaleTime: 0,
    defaultPreload: "intent",
    defaultPendingComponent: () => <PageSkeleton />,
    defaultPendingMs: 150,
    defaultPendingMinMs: 300,
  });

  return router;
};

declare module "@tanstack/react-router" {
  interface Register {
    router: ReturnType<typeof getRouter>;
  }
}
````

````css
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .tnum {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
  .scrollbar-none {
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }
  .scrollbar-none::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
}

/* Material Symbols (icon set used by the Stitch design) */
.material-symbols-outlined {
  font-family: "Material Symbols Outlined";
  font-weight: normal;
  font-style: normal;
  line-height: 1;
  letter-spacing: normal;
  text-transform: none;
  display: inline-block;
  white-space: nowrap;
  word-wrap: normal;
  direction: ltr;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  font-feature-settings: "liga";
  font-variation-settings:
    "FILL" 0,
    "wght" 400,
    "GRAD" 0,
    "opsz" 20;
  user-select: none;
  overflow: hidden;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

/* Range input styled to the design system */
input[type="range"].bp-range {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  appearance: none;
  width: 100%;
  height: 4px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: linear-gradient(
    to right,
    var(--brand) 0%,
    var(--brand) var(--fill, 50%),
    var(--surface-container-high) var(--fill, 50%)
  );
  outline: none;
}
input[type="range"].bp-range::-webkit-slider-thumb {
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 2px solid var(--brand);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-card);
  cursor: pointer;
}
input[type="range"].bp-range::-moz-range-thumb {
  width: 14px;
  height: 14px;
  border-radius: 9999px;
  background: #fff;
  border: 2px solid var(--brand);
  cursor: pointer;
}
input[type="range"].bp-range:focus-visible {
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--sage);
}
````

## File: frontend/README.md
````markdown
# BIOPATH AI

Frontend for BIOPATH AI, a feedstock-to-protein intelligence platform. It helps users find, characterise, evaluate and allocate local biological feedstocks for alternative protein production across four layers: Source, Fingerprint, Pathway and End-Use intelligence. The visual design follows the user's Stitch reference.

All data is simulated demo data. Every value carries a provenance tag (measured, literature, estimated, demo) so the interface never presents simulated figures as verified results.

## Tech

TanStack Start (React 19, TanStack Router), Vite, Tailwind CSS 4, shadcn/ui (Radix), custom SVG charts, deployed on Netlify.

## Run locally

```bash
pnpm install
npm run dev   # http://localhost:3000
```

## Structure

- `src/data`: typed demo fixtures plus `api.ts`, the only data access point (swap it for a backend later)
- `src/lib/scoring.ts`: transparent heuristic pathway, end-use and allocation model
- `src/components/layout`, `common`, `charts`: shell, shared UI, charts

## Roadmap

See `PLAN.md`. The foundations, data layer and charts are done. The screens come next: dashboard, feedstock explorer and profiles, source, fingerprinting, pathways, allocation, end-use, reports and module briefs.
````

````typescript
/**
 * Sidebar navigation, mirroring the Stitch reference design.
 * `to` points at a live screen; modules without a dedicated screen yet open a
 * module brief at /modules/$moduleId.
 */
export type AppPath =
  | "/"
  | "/feedstocks"
  | "/source-intelligence"
  | "/fingerprinting"
  | "/pathways"
  | "/allocation"
  | "/end-use"
  | "/formulation"
  | "/reports";

export type NavItem =
  | { label: string; icon: string; to: AppPath; moduleId?: undefined }
  | { label: string; icon: string; to: "/modules/$moduleId"; moduleId: string };

export interface NavSection {
  title: string;

}

const mod = (label: string, icon: string, moduleId: string): NavItem => ({
````

````typescript
import { createFileRoute, Link } from "@tanstack/react-router";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Icon } from "@/components/common/icon";
import { PageHeader } from "@/components/common/page";
import { Card } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { getDashboard } from "@/data/api";
import { backendApi, type LiveStats } from "@/data/backend-api";
import { FEEDSTOCKS } from "@/data/feedstocks";
import { fmtCompact, fmtDate } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export const Route = createFileRoute("/")({
  component: HomePage,
});

function useDashboardData() {
  const [demo, setDemo] = useState<Awaited<
    ReturnType<typeof getDashboard>
  > | null>(null);
  const [live, setLive] = useState<LiveStats | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    Promise.all([getDashboard(), backendApi.stats.get()])
      .then(([d, s]) => {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setDemo(d);
        setLive(s);
        setLoading(false);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      });
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  return { demo, live, loading };
}

const STAGE_COLOR: Record<string, string> = {
  "In Progress": "text-brand-strong bg-mint",
  "Pathway Review": "text-amber-ink bg-amber-soft",
  Fingerprinting: "text-on-surface-variant bg-surface-high",
};

function KpiCard({
  icon,
  label,
  value,
  sub,
  to,
  loading,
}: {
  icon: string;
  label: string;
  value: string | number;
  sub?: string;
  to?: string;
  loading?: boolean;
}) {
  const inner = (
    <div className="flex items-start gap-4 p-5">
      <div className="grid size-10 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-xl bg-surface-high text-brand-strong">
        <Icon name={icon} size={20} />
      </div>
      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
        {loading ? (
          <Skeleton className="mb-1.5 h-7 w-16" />
        ) : (
          <p className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-on-surface">
            {value}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="text-sm text-on-surface-variant">{label}</p>
        {sub && <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">{sub}</p>}
      </div>
    </div>
  );

  if (to) {
    return (
      <Link to={to} className="block">
        <Card className="cursor-pointer transition-shadow hover:shadow-md">
          {inner}
        </Card>
      </Link>
    );
  }
  return <Card>{inner}</Card>;
}

function ActivityIcon({ name, tone }: { name: string; tone: string }) {
  const map: Record<string, string> = {
    fingerprint: "fingerprint",
    menu_book: "menu_book",
    alt_route: "alt_route",
    verified_user: "verified_user",
  };
  return (
    <div
      className={cn(
        "grid size-8 shrink-0 place-items-center rounded-lg",
        tone === "critical"
          ? "bg-risk/10 text-risk"
          : "bg-surface-high text-on-surface-variant",
      )}
    >
      <Icon name={map[name] ?? "circle"} size={16} />
    </div>
  );
}

function HomePage() {
  const { demo, live, loading } = useDashboardData();

  const liveSuppliers = live?.supplierCount ?? 0;
  const liveFeedstocks = live?.feedstockCount ?? 0;
  const liveBatches = live?.batchCount ?? 0;
  const demoFeedstocks = FEEDSTOCKS.length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-10 pt-6">
      <PageHeader
        eyebrow="Overview"
        title="Dashboard"
        description="BIOPATH AI · Feedstock-to-Protein Intelligence"
      />

      {/* KPI Row */}
      <section aria-label="Key metrics">
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <KpiCard
            icon="eco"
            label="Demo feedstocks"
            value={demoFeedstocks}
            sub="22 profiled · 5 screening"
            to="/feedstocks"
            loading={loading}
          />
          <KpiCard
            icon="inventory_2"
            label="Live batches"
            value={loading ? "—" : liveBatches}
            sub={
              liveBatches > 0
                ? `${liveFeedstocks} feedstocks registered`
                : "Register batches to track supply"
            }
            to="/source-intelligence"
            loading={loading}
          />
          <KpiCard
            icon="alt_route"
            label="Pathways evaluated"
            value={
              loading
                ? "—"
                : demo
                  ? fmtCompact(demo.kpis.pathwaysEvaluated)
                  : "—"
            }
            sub="Across all profiled feedstocks"
            to="/pathways"
            loading={loading}
          />
          <KpiCard
            icon="people"
            label="Live suppliers"
            value={loading ? "—" : liveSuppliers}
            sub="Registered in this workspace"
            to="/source-intelligence"
            loading={loading}
          />
        </div>
      </section>

      <div className="grid gap-8 lg:grid-cols-12">
        {/* Active projects */}
        <section
          aria-label="Active research projects"
          className="lg:col-span-7"
        >
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-on-surface">Active projects</h2>
            <Link
              to="/feedstocks"
              className="text-sm text-brand-strong hover:underline"
            >
              View all feedstocks →
            </Link>
          </div>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {loading
              ? Array.from({ length: 3 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <Skeleton key={i} className="h-24 rounded-xl" />
                ))
              : demo?.projects.map((p) => (
                  <Card key={p.id} className="p-4">
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                      <div className="size-14 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-lg bg-surface-high">
                        <img
                          src={p.image}
                          alt=""
                          className="size-full object-cover"
                          onError={(e) => {
                            (e.target as HTMLImageElement).style.display =
                              "none";
                          }}
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-2">
                          <Link
                            to="/feedstocks/$feedstockId"
                            params={{ feedstockId: p.feedstockId }}
                            className="font-medium text-on-surface hover:underline"
                          >
                            {p.title}
                          </Link>
                          <Badge
                            className={cn(
                              "shrink-0 text-xs",
                              STAGE_COLOR[p.stage] ?? "",
                            )}
                          >
                            {p.stage}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          {p.updated}
                        </p>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Progress
                            value={p.completion}
                            className="h-1.5 flex-1"
                          />
                          <span className="type-data text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                            {p.completion}%
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </Card>
                ))}
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* Recent activity */}
        <section aria-label="Recent activity" className="lg:col-span-5">
          <div className="mb-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <h2 className="font-semibold text-on-surface">Recent activity</h2>
          </div>
          <Card className="divide-y divide-hairline">
            {loading
              ? Array.from({ length: 4 }).map((_, i) => (
                  <div key={i} className="flex gap-3 p-4">
                    <Skeleton className="size-8 shrink-0 rounded-lg" />
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-1.5">
                      <Skeleton className="h-3.5 w-3/4" />
                      <Skeleton className="h-3 w-1/2" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))
              : demo?.activity.map((a) => (
                  <div key={a.id} className="flex gap-3 p-4">
                    <ActivityIcon name={a.icon} tone={a.tone} />
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-on-surface">
                        {a.title}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-on-surface-variant">
                        {a.detail}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="type-data shrink-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                      {a.ago}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
          </Card>

          {/* Live batch activity */}
          {live && live.recentBatches.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-6">
              <div className="mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold text-on-surface">
                  Latest collection batches
                </h3>
                <Link
                  to="/source-intelligence"
                  className="text-xs text-brand-strong hover:underline"
                >
                  View all →
                </Link>
              </div>
              <Card className="divide-y divide-hairline">
                {live.recentBatches.map((b) => (
                  <div
                    key={b.id}
                    className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5"
                  >
                    <Icon
                      name="inventory_2"
                      size={16}
                      className="text-on-surface-variant"
                    />
                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <p className="text-xs font-medium text-on-surface">
                        {b.batchCode}
                      </p>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                        {b.quantity} {b.quantityUnit}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                    <span className="type-data text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {fmtDate(b.collectionDate)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </Card>
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>

      {/* Quick access */}
      <section aria-label="Quick access">
        <h2 className="mb-4 font-semibold text-on-surface">
          Explore BIOPATH AI
        </h2>
        <div className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3">
          {[
            {
              icon: "eco",
              to: "/feedstocks",
              label: "Feedstock Explorer",
              desc: "Browse and search 22 characterised feedstocks with composition and risk data.",
              params: undefined,
            },
            {
              icon: "alt_route",
              to: "/pathways",
              label: "Pathway Optimizer",
              desc: "Rank conversion pathways against your chosen feedstock and target market.",
              params: undefined,
            },
            {
              icon: "fingerprint",
              to: "/fingerprinting",
              label: "Batch Fingerprinting",
              desc: "Statistical control charts and QC pass rates across all logged batches.",
              params: undefined,
            },
            {
              icon: "pie_chart",
              to: "/allocation",
              label: "Resource Allocation",
              desc: "Greedy allocation across feedstocks under water and energy caps.",
              params: undefined,
            },
            {
              icon: "category",
              to: "/end-use",
              label: "End-Use Intelligence",
              desc: "Food, feed and industrial suitability for each feedstock × pathway.",
````
